scripts.text: This is a pub but also an adventurers' club where adventurers stop by. They come from all over the place and share their stories as well as find companions for adventures.

scripts.text: These days, many people come to seek information before heading off to the new world.
scripts.translation: 最近有很多人在前往新世界之前，来这里打听消息。

scripts.text: About ten years ago, it was a conciliating place to rehab hoodlum dorams and recruit them as vigilantes. Before that, rough sailors came to relax after a hard day's work.
scripts.translation: 大约十年前，这里曾用来感化惹事生非的多兰，并招募他们加入义警团。在那之前，辛苦工作一天的水手们常来这里放松。

scripts.text: Chief Peperoncino and Captain Gamberry first met here as well. The three became sworn brothers and became legends after their endeavors proved to be successful.
scripts.translation: 佩佩龙奇诺首领和甘贝里船长也是在这里初次相遇的。三人结为异姓兄弟，后来事业有成，成了传奇人物。

scripts.text: So people who wish to succeed or adventurers who wish to become just like them come here a lot.
scripts.translation: 因此，渴望成功的人，以及想成为他们那样的冒险者，都常来这里。

scripts.text: Did you decide what you'll have?

scripts.text: Everyone orders kaluna milk here because of the oven resolution by Peperoncino, Gamberry, and Thomas. But Pub-Oven's real specialty menu is the fish cake.

scripts.text: Fish cake is a white fish fillet mashed with boiled beans that is shaped and fried. It's really delicious but no one asks for it.
scripts.translation: 鱼糕是把白身鱼肉和煮熟的豆子捣碎混合，塑形后再油炸而成。味道很好，却没人点。

scripts.text: So we don't even have the ingredients prepared these days. When there's an order once in a while, we run to the fish store to buy a cod and start cooking then.

scripts.text: Besides, there are elements of Undead, Holiness and Darkness.

scripts.translation: 各种属性彼此相克，善用克制对手的属性吧。

scripts.text: That way, you can get the upper hand of a battle.

scripts.text: Let me give you a brief example on their correlation.

scripts.text: Yet, Water element defeats Fire element.

scripts.text: If you run into a problem, ask them for help. You know, the twins in the vigilante corps. Aglio... Ali... Ol...

对！他们叫阿利奥和奥利戈！

scripts.translation: 他们叫阿利奥和奥利奥，不是阿利奥和奥利戈。你把他们说得像糖果一样。

scripts.text: It's dangerous to put yourself out into the world. Take these tri-colored anchovies.
scripts.translation: 独自闯荡世界很危险。拿着这些三色鳀鱼吧。

scripts.text: Everyone keep away! I'm dangerous. Krahh! How long can the tri-colored anchovies hold off?!
scripts.translation: 大家都离我远点！我很危险。喵啊！三色鳀鱼能挡住它们多久？！

scripts.text: Kah... The poltergeist that had been sleeping inside my bag is raging!
scripts.translation: 嘎...一直睡在我包里的恶灵发狂了！

scripts.text: Good! This should be enough to keep me from getting snubbed in the new world.
scripts.translation: 太好了！这样到了新世界，我就不会被人冷落了。

scripts.text: I've worked here for a while, but I'm still the youngest so I do all the dishes.
scripts.translation: 我在这里工作有一阵子了，但还是年纪最小，所以所有碗都归我洗。

scripts.text: A glass before sailing out, a glass on land after a long voyage, a glass for everyone who came from out of town to make an oven resolution, a glass for every regular customers, a glass for everyone who drinks because others drink it..
scripts.translation: 出海前喝一杯，长途航行回来上岸后喝一杯；外地人来参加烤箱决议，人人都要喝一杯；每位熟客喝一杯，就连看别人喝也跟着喝的人也要来一杯...

scripts.text: So basically, It's beyond your imagination how many glasses I have to wash each day. Not only that, I have to listen to vigilance corps and merchants' low-ranking dorams whine, and counsel rookie adventurers.
scripts.translation: 所以，我每天要洗多少杯子，简直多得数不清。不仅如此，我还得听义警团和商人手下的低阶多兰抱怨，还要劝导新手冒险者。

scripts.text: Really, 24 hours are too short. We should hire one more person!

scripts.text: My family members are very lazy. Unless I train them based on my strong belief, they can never become warriors.

scripts.text: What's more, Jogi keeps wandering near the forest, saying He's going for the Militia. Mom said it's dangerous...
scripts.translation: 乔吉总在森林附近闲逛，说自己要加入民兵。妈妈说那里很危险...

scripts.text: What if a monster takes my brother away? That monster's gotta hurt a lot...

scripts.text: I'm Goma Chara, the eldest daughter of the Charas. These brats are who quicken my ageing process...
scripts.translation: 我是戈马·查拉，查拉家的长女。这些小鬼头真让我操心，感觉都要被他们气

scripts.text: If you happen to have the amulet that my brother Yota made, I can polish it for you.
scripts.translation: 老了...如果您有我弟弟约塔做的护身符，我可以帮您打磨。

scripts.text: My father was a born seaman so went out into the sea a long time ago, saying he'll catch the world's largest tuna.
scripts.translation: 爸爸天生是个水手，很久以前就出海了，说要捕获世界上最大的金枪鱼。

scripts.text: My mother can be a collector so she would go into the deepmost side of the forest, looking for the odd fruits. She would come and go even before I know it.
scripts.translation: 妈妈喜欢收藏奇珍异果，所以常去森林最深处寻找。她总是来去匆匆，我还没反应过来，她就已经走了。

scripts.text: So taking care of these bratty brothers has become my responsibility! I wonder why I was born the eldest! I've almost had it!
scripts.translation: 照顾这些调皮的弟弟就成了我的责任！真不懂为什么偏偏我是老大！我快受不了了！

scripts.text: Yota! Tidy up your place after making amulets! Pick up the scales of horse mackerels there. Oh, my days...
scripts.translation: 约塔！做完护身符要把地方收拾干净！把地上的竹荚鱼鳞片捡起来。真是的...

scripts.text: Jogi, Dandi is about to burst into crying. Please behave yourself, will you?
scripts.translation: 乔吉，丹迪快要哭出来了。你就不能乖一点吗？

scripts.text: I'm sorry but our chit-chat ends here. Time flies when you're busy taking care of little brothers.
scripts.translation: ！抱歉，闲聊就到这里吧。照顾弟弟们的时候，时间总是过得飞快。

scripts.text: Yota often makes quality amulets, but he still needs more polishing.
scripts.translation: 约塔做的护身符通常很不错，不过还得多打磨

scripts.text: If he pays attention to details, his amulets will be even greater. But he just doesn't care.
scripts.translation: 。要是他能多注意细节，护身符就会更好，可他就是不上心。
这枚护身符已经完美无缺了！

scripts.text: Show me your amulet, will you? I can't seem to find it in your inventory.
scripts.translation: 把护身符给我看看，好吗？我在你的物品栏里没找到。

scripts.text: ...I knew this was going to happen again. Worse, this one must require a lot more time to polish!

scripts.text: I'm sorry to say this when you're working so hard to help us, but how about searching for some other work? I think It's a shame to let your skills go to waste.
scripts.translation: 您这么努力地帮我们，我实在不该这么说...不过要不要考虑找点别的工作？您的本事不用在这里太可惜了。

scripts.text: I heard that honey collect is in need of help, so you should go see ^4D4DFF[Florin]^000000. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation: 听说采蜜的人手不够，您可以去找[弗洛林]。谢谢您帮忙。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: I heard that Prok needs some help right now. Why don't you go see ^4D4DFF[Prok]^000000? Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation: 听说[普罗克]现在需要帮忙。您去看看吧？谢谢您帮忙。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: Speaking of which, ^4D4DFF[Fisher]^000000 said he needed some help. Would you like to give it a try? Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation: 对了，[渔夫]也说需要人手。您愿意去试试吗？谢谢您帮忙。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: ^4D4DFF[Sleepy meow]^000000, who lives over there at the mouth of the cave where basilisks live, is desperately seeking for a strong individual. Perhaps you should give it a try for the experience. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation: 住在蛇怪洞穴入口附近的[瞌睡喵]正在急寻强者。您不妨去试试，顺便积累些经验。谢谢您帮忙。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: Taking a ship from the ^4D4DFF[dock]^000000 in search of a bigger adventure is also a good idea. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation: 从[码头]乘船，去寻找更大的冒险，也不错。谢谢您帮忙。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: Thank you. Now our cows can enjoy delicious meal.
scripts.translation: 谢谢您。现在奶牛们终于能吃上美味的饭了。

scripts.text: But you seem too skilled to do this kind of work. There are many other jobs that require physical strength, so perhaps you should go seek them.
scripts.translation: 不过您看起来太能干了，不该做这种工作。还有很多需要体力的工作，您不妨去找找看。

scripts.text: Not today. Maybe tomorrow? Let me see... Who said needed some help?
scripts.translation: 今天没有。也许明天吧？让我想想...谁说过需要帮忙来着？

scripts.text: Hey cows- eat a lot and relax a lot- I'll sing you a song-
scripts.translation: 嘿，奶牛们——多吃多休息——我来给你们唱首歌——

scripts.text: Hello, are you the person who's here to help us? Then you can start now.
scripts.translation: 您好，您是来帮忙的吗？那就开始吧。

scripts.text: Work? That's out of the blue. No, I won't do it!
scripts.translation: 工作？怎么突然说这个？不，我不干！

scripts.text: If you need help, then you should at least tell me what I should do.
scripts.translation: 想让我帮忙，至少得告诉我该做什么。

scripts.text: Oh, didn't the Chef tell you? I'm sorry, most people come here after hearing the details from him.
scripts.translation: 哦，厨师没告诉您吗？抱歉，大家通常都是先听他说明情况才来的。

scripts.text: Those Grass Fabres and Leaf Lunatics are eating away the entire grass. But they shouldn't because they're leaving my cute cows here with no food.
scripts.translation: 草地绿棉虫和群叶疯兔快把草吃光了！它们不能这样，害得我可爱的奶牛都没草吃了。

scripts.text: Our cows have nothing to eat then.
scripts.translation: 这样下去，我们的奶牛就没东西吃了。

scripts.text: If our cows can't eat grass, then we can't milk them. If we have no fresh milk, then we can't make kaluna milk.
scripts.translation: 奶牛没草吃，我们就挤不出奶。没有鲜奶，也就做不了卡鲁纳牛奶。

scripts.text: And... Oh, I don't even want to imagine after that.
scripts.translation: 而且...唉，我都不敢往下想。

scripts.text: So I need you to catch Grass Fabres and Leaf Lunatics. Five each. Okay, then start!
scripts.translation: 所以得请您抓草地绿棉虫和群叶疯兔，各 5 只。好了，开始吧！

scripts.text: You're still not done yet. Please catch five Grass Fabres and five Leaf Lunatics.
scripts.translation: 还没完成呢。请再抓 5 只草地绿棉虫和 5 只群叶疯兔。

scripts.text: Mm...good. This area is settled now. You're really good at this.
scripts.translation: 嗯...很好，这一带已经安全了。您做得真不错。

scripts.text: Thank you so much. I hope you can help us again next time. So what'd you say? Please give it a thought.
scripts.translation: 太感谢您了。希望下次还能请您帮忙。刚才我说的事，您再考虑一下吧。

scripts.text: there's nothing threatening around here right now. Our cows are satisfied with their meals, too.
scripts.translation: 眼下这附近没有威胁，奶牛们也吃得很满足。

scripts.text: Get some good rest and come back tomorrow.
Adventurer, please help! Packs of Grass Fabres and Leaf Lunatics are coming this way!
scripts.translation: 冒险者，请帮帮忙！成群的草地绿棉虫和群叶疯兔正朝这边过来！

scripts.text: Please catch five from each pack! I'll do whatever I can with the rest!
scripts.translation: 请两种各抓 5 只！剩下的我会尽力处理！

scripts.text: Adventurer, I know you're helping us right now but I think you are better off working not in this field, but in a different one.
scripts.translation: 冒险者，我知道您正在帮我们，不过您更适合去其他领域工作，不该一直待在这里。

scripts.text: I heard that Prok needs some help right now. Why don't you go see ^4D4DFF[Prok]^000000? Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation: 听说[普罗克]现在需要帮忙，您去找他看看吧。谢谢您帮忙。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: Speaking of which, ^4D4DFF[Fisher]^000000 said he needed some help. Would you like to give it a try? Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation: 对了，[渔夫]也说需要人手。您愿意去试试吗？谢谢您帮忙。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: ^4D4DFF[Sleepy meow]^000000, who lives over there at the mouth of the cave where basilisks live, is desperately seeking for a strong individual. Perhaps you should give it a try for the experience. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation: 住在蛇怪洞穴入口附近的[瞌睡喵]正在急寻强者。您不妨去试试，顺便积累些经验。谢谢您帮忙。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: Taking a ship from the ^4D4DFF[dock]^000000 in search of a bigger adventure is also a good idea. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation: 从[码头]乘船去寻找更大的冒险，也不错。谢谢您帮忙。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: Thanks to you, we were able to collect so much honey. Thank you!
scripts.translation: 多亏了您，我们才能收集到这么多蜂蜜。太谢谢您了！

scripts.text: But I think you are better off working not in this field, but in a different one.
scripts.translation: 不过，您更适合去其他领域工作，不该一直待在这里。

scripts.text: If It's all right with you, may I find you work? You've done a lot today, so please get some good rest and see you tomorrow.
scripts.translation: 如果您愿意，我可以帮您找份工作。您今天已经很辛苦了，先好好休息，明天再见。

scripts.text: I heard that Prok needs some help right now. Why don't you go see ^4D4DFF[Prok]^000000? Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation: 听说[普罗克]现在需要帮忙，您去找他看看吧。谢谢您帮忙。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: Speaking of which, ^4D4DFF[Fisher]^000000 said he needed some help. Would you like to give it a try? Thank you for helping us.

scripts.text: Taking a ship from the ^4D4DFF[dock]^000000 in search of a bigger adventure is also a good idea. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation: 从[码头]乘船去寻找更大的冒险，也不错。谢谢您帮忙。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: I really like this job! I can smell sweet flowers and also get some honey!
scripts.translation: 我真喜欢这份工作！既能闻到甜甜的花香，又能收集蜂蜜！

scripts.text: Ouch! Why are you hitting me all of a sudden?
Oh! I'm sorry. I thought it was the hornets again.
scripts.translation: 啊！抱歉，我还以为又是蜂兵来了。

scripts.text: You look like you need help.
I almost got hurt. Please be careful next time.
scripts.translation: 我差点受伤，下次小心点。

scripts.text: You look like you need help. Want me to help?
scripts.translation: 看起来你需要帮忙。要我帮你吗？

scripts.text: Really... you'll help me? Even after I had hit you? Well, I'm so grateful if you can because I need some help right now.
scripts.translation: 真的吗...你愿意帮我？我刚才还打了你呢。太感谢了，我现在确实需要帮忙。

scripts.text: I'm collecting honey needed to ferment kaluna from the blooming flowers here, but our biggest rivals, the hornets, are taking everything before we even get a chance.
scripts.translation: 我正在采集花朵里的蜂蜜，用来发酵卡鲁纳。可我们的死对头蜂兵总是抢在我们前面，把蜂蜜全采光了。

scripts.text: At this rate, I won't have enough honey and won't be able to make kaluna milk. If people can't drink kaluna milk, then there will be a riot and...
scripts.translation: 再这样下去，我就采不到足够的蜂蜜，也做不出卡鲁纳牛奶了。大家要是喝不到卡鲁纳牛奶，肯定会闹起来...

scripts.text: Adventurer, I beg you. We must stop Lasagna from going back to its dark ages. Everything is in your hands!
scripts.translation: 冒险者，求求您了。我们不能让罗札纳倒退回黑暗时代。一切就拜托您了！

scripts.text: Please defeat our rivals, the wild hornets. Around ten would do.
scripts.translation: 请帮忙消灭我们的死对头狂野蜂兵。大约十只就够了。

scripts.text: If you can defeat them, then I'll do whatever I can with the rest. Thank you.
scripts.translation: 只要您能击败它们，剩下的交给我处理。谢谢您。

scripts.text: Oh, you're not done yet. Have you forgotten what you were supposed to catch?
scripts.translation: 哦，您还没完成呢。忘了自己该抓什么了吗？

scripts.text: You need to catch ten wild hornets. Good luck!
scripts.translation: 请消灭 10 只狂野蜂兵。祝您好运！

scripts.text: Thanks to you, we were able to collect so much honey. Thank you!
scripts.translation: 多亏了您，我们才能收集到这么多蜂蜜。太谢谢您了！

scripts.text: But I think you are better off working not in this field, but in a different one.
scripts.translation: 不过，您更适合去其他领域工作，不该一直待在这里。

scripts.text: If It's all right with you, may I find you work? You've done a lot today, so please get some good rest and see you tomorrow.
scripts.translation: 如果您愿意，我可以帮您找份工作。您今天已经很辛苦了，先好好休息，明天再见。

scripts.text: I heard that Prok needs some help right now. Why don't you go see ^4D4DFF[Prok]^000000? Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation: 听说[普罗克]现在需要帮忙，您去找他看看吧。谢谢您帮忙。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: The wild hornets are quiet right now. At this number, I can take care of them myself.
scripts.translation: 现在狂野蜂兵不怎么活动，这点数量我自己就能应付。

scripts.text: Once the sun is up, they'll be back again. Could you come back then and help me?
scripts.translation: 太阳一出来，它们就会再度出现。到时候您能再来帮我吗？

scripts.text: You look like you still need help today as well. Want me to help?
scripts.translation: 看起来您今天也需要帮忙。要我帮您吗？

scripts.text: Ah, adventurer, I'm so glad you're here!
scripts.translation: 啊，冒险者，您来了真是太好了！

scripts.text: I need you to defeat our rival wild hornet today as well. Around ten hornets. Thank you!
scripts.translation: 今天也请您消灭我们的死对头狂野蜂兵，大约十只就行。谢谢您！

scripts.text: After observing you, I get a feeling that you might better off working not in this field, but in a different one.
scripts.translation: 观察过您之后，我觉得您更适合去其他领域工作，不该一直待在这里。

scripts.text: Speaking of which, ^4D4DFF[Fisher]^000000 said he needed some help. Would you like to give it a try? Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation: 对了，[渔夫]说需要帮忙。您愿意去试试吗？谢谢您帮忙。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: ^4D4DFF[Sleepy meow]^000000, who lives over there at the mouth of the cave where basilisks live, is desperately seeking for a strong individual. Perhaps you should give it a try for the experience. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation: [瞌睡喵]住在巴希利斯克洞穴入口附近，正在急寻强者。您不妨去试试，顺便积累些经验。谢谢您帮忙。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: Taking a ship from the ^4D4DFF[dock]^000000 in search of a bigger adventure is also a good idea. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation: 从[码头]乘船去寻找更大的冒险，也不错。谢谢您帮忙。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: After observing you, I get a feeling that you might better off working not in this field, but in a different one.
scripts.translation: 观察过您之后，我觉得您更适合去其他领域工作，不该一直待在这里。

scripts.text: Speaking of which, ^4D4DFF[Fisher]^000000 said he needed some help. Would you like to give it a try? Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation: 对了，[渔夫]说需要帮忙。您愿意去试试吗？谢谢您帮忙。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: ^4D4DFF[Sleepy meow]^000000, who lives over there at the mouth of the cave where basilisks live, is desperately seeking for a strong individual. Perhaps you should give it a try for the experience. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation: [瞌睡喵]住在巴希利斯克洞穴入口附近，正在急寻强者。您不妨去试试，顺便积累些经验。谢谢您帮忙。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: Taking a ship from the ^4D4DFF[dock]^000000 in search of a bigger adventure is also a good idea. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation: 从[码头]乘船去寻找更大的冒险，也不错。谢谢您帮忙。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: Wow, thank you! That was quick.
But rather than working on this side, I think you should seek out for an adventure.
scripts.translation: 不过，比起在这里工作，我觉得您更应该去冒险。

scripts.text: If you wish, I can find something for you. But not today. Perhaps tomorrow. Today you should get some rest.
scripts.translation: 如果您愿意，我可以帮您找点事做。不过今天不行，也许明天吧。今天先好好休息。

scripts.text: Speaking of which, ^4D4DFF[Fisher]^000000 said he needed some help. Would you like to give it a try? Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation: 对了，[渔夫]说需要帮忙。您愿意去试试吗？谢谢您帮忙。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: ^4D4DFF[Sleepy meow]^000000, who lives over there at the mouth of the cave where basilisks live, is desperately seeking for a strong individual. Perhaps you should give it a try for the experience. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation: [瞌睡喵]住在巴希利斯克洞穴入口附近，正在急寻强者。您不妨去试试，顺便积累些经验。谢谢您帮忙。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: Taking a ship from the ^4D4DFF[dock]^000000 in search of a bigger adventure is also a good idea. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation: 从[码头]乘船去寻找更大的冒险，也不错。谢谢您帮忙。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: Slippery- sticky- It's amazing such creatures exist.
scripts.translation: 滑溜溜的...黏糊糊的...竟然还有这种生物，真奇妙。

scripts.text: Can you by any chance help me? If you have time, that is.
scripts.translation: 您能帮帮我吗？如果您有空的话。

scripts.text: I'm busy right now. I'll help you next time. Sorry!
scripts.translation: 我现在没空，下次再帮你吧。抱歉！

scripts.text: Wow! Thank you! I need to take sticky webfeet but That's a bit hard to do alone.
scripts.translation: 哇！谢谢您！我得去收集黏糊蹼，不过一个人做起来有点困难。

scripts.text: This sticky webfoot is the main ingredient of pudding, but it goes bad quickly after a day. And smells awful, too.
scripts.translation: 黏糊蹼是制作布丁的主要材料，不过放一天就会变质，味道也会变得很难闻。

scripts.text: So every day, I must only collect how much I need for the day. But I still haven't collected enough for today.
scripts.translation: 所以我每天只能采集当天需要的量，但今天还没收够。

scripts.text: Chef must be waiting... It's such a relief that you're helping me.
scripts.translation: 厨师应该等急了...幸好有您来帮忙。

scripts.text: Could you catch Sweet Roda Frogs and bring me sticky webfeet? Around five of them. Thank you!
scripts.translation: 能帮我抓 5 只甜心罗达蛙，带回它们的黏糊蹼吗？谢谢您！

scripts.text: Um, did you really catch Sweet Roda Frog?
scripts.translation: 嗯...您真的抓到甜心罗达蛙了吗？

scripts.text: You need to catch ten... I also need five sticky webfeet.
scripts.translation: 得抓 10 只...我还需要 5 份黏糊蹼。

scripts.text: I asked for five sticky webfeet but I still need a bit more. I don't have enough time to collect them alone.
scripts.translation: 我让您带回 5 份黏糊蹼，可还差一点。我一个人收集的话，时间不够。

scripts.text: Wow, thank you! That was quick.
Can I ask for a favor again next time? I need to take fresh ones every day.
scripts.translation: 下次还能再麻烦您吗？我每天都需要新鲜的黏糊蹼。

scripts.text: You're here again. But I don't need sticky webfeet yet. What you sent yesterday is enough.
scripts.translation: 您又来了。不过我现在还不需要黏糊蹼，您昨天送来的已经够用了。

scripts.text: But you never know, so can you come back tomorrow?
scripts.translation: 不过也说不准，您明天能再来吗？

scripts.text: You're here. Can you help me today as well?
scripts.translation: 您来了。今天也能帮我吗？

scripts.text: Could you catch ten Sweet Roda Frogs and bring me sticky webfeet? Around five of them. Thank you!
scripts.translation: 能帮我抓 10 只甜心罗达蛙，带回大约 5 份黏糊蹼吗？谢谢您！

scripts.text: Adventurer, stop what you're doing just for a minute. I think I can handle it alone from here. You seem too strong for this type of work, you know.
scripts.translation: 冒险者，请先停一下手头的事。我想剩下的我自己能处理。您这么厉害，做这种工作有点大材小用。

scripts.text: ^4D4DFF[Sleepy meow]^000000, who lives over there at the mouth of the cave where basilisks live, is desperately seeking for a strong individual. Perhaps you should give it a try for the experience. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation: [瞌睡喵]住在巴希利斯克洞穴入口附近，正在急寻强者。您不妨去试试，顺便积累些经验。谢谢您帮忙。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: Taking a ship from the ^4D4DFF[dock]^000000 in search of a bigger adventure is also a good idea. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation: 从[码头]乘船去寻找更大的冒险，也不错。谢谢您帮忙。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: Thank you so much. I bet they'll be scared to show up for a while.
scripts.translation: 太谢谢您了！我想它们一时半会儿都不敢再来了。

scripts.text: But I think you should seek for bigger adventures. don't let your skills go to waste in this boondocks and go out to a bigger place.
scripts.translation: 不过，您应该去寻找更大的冒险。别把本事浪费在这种偏僻地方，去更广阔的天地闯闯吧。

scripts.text: Right. There was someone who needed help. You had a long day today, so perhaps you should go see him tomorrow.
scripts.translation: 对了，之前有人说需要帮忙。您今天辛苦了，明天再去找他吧。

scripts.text: ^4D4DFF[Sleepy meow]^000000, who lives over there at the mouth of the cave where basilisks live, is desperately seeking for a strong individual. Perhaps you should give it a try for the experience. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation: [瞌睡喵]住在巴希利斯克洞穴入口附近，正在急寻强者。您不妨去试试，顺便积累些经验。谢谢您帮忙。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: Taking a ship from the ^4D4DFF[dock]^000000 in search of a bigger adventure is also a good idea. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation: 从[码头]乘船去寻找更大的冒险，也不错。谢谢您帮忙。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: Today's wind is good! The fish will dry nicely.
scripts.translation: 今天风向正好！鱼干一定能晒得很好。

scripts.text: Oh, what am I going to do. Hey you, adventurer! Hold on a second!
scripts.translation: 哎呀，这可怎么办？喂，冒险者！等一下！

scripts.text: Yeah? Then I guess there's nothing I can do.
Take a look at those Desert Wolves. What do you think?
scripts.translation: 看看那些沙漠之狼，您觉得怎么样？

scripts.text: Those monsters steal all the fish I'm drying right now!
scripts.translation: 那些魔物把我正在晾晒的鱼全偷走了！

scripts.text: What Hunter Desert Wolf in the world eats fish? A dried one, too!
scripts.translation: 世上哪有沙漠之狼会吃鱼啊？而且还是鱼干！

scripts.text: Then again...It's hard to forget this fish once you get a taste of it since the flavors are concentrated.
scripts.translation: 不过话说回来...鱼干的味道很浓，尝过一次就让人难以忘怀。

scripts.text: But this is Chef's favorite snack. It's the only snack that picky eater likes.
scripts.translation: 可这是厨师最喜欢的零食，也是那个挑食家唯一爱吃的零食。

scripts.text: Without it, we have to endure a very difficult time.
scripts.translation: 没有鱼干的话，我们可要难熬了。

scripts.text: Oh, there they are again! Adventurer, please keep them from coming here. Catch ten of them.
scripts.translation: 啊，它们又来了！冒险者，请别让它们靠近。抓 10 只吧。

scripts.text: Those Hunter Desert Wolves are rampaging still.
scripts.translation: 那些猎人沙漠狼还在肆虐。

scripts.text: At least ten should be caught.
Adventurer, I was so desperate back then that I just grabbed anybody who passed by, but I think I hit the jackpot!
scripts.translation: 冒险者，当时我急得团团转，随手拉了个路人帮忙，没想到真是捡到宝了！

scripts.text: Oh, don't take it the wrong way. Despite what it may seem, I'm really grateful from deep down. Thank you!
scripts.translation: 哦，别误会。虽然我看起来不像是感激的样子，但我是真心感谢您！

scripts.text: I hope you can help me tomorrow as well!
scripts.translation: 希望明天也能请您帮忙！

scripts.text: The Hunter Desert Wolves are quiet right now. They must've been shocked to see you in action.
scripts.translation: 猎人沙漠狼现在安静多了。它们肯定是被您的身手吓到了。

scripts.text: So I hope you come back tomorrow!
Adventurer, good to see you! They're fiercely coming at us. I guess they're real furious about not having any fish yesterday.
scripts.translation: 冒险者，您来得正好！它们正气势汹汹地冲过来，看来是因为昨天没吃到鱼，气坏了。

scripts.text: Whoa! There they are again! Adventure, please keep those Hunter Desert Wolves away from here. Catch ten of them.
scripts.translation: 哇！它们又来了！冒险者，请把这些猎人沙漠狼赶走。抓 10 只吧。

scripts.text: Adventurer. I had a dream. You were heading off to the new world meow.
scripts.translation: 冒险者，我做了个梦。梦见你正要前往新世界喵。

scripts.text: My dream is almost prophetic. So stop what you were doing and go to the ^4D4DFF[dock]^000000 to board on a ship heading to the new world. A bigger adventure will be waiting for you there meow.
scripts.translation: 我的梦几乎都会成真。别忙手头的事了，去[码头]搭上前往新世界的船吧。更大的冒险在等着你喵。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: Wherever go you, I wish you well. Thank you meow.
scripts.translation: 无论你去哪里，都祝你一切顺利。谢谢你喵。

scripts.text: Adventurer. I had a dream. You were heading off to the new world meow.
scripts.translation: 冒险者，我做了个梦。梦见你正要前往新世界喵。

scripts.text: My dream is almost prophetic. So stop what you were doing and go to the ^4D4DFF[dock]^000000 to board on a ship heading to the new world. A bigger adventure will be waiting for you there meow.
scripts.translation: 我的梦几乎都会成真。别忙手头的事了，去[码头]搭上前往新世界的船吧。更大的冒险在等着你喵。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: Wherever go you, I wish you well. Thank you meow.
scripts.translation: 无论你去哪里，都祝你一切顺利。谢谢你喵。

scripts.text: Adventurer. You're kind... You saved my life.
scripts.translation: 冒险者...你真好...救了我的命。

scripts.text: But what are you doing in such a rustic place? Isn't it better that you go and search for a bigger world? Like the new world, for example.
scripts.translation: 不过，你为什么待在这么偏僻的地方？去探索更广阔的世界不是更好吗？比如新世界。

scripts.text: If I were you, I would've left long ago. You're not here because you don't know how to get there, right? If That's the case, then I'll tell you. I can do that much for my life's savior.
scripts.translation: 如果我是你，早就离开这里了。你还留在这儿，该不会是不知道怎么去吧？要是这样，我来告诉你。毕竟你救了我的命，这点忙我还是帮得上的。

scripts.text: If you go to Lasagna, there is a ^4D4DFF[dock]^000000 there. Take a ship that goes to the new world from there. Wherever you go, I wish you the best. Thanks for everything meow.
scripts.translation: 去罗札纳的话，那里有个[码头]。搭船就能前往新世界。无论你去哪里，都祝你顺利。谢谢你救了我喵。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: What do you mean, save you?
I think someone with more experience should take care of this. I'm still a rookie.
scripts.translation: 我觉得这件事还是该交给更有经验的人。我还只是个新手。

scripts.text: I think I'm going to die at this rate...
scripts.translation: 照这样下去，我会死掉的...

scripts.text: My dad, I mean, Chef, told me to get mushroom spores or something...
scripts.translation: 我爸爸——我是说厨师——叫我去找香菇芽孢什么的...

scripts.text: I must bathe in the sunlight and sleep on days like this...
scripts.translation: 这种天气，我就该晒着太阳睡觉...

scripts.text: This sunlight is putting me to sleep meow...
I was here, desperately fighting against the sunlight and waiting for someone to pass by meow.
scripts.translation: 我一直在这里拼命抵抗睡意，等着有人经过喵。

scripts.text: I think I'm going to die, trying to fight sleepiness meow.
scripts.translation: 和睡意对抗，我都快撑不住了喵。

scripts.text: So please get those mushroom spores for me cuz I'm dying meow.
scripts.translation: 我都快不行了，快帮我找些香菇芽孢喵。

scripts.text: And while you're at it, beat those Trans Spores, too. I hate them meow.
scripts.translation: 顺便打败那些变形蘑菇吧，我讨厌它们喵。

scripts.text: My dad, I mean, Chef, gave me a training on entering caves so he can use me for such tasks meow.
scripts.translation: 我爸爸——我是说厨师——教过我怎么进洞穴，就是为了让我做这种差事喵。

scripts.text: So just the thought of them makes me all furious meow.
scripts.translation: 所以一想到它们，我就气得不行喵。

scripts.text: What is that look in your eyes? Do you think I'm pathetic meow?
scripts.translation: 你那是什么眼神？觉得我很可怜吗喵？

scripts.text: That's rude but It's okay. You're not the only one meow.
scripts.translation: 这样想是有点失礼，不过没关系。你不是第一个这么想的人喵。

scripts.text: It's okay if you decide not to help meow.
scripts.translation: 你不想帮我也没关系喵。

scripts.text: Even if I don't die here fighting against sleep, my dad, I mean, Chef, will kill me. Merely over mushroom spores meow.
scripts.translation: 就算我不是困死在这里，我爸爸——我是说厨师——也会因为这点香菇芽孢把我骂死喵。

scripts.text: That's okay, too. I came back to life many times already. Long and deep sleep is all I need to revive meow.
scripts.translation: 没关系，我已经死而复生很多次了。只要睡个长觉，我就能恢复过来喵。

scripts.text: So, please think of it as... saving someone's life...and help meeee...
scripts.translation: 所以...就当是在救一条命...帮帮我嘛...

scripts.text: Adventurer...? Are you waking me up cuz you're done? Let me see...
scripts.translation: 冒险者...你是做完了才来叫醒我的吗？我看看...

scripts.text: Wow, you're really done! That was so quick of you that I am wide awake. You really are a wonder!
scripts.translation: 哇，真的做完了！你动作太快，害我都清醒了。你真厉害！

scripts.text: Why don't you work at Pub-Oven instead of me? Then again, I'm sure you'd hate that, too.
scripts.translation: 你干吗不去酒馆烤箱工作，非要来帮我？不过你大概也会讨厌那份工作吧。

scripts.text: I might need to get some mushroom spores or something tomorrow as well, so drop by again. I'm going to bring these quickly and relax. Thanks! I owe you.
scripts.translation: 明天我可能还要找香菇芽孢，到时候再来吧。我先把这些赶紧送过去，然后休息。谢谢你，我欠你个人情。

scripts.text: Have you finished it already meow?
Of course not. This is not it. Did you forget already meow?
scripts.translation: 当然还没。这不是我要的东西。你已经忘了吗喵？

scripts.text: Catch ten Trans Spores and bring five mushroom spores meow.
scripts.translation: 抓 10 只变形蘑菇，再带回 5 份香菇芽孢喵。

scripts.text: Call me when you're done. Don't wake me up for no reason meow.
scripts.translation: 做完了再叫我。别没事叫醒我喵。

scripts.text: there's no more for today, so can go...
scripts.translation: 今天没有别的事了，你可以走了...

scripts.text: An adventurer. The adventurer from yesterday. Great, please save me today as well meow.
scripts.translation: 冒险者...是昨天那位冒险者！太好了，今天也救救我吧喵。

scripts.text: There seems to be another bothersome fish cake order that came in. So please get the ingredients for me. I'm busy today as well, desperately fighting against the sunlight meow.
scripts.translation: 又来了一单麻烦的鱼糕订单。帮我准备一下材料吧。我今天也忙着和阳光搏斗，快撑不住了喵。

scripts.text: Catch ten Trans Spores and bring them five mushroom spores meow.
scripts.translation: 抓 10 只变形蘑菇，再带回 5 份香菇芽孢喵。

scripts.text: You finished the job safe and sound. Thank you.
scripts.translation: 您平安顺利地完成了工作。谢谢。

scripts.text: But you're still skilled to be stuck here working. How about you look for something else?
scripts.translation: 您的本事这么好，困在这里做这种工作太可惜了。不如去找点别的事做？

scripts.text: Going on an adventure to the new world would be nice, too. If it weren't for my job, I would've left long ago.
scripts.translation: 去新世界冒险也不错。要不是这份工作牵绊着我，我早就出发了。

scripts.text: Anyway, thanks for your help. It helped a lot.
scripts.translation: 总之，谢谢您帮忙，真是帮了大忙。

scripts.text: I see that you were taking care of the favor I had asked.
scripts.translation: 看来您已经在帮我处理拜托您的事了。

scripts.text: But you're still skilled to be stuck here working. How about you look for something else?
scripts.translation: 您的本事这么好，困在这里做这种工作太可惜了。不如去找点别的事做？

scripts.text: I am not shameless enough to tie down a young person with such potential.
scripts.translation: 我可没厚脸皮把一位这么有潜力的年轻人留在这里。

scripts.text: Going on an adventure to the new world would be nice, too. If it weren't for my job, I would've left long ago.
scripts.translation: 去新世界冒险也不错。要不是这份工作牵绊着我，我早就出发了。

scripts.text: Anyway, thanks for your help. It helped a lot.
scripts.translation: 总之，谢谢您帮忙，真是帮了大忙。

scripts.text: Adventurer, can you do me a small favor? There are things I must do right now but as you can see, I am shorthanded. What'd you say?
scripts.translation: 冒险者，能帮我个小忙吗？我现在有急事要处理，可你也看到了，我人手不够。您意下如何？

scripts.text: Think of it as a continuation of your training and please help me. I'll give you a hefty wage, so what'd you say?
scripts.translation: 就当是继续训练，帮我一次吧。我会付您丰厚的报酬，怎么样？

scripts.text: I'm busy right now. I'll do it later.
scripts.translation: 我现在没空，之后再做吧。

scripts.text: Oh, thanks a bunch. What a relief, really!
scripts.translation: 哦，太感谢了！真是帮了大忙！

scripts.text: Then Let's cut to the chase.
All people from Lasagna love kaluna milk, but do you know what It's made of? Kaluna made from well-fermented kalunyak and fresh milk.
scripts.translation: 罗札纳的人都爱喝卡鲁纳牛奶，但您知道它是怎么做的吗？用发酵好的卡鲁尼亚克和新鲜牛奶就能制成。

scripts.text: As the recipe is simple, it takes good ingredients to come up with the best taste. So we get milk from our own cow that we raised.
scripts.translation: 食谱虽然简单，要做出好味道就得用上等食材。所以牛奶都是我们用自家养的奶牛挤的。

scripts.text: I'm sure you've been to Raviol Plains. You must come from there.
scripts.translation: 我想您一定去过罗札纳平原，应该就是从那里来的吧。

scripts.text: Where you must go is not the guard post. If you go south straight down, you'll see crossroads. Then go straight down underneath.
scripts.translation: 您要去的地方不是卫兵哨所。一直往南走到十字路口，再从路口继续向南。

scripts.text: That's where our cows are grazing. Grass there is fresh and clean, so the milk tastes superb.
scripts.translation: 我们的奶牛就在那儿吃草。那里的草新鲜又干净，挤出来的牛奶特别香。

scripts.text: But the Grass Fabres and Leaf Lunatics are devouring the grasses.
scripts.translation: 可草地绿棉虫和群叶疯兔正在把草吃光。

scripts.text: So please go and get rid of them. Five from each group should be enough.
scripts.translation: 所以请去把它们赶走。每种抓 5 只就够了。

scripts.text: You may come to me after catching all of them, or you can talk to the ^4D4DFF[shepherd]^000000 there.
scripts.translation: 抓完后可以来找我，也可以去找那边的[牧羊人]。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: Pay is same anywhere. You ready?
scripts.translation: 哪里给的报酬都一样。准备好了吗？

scripts.text: Do you know what the important things are when making kaluna milk? They're well-fermented kaluna and fresh milk.
scripts.translation: 您知道制作卡鲁纳牛奶最重要的原料是什么吗？发酵好的卡鲁尼亚克和新鲜牛奶。

scripts.text: Kaluna is made by a kaluna master near the south bridge. I can't tell you what exactly goes in there because It's a trade secret, but I can tell you one thing.
scripts.translation: 卡鲁纳是由南桥附近的卡鲁纳大师制作的。虽然制作配方是商业机密，不能告诉您，但有一点我可以透露。

scripts.text: It's honey. Lasagna fields are covered with sweet flowers, so we can collect a lot of quality honey.
scripts.translation: 那就是蜂蜜。罗札纳的田野开满了甜美的花朵，所以能采到许多上等蜂蜜。

scripts.text: But do you know what the greatest enemy is when collecting that honey? It's the wild hornet.
scripts.translation: 不过，您知道采蜜时最大的敌人是什么吗？就是狂野蜂兵。

scripts.text: They're honey-crazy creatures who are masters when it comes to collecting honey... We can't get rid of them entirely since the flowers need to be pollenated, but there's a need to control their number.
scripts.translation: 它们对蜂蜜如痴如醉，采蜜也很有一手...花朵还得靠它们授粉，我们不能赶尽杀绝，但必须控制数量。

scripts.text: So when the time comes, we hire adventurers to hunt the wild hornets.
scripts.translation: 所以每到时候，我们就会雇冒险者去讨伐狂野蜂兵。

scripts.text: You should give it a try. Ten hornets Aren't too much of a burden.
scripts.translation: 您也去试试吧。十只蜂兵不难对付。

scripts.text: You may come to me when you're done, or you may report to ^4D4DFF[Florin]^000000 who is collecting honey there.
scripts.translation: 完成后可以来找我，也可以去找在那里采蜜的[弗洛林]。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: I beg you. Please catch Roda Frogs and bring me five sticky webfeet! Without them, I can't make any pudding!
scripts.translation: 求求您了，抓些罗达蛙，给我带回 5 份黏糊蹼！没有它们，我就做不了布丁！

scripts.text: Please catch ten Roda Frogs. I always hated their slippery skin.
scripts.translation: 请抓 10 只罗达蛙。我一直很讨厌它们滑溜溜的皮肤。

scripts.text: You may bring sticky webfeet to me if you get them, or you may take them to ^4D4DFF[Prok]^000000. He agreed to bring them here anyway.
scripts.translation: 拿到黏糊蹼后可以交给我，也可以交给[普罗克]。他答应会帮忙带过来。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: My strings still Aren't here. It must be those Desert Wolves again.
scripts.translation: 我的鱼串还没送来。肯定又是那些沙漠之狼搞的鬼。

scripts.text: Hey adventurer, so what'd you say? won't you take care of those wolves and save our strings?
scripts.translation: 冒险者，您意下如何？能帮我赶走那些狼，保住鱼串吗？

scripts.text: Dried fish. They are tied one after the other on a string, so we call them strings for short. But those Desert Wolves are a headache because they constantly finish them off.
scripts.translation: 就是把晒干的鱼一条条串在绳子上，所以简称鱼串。那些沙漠之狼总把鱼串吃光，真让人头疼。

scripts.text: Please take care of those Desert Wolves and save our strings. They're my favorite snack. Catch ten wolves and they won't come near anymore.
scripts.translation: 请赶走那些沙漠之狼，保住我们的鱼串吧。那可是我最喜欢的零食。抓 10 只，它们就不敢再靠近了。

scripts.text: You may come to me when you're done, or you may report to ^4D4DFF[Fisher]^000000 who is drying fish there.
scripts.translation: 完成后可以来找我，也可以去找在那里晒鱼的[渔夫]。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: Do you know what Pub-Oven's signature menu is?
scripts.translation: 您知道酒馆烤箱的招牌菜是什么吗？

scripts.text: No, no. That's the most popular menu. What I mean is... right! Chef's specialty menu is what I meant.
scripts.translation: 不，不，那可是最受欢迎的饮料。我是说...对了，我指的是厨师的招牌菜。

scripts.text: It's the fish cake, there Aren't too many who ask for it. So we don't even have the ingredients in store.
scripts.translation: 就是鱼糕，不过点的人不多，所以店里没有备食材。

scripts.text: So we get the ingredients immediately when there's an order.
scripts.translation: 有人点单时，我们才会马上去采购食材。

scripts.text: Pub-Oven has its own special network where it receives ingredients within ten minutes. So customers don't need to wait infinitely.
scripts.translation: 酒馆烤箱有自己的配送网络，十分钟内就能把食材送到，不会让顾客一直等。

scripts.text: But as you know, there's no such thing as ����never���� in life. Yet, we always make the effort to achieve ����never.����
scripts.translation: 正如您所知，人生没有“永远不可能”这回事。但我们会努力做到“绝不让顾客久等”。

scripts.text: And right now, that effort is being challenged.
scripts.translation: 而现在，这份努力正受到考验。

scripts.text: You must've heard about the cave in Raviol Forest. There are unspeakable things as well as creatures that are delicious food ingredients.
scripts.translation: 您一定听说过罗札纳森林里的洞穴。那里既有难以言喻的怪物，也有美味的食材。

scripts.text: You know the Trans Spores? Their ����mushroom spores���� are an essential ingredient for our fish cake.
scripts.translation: 您知道变形蘑菇吗？它们掉落的“香菇芽孢”是制作鱼糕的必备材料。

scripts.text: But for some reason, they live with the basilisks, but so this is a serious problem for us.
scripts.translation: 不知为何，它们竟和巴希利斯克住在一起，这给我们造成了大麻烦。

scripts.text: We sent someone in a hurry to find some mushroom spores, but nothing. No news at all.
scripts.translation: 我们急忙派人去找香菇芽孢，却一直没有结果，也没有任何消息。

scripts.text: It's been 15 minutes since we sent a message but still no news. This must mean that he's probably sleeping nearby again.
scripts.translation: 发出消息已经 15 分钟了，还是没有回音。他大概又在附近睡着了。

scripts.text: I didn't want to ask that sleepyhead for help, but he was the only person who was available.
scripts.translation: 我本来不想拜托那个瞌睡鬼，可当时只有他有空。

scripts.text: So you want me to get some mushroom spores, right?
scripts.translation: 所以您要我去找些香菇芽孢，对吧？

scripts.text: My friend, you're quick and sensible. Yes, please get some mushroom spores.
scripts.translation: 您真机灵，一下就明白了。没错，请帮我找些香菇芽孢。

scripts.text: On your way, perhaps you can beat down Trans Spore for training purposes. Catch about ten Trans Spores as well.
scripts.translation: 路上也可以顺便打几只变形蘑菇练练手。请再抓大约 10 只变形蘑菇。

scripts.text: You must get used to the job so that I can make you work again!
scripts.translation: 得让您习惯这份工作，以后我才能继续请您帮忙！

scripts.text: How can you force me to say such a thing?! You're so dense! Go, get going!
scripts.translation: 我怎么会把这种话说出口？！您可真迟钝！快去吧！

scripts.text: You may bring them to me when you're done, or you may give them to ^4D4DFF[Sleepy meow]^000000. Also, don't forget to kick his behinds!
scripts.translation: 完成后可以把东西交给我，也可以交给[瞌睡喵]。别忘了踹他几脚！ ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: Our cow...should eat lots of tasty stuff... Please take care of five Leaf Lunatics and five Grass Fabres.
scripts.translation: [厨师]我们的奶牛...该多吃点好吃的...请帮我抓 5 只群叶疯兔和 5 只草地绿棉虫。

scripts.text: You must hurry. We're almost done with the honey we have. Ten wild hornets!
scripts.translation: [厨师]快点，蜂蜜快用完了。抓 10 只狂野蜂兵！

scripts.text: Please help me make some pudding today. Catch ten Sweet Roda Frogs and bring me five sticky webfeet!
scripts.translation: [厨师]今天请帮我做些布丁。抓 10 只甜心罗达蛙，再带回 5 份黏糊蹼！

scripts.text: Please guard my strings. Catch ten Hunter Desert Wolves. That should be enough to keep them away from my strings.
scripts.translation: [厨师]请帮我看好鱼串。抓 10 只猎人沙漠狼，让它们别再靠近鱼串。

scripts.text: Can we make some fish cake today? I beg you. Please don't make me send my customers home empty handed. They came after a long time for fish cakes.
scripts.translation: 今天能做些鱼糕吗？求求您了，别让我让顾客空手而归。他们等了很久才来吃鱼糕。

scripts.text: Please catch ten Trans Spores and bring me five mushroom spores. Hurry!
scripts.translation: 请抓 10 只变形蘑菇，再带回 5 份香菇芽孢。快点！

scripts.text: Now our cows can have lots of tasty grasses. Thank you.
scripts.translation: 现在奶牛们可以尽情吃美味的青草了。谢谢您。

scripts.text: Our cows liked you very much. That's surprising because they're usually very shy.
scripts.translation: 奶牛们很喜欢您，真让人意外，它们平时都很怕生。

scripts.text: So can you do me another favor tomorrow? Oh, no need to answer right away. Get some good rest tonight and come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation: 明天还能再帮我一次吗？不用现在回答，今晚好好休息，明天再来吧。

scripts.text: You took care of those wild hornets safely. Just amazing.
scripts.translation: 您顺利解决了那些狂野蜂兵，真了不起。

scripts.text: So amazing that I want to ask for another favor tomorrow. Florin's been having a lot of difficulties lately.
scripts.translation: 您做得太好了，明天我还想再请您帮个忙。弗洛林最近遇上不少麻烦。

scripts.text: Please help me make some pudding today. Catch ten Sweet Roda Frogs and bring me five sticky webfeet!
scripts.translation: 今天请帮我做些布丁。抓 10 只甜心罗达蛙，再带回 5 份黏糊蹼！

scripts.text: Oh, thank you! You saved me! I wish you can get a taste of the pudding made with this, but I'm so busy at the moment.
scripts.translation: 太谢谢您了，您救了我一命！真希望能请您尝尝用这些做的布丁，可我现在实在忙不过来。

scripts.text: By the way, we're going to see each other again tomorrow, right?
scripts.translation: 对了，明天我们还会见面吧？

scripts.text: Adventurer, I heard about your feats. Thanks to you, my strings are safe.
scripts.translation: 冒险者，我听说了您的英勇事迹。多亏了您，我的鱼串保住了。

scripts.text: I must repay you for saving my strings. Thank you so much.
scripts.translation: 您救了我的鱼串，我一定要好好报答您。真的非常感谢。

scripts.text: And can you help me again tomorrow? I want to entrust my strings with someone reliable.
scripts.translation: 明天还能再帮我一次吗？我想把鱼串交给可靠的人看管。

scripts.text: Can we make some fish cake today? I beg you. Please don't make me send my customers home empty handed. They came after a long time for fish cakes.
scripts.translation: 今天能做些鱼糕吗？求求您了，别让我让顾客空手而归。他们等了很久才来吃鱼糕。

scripts.text: Please catch ten Trans Spores and bring me five mushroom spores. Hurry!
scripts.translation: 请抓 10 只变形蘑菇，再带回 5 份香菇芽孢。快点！

scripts.text: Five mushroom spores. Perfect. It was wise to ask an adventurer for help.
scripts.translation: 五份香菇芽孢，正好。找冒险者帮忙果然没错。

scripts.text: We almost lost all our customers who wanted fish cake. Thanks a lot!
scripts.translation: 差点就让所有想吃鱼糕的顾客失望了。太感谢您了！

scripts.text: What, you're here already to help?
scripts.translation: 咦，您这么快就来帮忙了？

scripts.text: It's too early right now. Pushing won't solve anything.
Have a nice rest and come back again tomorrow.
You here? Right when I needed some help.
scripts.translation: 您来啦？正好我需要帮忙。

scripts.text: Will you help today as well?
I'm busy right now. I'll do it later.
scripts.translation: 我现在没空，之后再做吧。

scripts.text: Please guard the grasses from Grass Fabre and Leaf Lunatic. They are food for our cows.
scripts.translation: 请保护草地，别让草地绿棉虫和群叶疯兔吃光牧草。那是奶牛的食物。

scripts.text: Grass Fabre and Leaf Lunatic, five each. That should scare the rest nearby and keep them at bay.
scripts.translation: 草地绿棉虫和群叶疯兔各抓 5 只，应该就能吓退附近其他的魔物。

scripts.text: Once you cross the south bridge, you'll see crossroads. Take the road right underneath and go straight to the Raviol Plains where the shepherd is.
scripts.translation: 过了南桥就能看到十字路口。沿着正下方的路一直走，就能到牧羊人所在的罗札纳平原。

scripts.text: You may come to me after catching all of them, or you can talk to the <NAVI>^4D4DFF[shepherd]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild01,353,370,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation: 抓完后可以来找我，也可以去找那边的<NAVI>[牧羊人]<INFO>lasa_fild01,353,370,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: Pay is same anywhere. You ready?
scripts.translation: 哪里给的报酬都一样。您准备好了吗？

scripts.text: A new day has just begun, and so will the wild hornets with their activities.
scripts.translation: 新的一天开始了，狂野蜂兵也要开始活动了。

scripts.text: Please go to Raviol Forest and catch ten wild hornets.
scripts.translation: 请去罗札纳森林消灭 10 只狂野蜂兵。

scripts.text: You may come to me when you're done, or you may report to <NAVI>^4D4DFF[Florin]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,102,372,000,1,</INFO></NAVI> who is collecting honey there.
scripts.translation: 完成后可以来找我，也可以向在那里采蜜的<NAVI>[弗洛林]<INFO>lasa_fild02,102,372,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>汇报。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: You should go to Ravioli Forest. Please bring five sticky webfeet.
scripts.translation: 请去罗比奥森林，带回 5 份黏糊蹼。

scripts.text: While you're there, catch ten Sweet Roda Frogs. Their population has increased too much recently.
scripts.translation: 顺便抓 10 只甜心罗达蛙吧。最近它们的数量增加太多了。

scripts.text: You may bring sticky webfeet to me if you get them, or you may take them to <NAVI>^4D4DFF[Prok]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,177,241,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>. He agreed to bring them here anyway.
scripts.translation: 拿到黏糊蹼后可以交给我，也可以交给<NAVI>[普罗克]<INFO>lasa_fild02,177,241,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>。他答应会帮忙带过来。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: Listen carefully, because this is the most important request.
scripts.translation: 请仔细听，这件事最重要。

scripts.text: Please keep the Hunter Desert Wolves away from my strings. Catch ten wolves and they won't go after my strings anymore.
scripts.translation: 请别让猎人沙漠狼靠近我的鱼串。抓 10 只，它们就不会再来捣乱了。

scripts.text: You may come to me when you're done, or you may report to <NAVI>^4D4DFF[Fisher]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,326,170,000,1,</INFO></NAVI> who is drying fish in Raviol Forest.
scripts.translation: 完成后可以来找我，也可以向在罗比奥森林晒鱼的<NAVI>[渔夫]<INFO>lasa_fild02,326,170,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>汇报。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: Good. An order for fish cake just came in.
scripts.translation: 太好了，刚好有顾客点了鱼糕。

scripts.text: We didn't get orders for this menu that often, so It's strange that there's so many requests. Did the word spread finally that It's good?
scripts.translation: 平时很少有人点这道菜，今天却收到这么多订单，真奇怪。难道大家终于知道它很好吃了？

scripts.text: Anyhow, we're in a hurry down to the minute and seconds but that sleepyhead is probably sleeping again. So I hope that you, adventurer, can help us again.
scripts.translation: 总之，我们分秒必争，可那个瞌睡鬼大概又睡着了。冒险者，拜托您再帮我们一次。

scripts.text: Please bring five mushroom spores and catch ten Trans Spores.
scripts.translation: 请带回 5 份香菇芽孢，并抓 10 只变形蘑菇。

scripts.text: You may come to me when you're done, or you may report to <NAVI>^4D4DFF[Sleepy meow]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,331,251,000,1,</INFO></NAVI> who is dozing off in the forest.
scripts.translation: 完成后可以来找我，也可以向在森林里打瞌睡的<NAVI>[瞌睡喵]<INFO>lasa_fild02,331,251,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>汇报。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: Today won't be boring? I wonder who'll visit me today. Who is it?
scripts.translation: 今天应该不会无聊吧？不知道今天会有谁来找我呢？是谁呀？

scripts.text: Ah! You're here. Come in. This is a magical place of miraculous elderly lady. It's a shrine.
scripts.translation: 啊，您来了。请进。这是奇迹老奶奶施展魔法的地方，是一座神龛。

scripts.text: Elderly lady? She doesn't look like one. Like a very... young doram.
scripts.translation: 老奶奶？她看起来不像啊。倒像是...一位年轻的多兰。

scripts.text: Grandma will be sad to hear that. This world is full of things that exist but cannot be seen. For instance, Let's talk about your case.
scripts.translation: 老奶奶听到这话会伤心的。这个世界上有很多看不见却真实存在的事物。就拿您来说吧...

scripts.text: Before the discovery of the new world, we dorams thought that Lasagna was the end of the world. The new world was invisible and so were the countless people who lived there.
scripts.translation: 发现新世界之前，我们多兰一直以为罗札纳就是世界的尽头。新世界看不见，生活在那里的无数人也看不见。

scripts.text: But didn't the new world and human really exist?
scripts.translation: 可是，新世界和人类不都是真实存在的吗？
那么，您来这里有什么事？

scripts.text: There is a sufferer and I'm here for that person.
scripts.translation: 有个人正在受苦，我是为他来的。

scripts.text: What pain is that? If grandma and I can take care of it, we will. One shouldn't turn away from a sufferer.
scripts.translation: 他在受什么苦？如果我和老奶奶能帮上忙，一定会尽力。不能对受苦的人袖手旁观。

scripts.text: Well, he's in denial but I think he's been possessed by an evil spirit. He opened a sealed jar on an uninhabited island.
scripts.translation: 他还不肯承认，不过我觉得他被恶灵附身了。他在一座无人岛上打开了一个封印罐。

scripts.text: Oh my. Who would've thought that there would be another idiot like the ^0000cdboatswain of Con-Chliina^000000.
scripts.translation: 天哪！谁会想到还有另一个像康奇利娜号的水手长那样的笨蛋。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Uh, that boatswain is the person who had asked for my help.
scripts.translation: 呃，那位水手长就是请我来帮忙的人。

scripts.text: Indeed, who else would do such an idiotic thing? I can't help him, so please leave.
scripts.translation: 可不是嘛，除了他还有谁会做这种蠢事？我帮不了他，请回吧。

scripts.text: Is there really no way to help him?
Those evil spirits usually try to take over the host by absorbing his energy and leave when he dies. For some reason, they can't take over the host's body.
scripts.translation: 那些恶灵通常会吸取宿主的能量，等宿主死后再离开。不知为何，它们无法完全占据宿主的身体。

scripts.text: So they move on to another person nearby. That's why when the host dies, it is specially sealed in a jar by a shaman and discarded in a place where no one can find it.
scripts.translation: 所以它们会转移到附近的其他人身上。宿主死后，萨满会把恶灵封进罐子，再将罐子丢到无人能找到的地方。

scripts.text: But if someone opens the jar, those evil spirits cling onto that idiot and repeat the same process. there's no way to detach them until the host dies. In other words, there's no solution that would make the boatswain happy.
scripts.translation: 可一旦有人打开罐子，恶灵就会附到那个笨蛋身上，重复同样的过程。宿主死前无法驱除恶灵。也就是说，水手长的问题无解。

scripts.text: When I told him that ��a noble person from a new place solves the problem,�� I meant that the problem will move onto ^0000cda new person^000000. Seems like he misunderstood me and sent you.
scripts.translation: 我告诉他“来自新地方的高贵之人会解决问题”时，意思是恶灵会转移到一个新宿主身上。看来他误会了我的意思，才把您派来。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I opened the jar. It was an unfortunate accident.
scripts.translation: 是我打开了罐子。那只是一次意外。

scripts.text: I-I don't mean that I dislike grandma. Yes, yes. I'll be careful.
scripts.translation: 我...我不是不喜欢老奶奶。我知道了，我会小心的。

scripts.text: Anyway, the boatswain has no choice. Live rest of his life, tormented, or become a shaman cat and live somewhat comfortably. Life of a shaman cat Isn't so bad.
scripts.translation: 总之，水手长只有两种选择：带着痛苦度过余生，或成为萨满喵，过上稍微安稳些的日子。萨满喵的生活其实不差。

scripts.text: Those with much knowledge have a bit more options.
scripts.translation: 知识越丰富，能选的路也越多。

scripts.text: If he chooses not to become a shaman meow, then he must live every day ^0000cddependent on a new talisman^000000. But if he chooses to become a shaman meow, then tell him to come see me.
scripts.translation: 如果他不想成为萨满喵，就只能每天依靠新的护符。若他决定成为萨满喵，就让他来找我。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: But becoming a shaman meow will be better in many ways. Evil spirits will wear him down more and more to take over his body.
scripts.translation: 不过，成为萨满喵会更好。恶灵会不断削弱他的身体，伺机夺取控制权。

scripts.text: I heard that the boatswain had visited previous shaman meow with Captain Gamberry in the past. But he stormed out in the middle of explanation and never came back.
scripts.translation: 听说水手长以前和甘贝里船长一起来拜访过前任萨满喵。可他听到一半就气冲冲地离开，再也没回来。

scripts.text: He should be counting his days by now after suffering so much.
scripts.translation: 他受了这么多折磨，现在大概已经在数着剩下的日子了。

scripts.text: Not really. He seemed really energetic.
scripts.translation: 倒也没有。他看起来精力很充沛。

scripts.text: I guess not everyone has what it takes to become the boatswain of Con-Chliina. How did he survive all this time?
scripts.translation: 看来不是谁都能当康奇利娜号的水手长。他到底是怎么撑到现在的？

scripts.text: Well... He seems to be living off on one superstition to another. Like dolls and salts.
scripts.translation: 嗯...他好像靠着一个又一个迷信撑过来，比如布偶和盐。

scripts.text: Oh my, he really is an idiot. Had he come to me earlier, I would have told him about a less painful path.
scripts.translation: 天哪，他真是个笨蛋。要是早点来找我，我本可以告诉他一条没那么痛苦的路。

scripts.text: At any rate, if he must depend on a new talisman every day, what's today's talisman? I'm sure the boatswain needs some time to think things over, so until then, he'll need talisman.
scripts.translation: 总之，如果他每天都得靠新护符，那今天需要什么护符？水手长应该还要时间考虑，在那之前也得有护符保平安。

scripts.text: Oh, that? Really? Ooh, That's awful... Seriously, how would that...ugh.
scripts.translation: 哦，那个？真的吗？噢...这也太糟了吧...真不知道该怎么说...

scripts.text: Today's talisman is ^0000cd20 basils and 5 basil locks^000000. Tie them firmly and carry them around. Then he'll be safe today.
scripts.translation: 今天的护符是20 个罗勒和 5 个罗勒锁。把它们牢牢系在身上，今天就能平安无事。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: They both are obtained from those dirty ^0000cdbasilisks^000000. Basilisks received energy from Lord Imuk that lived over 2,000 years, so evil spirits can't stand even being near a piece of them.
scripts.translation: 这两样东西都能从那些脏兮兮的蛇怪身上取得。蛇怪吸收了两千多年前伊穆克大人的力量，恶灵连靠近它们的碎片都受不了。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: But they really are way too filthy. I bet the boatswain will ask you for a favor since he won't want to catch one with his own hands.
scripts.translation: 不过它们实在太脏了。我敢说水手长会来找您帮忙，因为他肯定不想亲手去抓。

scripts.text: Make sure you deliver my message to the boatswain. And today's talisman is 20 basils and 5 basil locks.
scripts.translation: 记得把我的话转告水手长。今天的护符是 20 个罗勒和 5 个罗勒锁。

scripts.text: Today's talisman is ^0000cd5 basil locks and 1 holy water^000000. In the new world, the holy water drives the evil spirits away. It must've worked when the boatswain came in contact with the people of the new world.
scripts.translation: 今天的护符是5 个罗勒锁和 1 瓶圣水。圣水能驱逐新世界的恶灵，水手长接触新世界的人时，应该就是圣水起了作用。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Today's talisman is ^0000cd20 basil locks^000000. You'll get your hands very dirty today. I'm sorry. But grandma has spoken so That's the bottom line.
scripts.translation: 今天的护符是20 个罗勒锁。您今天得把手弄得很脏，抱歉。不过这是老奶奶的吩咐，没得商量。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: That thing clinging onto the boatswain is also a doram. It especially hates basil locks. That is the reason why basil locks are used.
scripts.translation: 附在水手长身上的东西也是多兰，尤其讨厌罗勒锁。所以护符里才要用罗勒锁。

scripts.text: Today's talisman is ^0000cd20 basils and 5 basil locks^000000. Same as the first. The most basic is the most useful.
scripts.translation: 今天的护符是20 个罗勒和 5 个罗勒锁，和第一次一样。最基础的往往最管用。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I pray for your peace and safety. Tell the boatswain to come back anytime he changes his mind.
scripts.translation: 愿您平安顺遂。告诉水手长，想通之后随时可以回来找我。

scripts.text: The boatswain must've sent you. I'll tell you about the talisman that'll help you get through today safely.
scripts.translation: 是水手长派您来的吧？我告诉您今天用什么护符才能平安度过。

scripts.text: Where... yes, yeah... today is that one? Got it.

scripts.text: You want to know the future? The past? If you know where you're standing, then you can see the past, future, everything.
scripts.translation: 想知道未来？还是过去？只要知道自己身处何处，就能看见过去、未来，乃至一切。

scripts.text: If you need to curse someone, break a curse, or need a bit of luck, then come see me.
scripts.translation: 想诅咒别人、解除诅咒，或是求点好运，都可以来找我。

scripts.text: The weather is good today, isn't it?
What can I do for you?
In Lasagna, a fresh sea breeze always tickle your whiskers.
scripts.translation: 在罗札纳，清新的海风总会拂过您的胡须。

scripts.text: And thanks to this moist air, our cheese ripen deliciously.
scripts.translation: 湿润的空气也让我们的奶酪熟成得格外香醇。

scripts.text: Oh! You haven't met our chief yet?
scripts.translation: 咦！您还没见过我们的首领吗？

scripts.text: I think it'd be best for you to see the chief first.
scripts.translation: ..我觉得您最好先去见见首领。

scripts.text: He should be at the Adventurers' Club around now...
scripts.translation: 他这会儿应该在冒险者俱乐

scripts.text: The Adventurers' Club is to the east from here, so it shouldn't be difficult to find.
scripts.translation: 部...俱乐部就在这里东边，不难找到。

scripts.text: The Vigilante Corp not only maintain public order in the town, but also play the main role in running the town.
scripts.translation: 义警团不仅维护城镇治安，也负责城镇的主要事务。也许我

scripts.text: Maybe our chief should be called the mayor instead.
scripts.translation: 们的首领更该被称作市长。

scripts.text: Lasagna is a port town located at the end of the Far-Star continent.
scripts.translation: 罗札纳是法尔斯塔尔大陆尽头的一座港口城镇。

scripts.text: it's a small but a thriving town thanks to the efforts of Chief Peperoncino, Captain Gamberi, and Captain Tomatomas!
scripts.translation: 多亏首领佩佩龙奇诺、甘贝里船长和托马斯船长的努力，这座小城才如此繁荣！

scripts.text: He is Chief Peperoncino, the boss of the Vigilante Corp!
scripts.translation: 他就是佩佩龙奇诺首领，义警团的头儿！

scripts.text: If you need anything, just say the word!
I'll help you with what I can!
Let me tell you something about our Vigilante Corp!
scripts.translation: 我来给你讲讲我们义警公司的事！可以说

scripts.text: You can say that we play a key role in this town!
scripts.translation: ，我们在这座城镇里发挥着重要作用！

scripts.text: All the young Doram want to join us too!
scripts.translation: 所有年轻的多兰都想加入我们！

scripts.text: The Vigilante haven't been around for long, but Lasagna was a failing town before we showed up and it's thanks to us that the town is thriving now!
scripts.translation: 义警公司成立的时间不长，但在我们出现之前，罗札纳还很衰败。多亏了我们，这座城镇如今才繁荣起来！

scripts.text: When I was a kid, it was so... so tough around here...
scripts.translation: 我小时候，这里...这里的日子可真难熬...

scripts.text: There were none of these savory and comfy streets of cheese... Instead, we had mushy anchovy guts... everywhere you go...
scripts.translation: 那时候可没有这些美味又舒适的奶酪街道...到处都是软烂的鳀鱼内脏...走到哪儿都是...

scripts.text: And don't talk about the smell...
Anyway! Enough of the depressing stuff!
scripts.translation: 总之！别再说这些丧气话了！

scripts.text: The future looked bleak for Lasagna, but they discussed and decided that Chief Peperoncino would take charge of the Vigilante to protect the town, while the captains Gamberi and Tomatomas lead the merchant band.
scripts.translation: 罗札纳的未来曾一度黯淡无光。经过商议，大家决定由首领佩佩龙奇诺率领义警保护城镇，船长甘贝里和船长番茄马斯则负责带领商队。

scripts.text: Well... I don't know much about the merchant band!
But I heard that it was started with the little seed money pooled by the three leaders, and now it has grown into a huge organization that makes most of this town's income.
scripts.translation: 不过听说，最初是三位领袖凑了点启动资金，如今已经发展成庞大的组织，几乎撑起了这座城镇的大部分收入。

scripts.text: In the beginning, they only had a single trading ship that leaked and was half sinking.
scripts.translation: 他们起初只有一艘漏水、快要沉没的贸易船。

scripts.text: But now, they have a massive fleet!
scripts.translation: 可现在，他们已经拥有一支庞大的舰队！

scripts.text: A few years ago, Captain Tomatomas embarked on a journey to discover a new trading route, but he went missing when his ship was caught up in a storm.
scripts.translation: 几年前，船长番茄马斯为了开辟新的贸易航线而出航，却在途中遭遇风暴，从此失踪。

scripts.text: Even our chief and Captain Gamberi had lost their calm.
scripts.translation: 就连首领和船长甘贝里也乱了方寸

scripts.text: They dropped everything and put all their efforts into finding Captain Tomatomas.
scripts.translation: 。他们放下手头所有事情，全力寻找船长番茄马斯。

scripts.text: Their efforts finally paid off, as Captain Tomatomas was recently found on an island called Malangdo off the coast of Midgard.
scripts.translation: ...他们的努力终于有了回报。最近，船长番茄马斯在米德加尔特海岸外一座名叫绵绵岛的岛上被找到了。

scripts.text: On top of that, they also discovered a new sea route to the continent of Midgard!
scripts.translation: 除此之外，他们还发现了一条通往米德加尔特大陆的新航线！

scripts.text: Ask about reaching the continent of Midgard.
scripts.translation: 询问如何前往米德加尔特大陆。

scripts.text: From here, the Con-Chliina is the only ship that can reach Midgard. So the only people who can board the ship are the Con-Chliina's sailors and members of the Vigilante Corp.
scripts.translation: 从这里出发，只有康奇利娜号能抵达米德加尔特。所以，只有康奇利娜号的水手和义警成员才能登船。

scripts.text: Because of that, even people from other towns are flooding in to join the Vigilante and because of that, we had to turn a sentry post in the southern part of the Ravioli Plain into a waiting area.
scripts.translation: 因此，连其他城镇的人也纷纷赶来加入义警。我们只好把罗比奥平原南边的哨站改成等候区。

scripts.text: The Doram are nothing if not curious!
scripts.translation: 多兰族可是出了名的好奇！

scripts.translation: 加入义警需要首领批准，你最好去问问他。

With the discovery of the new sea route, we've had a sudden influx of foreigners visiting our town...
scripts.translation: 吗？新航线开通后，最近来镇上的外地人突然多了起来...

scripts.text: In any case, please enjoy your stay and don't cause any trouble.
scripts.translation: ..总之，祝你在这里玩得愉快，别惹麻烦。

scripts.text: If you need anything, talk to Olio here.
scripts.translation: 有事就找这里的奥利奥。

scripts.translation: 目前只要通过一个简单的测试，就能加入义警，参加“米德加尔特远征”。

scripts.text: But I'm a bit busy with urgent matters to give you the test now, so perhaps later...
scripts.translation: 不过我现在正忙着处理急事，没法马上给你测试...也许晚些时候再说。

scripts.text: There was Jindou's intervention, but I didn't think you'd complete the first test so easily...

scripts.translation: 塔莉还带来了这些布料，说是剩下不少。

scripts.translation: 结束。对于满怀冒险热情的年轻人，我不想太过挑剔，这样就够了。

scripts.translation: 拿着这张乘船证去镇北的港口，他们就会让你上船。

scripts.text: Hurry over to the port now.

scripts.translation: ..年轻时，我也想过要成为了不起的人物

scripts.text: But there were too many things here that I had to protect...

scripts.translation: 光瞪着他，可没法让他开口。

scripts.text: You need a 'solution' that suits the likes of him.
scripts.translation: 你得用适合对付这种家伙的“办法”。

scripts.text: Even if that requires a bit of force.
scripts.translation: 必要时，也可以稍微动点武力。

scripts.translation: 试。你要是插手了，还能算测试吗？

scripts.text: How can someone who's never faced a Basilisk before pass that test?
scripts.translation: 伙。一个从没对付过蛇怪的人，怎么可能通过那项测试？

scripts.text: We aren't as laid-back as you people.
scripts.translation: 我们可不像你们那么悠闲。

scripts.text: I guess there's no helping it.
Head out east from the town to the Ravioli Forest, and keeping going 'east' until you find huge thorny vines.
scripts.translation: 从镇上往东走，进入罗比奥森林后继续向“东”走，直到找到巨大的荆棘藤蔓。

scripts.text: Bring back 5 branches of those thorny vines.
We'll continue after you get back.
scripts.translation: 等你回来后我们再继续。

scripts.text: You think I'd give in to that?
scripts.translation: 你以为我会因此屈服吗？

scripts.text: I know nothing! I won't tell you that our king commanded it!
scripts.translation: 我什么都不知道！我才不会告诉你们，是我们国王下令这么做的！

scripts.text: I'll never tell you that what we're after isn't Lasagna but that yellow thing living inside the cave!!!
scripts.translation: 我才不会告诉你们，我们要找的不是罗札纳，而是洞穴里住着的那个黄色家伙！！！

scripts.text: Jindou, I'll leave the rest to you.
Well, I don't think we can get anything more out of him, but I'll let you know if there's something new.
scripts.translation: 我想也问不出更多了。有新消息的话，我会通知你。

scripts.text: Alright, let's go outside and discuss your next test.
scripts.translation: 好了，我们到外面谈谈你的下一项测试。

scripts.text: Oh, wait! You were a big help this time, so I'll give you this as a token of my gratitude.
scripts.translation: 等等！这次你帮了大忙，我把这个送给你，聊表谢意。
。[长长的狐尾草]远程物理攻击 +5%，MHP + 200。

Right. If we use this, he won't be able to keep his mouth shut for much longer!
scripts.translation: 没错。用上这个，他很快就会忍不住开口！

scripts.text: Head out east from the town to the 'Ravioli Forest', and keeping going 'east' until you find huge thorny vines.
scripts.translation: 从镇上往东走，进入“罗比奥森林”，再继续向“东”走，直到找到巨大的荆棘藤蔓。

scripts.text: Bring back 5 branches of those thorny vines.
We'll continue after you get back.
scripts.translation: 等你回来后我们再继续。

scripts.translation: 没错。用上这个，他很快就会忍不住开口！

scripts.text: I'm not sure if you know, but this is a Basilisk, a race that lives not very far from here.
scripts.translation: 你可能不知道，这是一只蛇怪。蛇怪是生活在这附近的种族。

scripts.text: we've gotten along pretty well, but recently, they've started causing trouble around Lasagna.
scripts.translation: 我们一直相处得不错，但最近他们开始在罗札纳附近闹事。

scripts.text: This one in particular even came into the town and wreaked havoc yesterday. We had to detain him, but he wouldn't talk why he did it.
scripts.translation: 尤其是这家伙，昨天竟闯进镇上大闹一场。我们只好把他扣下来，可他就是不肯说原因。

scripts.text: Since it's come to this, We'll use what force necessary to loosen his tongue...
scripts.translation: 事到如今，只能用点必要的手段让他开口了...

scripts.text: I guess there's no helping it.
Go have a talk with Jindou.

scripts.translation: 您的物品栏里物品太多。

- You have obtained enough Hard Thorny Vines.
scripts.translation: - 已收集到足够的坚硬荆棘藤蔓。

scripts.text: - You might hurt yourself if you touch it.
scripts.translation: - 摸它可能会受伤。小心一

scripts.text: I've got to finish this quickly and go see him at the port!
scripts.translation: 得赶紧做完这个，然后去港口见他！哇

scripts.text: Oh! Did the chief send you?
You've been to the Ravioli Forest, right?
scripts.translation: 你去过罗比奥森林吧？就

scripts.text: Yeah, that forest to the east of here.
scripts.translation: 是这边东面的那片森林。

scripts.text: Go and teach Sweet Roda Frogs over there a lesson, and bring 'Luxurious Cloth' to me.
scripts.translation: 去教训一下那里的甜心罗达蛙，再给我带些“高级布条”来。

scripts.text: Let me see... Hum hum... Hmm...

scripts.text: Yeah, that forest to the east of here.
scripts.translation: 是这边东面的那片森林。

scripts.translation: 去教训一下那里的甜心罗达蛙，再给我带些“高级布条”来。

scripts.text: Let me see... Hum hum... Hmm...
Why do you keep looking at me?
scripts.translation: 你为什么一直盯着我看？

scripts.text: I'm going to make a bow tie with these.
scripts.translation: 我要用这些做个领结。这

scripts.text: Well, it's not particularly important, but it's like the symbols of the Vigilante Corp...
scripts.translation: 不是什么特别重要的东西，不过它算是义警团的标志...

scripts.text: When the bow tie is made, It'll be embroidered with your name and hung on the wall of the Vigilante office.
scripts.translation: 领结做好后，我会在上面绣上你的名字，再挂到义警办公室的墙上。

scripts.text: it's like a register of Vigilante members.
scripts.translation: 这就像义警成员名册一样。

scripts.text: It takes a while to embroider the name.
I'll take it to the chief when it's finished, so you can go first.
scripts.translation: 时间。做好后我会拿给首领，你先走吧。

scripts.text: It takes a while to embroider the name.
I'll take it to the chief when it's finished, so you can go first.
scripts.translation: 做好后我会拿给首领，你先走吧。

scripts.text: It looks a lot and large. How about cutting down some?
scripts.translation: 看起来数量不少、个头也大。要不要砍掉一些？

scripts.text: Aren't you being trained in the vigilante corps? How can you get on the ship when you are not good enough to finish the training? Go back and finish your training!
scripts.translation: 你不是在义警团接受训练吗？训练都没完成，怎么能上船？回去完成训练！

scripts.text: don't you have the ^0000cdBoarding Permission^000000? You need it to get on the ship! Hold yourself together! Go back and get one!
scripts.translation: 你没有登船许可吗？上船需要这个！打起精神来，回去拿一张！ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Are you going to get on the ship?
You have a business in the ship.
Get on now. If it is your first time, meet the purser and listen to the boarding instructions.
scripts.translation: 现在上船吧。第一次航行的话，去找事务长听听登船须知。

scripts.text: Hey, adventurer! Is it your first voyage?
scripts.translation: 嘿，冒险者！这是你第一次航行吗？

scripts.text: Well, don't bring dishonor to the name of Doram, OK? However, since you have been trained here, you will be able to play your part wherever you are. Good luck.
scripts.translation: 好吧，别给多兰丢脸啊！不过，你既然在这里受过训练，无论到哪里都能派上用场。祝你好运。

scripts.text: Oh, I have a favor to ask you. Would you bring it to the ^0000cdSous Chef^000000. Can you do this for me? You will keep sailing on this ship from time to time, you know, right?
scripts.translation: 对了，有件事想拜托你。可以把这个带给副厨师长吗？你以后也会时常搭这艘船吧？ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Well, well. You seem to know how things work around here. You can bring it to the Sous Chef. However, the Sous Chef is kind of eccentric. You have to say something when you hand over things to him.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，看来你很懂这里的规矩嘛。把东西带给副厨师长就行。不过他有点古怪，交东西时记得说句话。

scripts.text: You should toss this to him, saying ��^0000cd[Here comes the newbie!]^000000 He believes that a Doram should say this on his or her first voyage for good luck. Anyways, he seems to think that it is the right way to do.
scripts.translation: 把这个递给他时，要说“新手来了！”。他觉得多兰第一次航行时说这句话能带来好运。总之，他认定这样做才对。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: You know what I mean, right?
You seem to understand it so well. I like it. What is your name, by the way? Haha...
scripts.translation: 你还挺上道的，我喜欢。对了，你叫什么名字？哈哈...

scripts.text: I see. Let's say hi when we run into each other. Well, make sure to follow my instructions when you hand it over to the Sous Chef, OK?
scripts.translation: 知道了。下次碰面记得打招呼。把东西交给副厨师长时，记得照我说的做啊。

scripts.text: If, there's anything you want to know, don't hesitate to come and see me. And when you get on, make sure to say hi to the ^0000cdpurser^000000.
scripts.translation: 有不明白的事就来找我。上船后也记得跟事务长打声招呼。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Are you back already? What about your mission?
scripts.translation: 这么快就回来了？任务办得怎么样？

scripts.text: Come back after finishing the mission!
Just in time. Since the fog is gone, we can set off soon.
scripts.translation: 来得正好。雾已经散了，我们很快就能出发。

scripts.text: Whoa, the punk never dies and returns.
scripts.translation: 哟，那个家伙居然没死，又回来了。

scripts.text: No. don't you know? It is a lyric from this latest hit. Oh, please, don't act like you are from some rural town. What would they think of us all? Anyways, what about the thing you are supposed to bring? Do you have it?
scripts.translation: 不是。你不知道吗？这是最近的热门歌曲里的歌词。拜托，别装得像个乡下人似的，别人会怎么看我们？对了，你要带的东西呢？带来了吗？

scripts.text: Not yet. How many did you ask?
How stupid... I told you to bring ^0000cd3^000000. I said 3! You can get them from the ^0000cdBasilisks^000000. How many times I have to tell you that? I think I said it about 100 times!
scripts.translation: 真笨...我让你带3个。就是3个！去找蛇怪拿。到底要我说多少遍？我都说了差不多100遍了！ ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: You wouldn't get on the ship until you bring it to me!
scripts.translation: 不把东西带给我，你就别想上船！
东西在这里。蛇怪的东西。

scripts.text: Ha. You are pretty good. How about retiring from the adventures and becoming an apprentice of mine? I'll be nice.
scripts.translation: 哈，你挺能干嘛。不如别当冒险者了，来做我的学徒？我会好好待你的。

scripts.text: I have to say no. I don't want to spend the eternity as a sailor boy.
scripts.translation: 我只能拒绝了。我可不想一辈子都当水手。

scripts.text: What? What did you say? A sailor boy? Hey! I am not just a sailor boy, but an invaluable asset who takes care of miscellaneous businesses of Con-Chliina! This ship cannot sail without me!
scripts.translation: 什么？你说什么？水手？喂！我可不只是个水手，我还负责康奇利纳号上各种杂事，是不可或缺的人物！没有我，这艘船根本开不了！

scripts.text: Oh, I see. Please excuse me.
Oh, I see. I am sorry.
Well, thanks anyway. I didn't really expect you to bring it for me. I have nothing else to offer you. Since there is a dangerous world out there, take this.
scripts.translation: 总之还是谢了。我本来也没指望你真会帮我带。没什么好送你的，不过外面的世界很危险，拿着这个吧。

scripts.text: You know, the anchovy from Lasagna is the best. You cannot buy this with money out there. Take it when I offer it to you. And give me all the Basilrocks you have.
scripts.translation: 你知道吧，罗札纳的鳀鱼最好吃了。在外面可买不到。既然我都给你了，就收下吧。把你身上所有的巴西洛克都给我。

scripts.text: Whoa, the punk never dies and returns.
scripts.translation: 哟，那个家伙居然没死，又回来了。

scripts.text: No. don't you know? It is a lyric from this latest hit. Oh, please, don't act like you are from some rural town. What would they think of us all?
scripts.translation: 不是。你不知道吗？这是最近的热门歌曲里的歌词。拜托，别装得像个乡下人似的，别人会怎么看我们？

scripts.text: Are you going to get on the ^0000cdship^000000?
Are you going to get on the ^0000cdship^000000?
You are the punk. Are you getting on the ship?
Or are you heading to ^0000cdIzlude^000000 or ^0000cdMalangdo^000000 in the new continent?
scripts.translation: 还是要去新大陆的依斯鲁得岛或绵绵岛？无论去哪儿 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Wherever you go, it costs ^0000cd{0} Zeny^000000.
You don't have enough money. Check again.
scripts.translation: 你的钱不够，再确认一下。

scripts.text: You don't have enough money. Check again.
scripts.translation: 你的钱不够，再确认一下。

scripts.text: Hey, you. Come this way. Have you really thrown it to the Sous Chef because I told you so?
scripts.translation: 嘿，你，过来。你真的照我说的，把东西扔给副厨师长了吗？

scripts.text: I have only done what you told me to do.

Ha! How could you? You do everything what I say, really? What a dimwit! Do you wear the beard for fashion, you moron? Do you know what kind of trouble I got into because of you? I was scolded because of you!
scripts.translation: 哈！你怎么能这么做？我说什么你都照办啊？真是个笨蛋！你留胡子是为了好看吗，蠢货？你知道我因为你惹上多少麻烦吗？我都被骂了！

scripts.text: Cut it out. Well, since you seem sorry, I'll forgive you if you bring a ^0000cdBasilrock^000000. I am quite a generous man.
scripts.translation: 够了。看你似乎挺后悔的，带一个巴西洛克来，我就原谅你。我可是很宽宏大量的。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Do you really want to sign yourself up for the worst voyage of your life?
scripts.translation: 你真想踏上人生中最糟糕的航程吗？

scripts.text: No one knows what it is. However, all sailors have it. You should really stop asking. Go get it now. I give 10 seconds.
scripts.translation: 没人知道那是什么。不过每个水手都有。别问了，赶紧去拿，我给你10秒。

scripts.text: Everyone should know where to get it in order to carry it. Where can I get it?
scripts.translation: 既然大家都带着它，肯定知道去哪儿找吧？我该去哪儿拿？

scripts.text: When you get out of the village, there is a cave at the right end of the field in which unpleasant snakes called the ^0000cdBasilisks^000000 live. You can get it from them.
scripts.translation: 出村后，田野最右边有个洞穴，里面住着叫巴西利斯克的讨厌蛇类。去找它们拿。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Since I am on my way there, I'll get some for you if I can. However, my mission comes first. You don't expect for me to process it before the mission the captain has given me, do you?
scripts.translation: 我正好要去那边，有机会的话会帮你带一些。不过我得先完成自己的任务。你不会以为我会先办你的事，再去做船长交代的任务吧？

scripts.text: Well... I don't mean... Hum... Well 10 seconds has passed. Bring me ^0000cd3 Basilrocks^000000, no less. Bring them without anyone knowing. I will make you regret if you tell anyone.
scripts.translation: 嗯...我不是那个意思...咳...好了，10秒到了。给我带3个巴西洛克，一个都不能少。偷偷带来，敢告诉别人我就让你后悔。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Welcome on board. Welcome to ^0000cdCon-Chliina^000000. We will send you safely to your destination. However, we cannot sail off right at this moment.
scripts.translation: 欢迎登船，欢迎来到康奇利纳号。我们会安全送您抵达目的地。不过现在还不能起航。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Right. You cannot see anything. There is this ^0000cdthick fog^000000. I wonder if we would be able to set off now.
scripts.translation: 没错，什么也看不见。外面有浓雾，真不知道现在能不能起航。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: If you are in a hurry, you should meet ^0000cdthe Captain and the Chief Officer^000000. They decide whether to sail off or not. They are in the Captain's Cabin up there/
scripts.translation: 您要是赶时间，就去见船长和大副。他们负责决定是否起航。两位都在上面的船长室里。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I smell something. The smell of a rookie...
scripts.translation: 我闻到一股气味...是新手的气味。

scripts.text: Oh, yeah. I see your name on the list. {0}.
scripts.translation: 哦，对了。我在名单上看到你的名字了。。 {0}

scripts.text: don't need to sweat. I believe you have got enough training out there so there is not much for you to do now. Why don't you go and familiarize yourself with the crews and their name?
scripts.translation: 不用紧张。我相信你已经在外面接受过充分训练，现在没什么特别要做的。不如去熟悉一下船员和他们的名字？

scripts.text: When you go somewhere where you know nobody, a Doram from the same town can be your best friend. So I recommend you to meet as many of them as possible now.
scripts.translation: 到了人生地不熟的地方，同乡多兰会是最好的伙伴。所以我建议你趁现在尽量多认识一些人。

scripts.text: There are 12 Part Leaders on this ship other than the Captain, and there are many other crews. You don't need to meet them all. You can meet the important ones.
scripts.translation: 这艘船上除了船长，还有12位部门负责人和许多船员。你不用每个人都认识，先认识几位重要人物就好。

scripts.text: There will be some guys who manage to show up right before the ship sails off so you should meet the ones you can meet for now. First of all, you should go meet the Captain.
scripts.translation: 有些人会赶在起航前才出现，所以先去认识现在能见到的人吧。首先去见船长。

scripts.text: The ^0000cdCaptain's Cabin^000000 is right over there. Since the Captain values courtesy and manners. make sure not to make any mistakes.
scripts.translation: 船长室就在那边。船长很重视礼节和举止，千万别失礼。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: The Captain and the Chief Officer are in there. You may go meet them. You can also talk to them about the sailing schedule.
scripts.translation: 船长和大副都在里面，你可以去见他们，也可以顺便问问航行日程。

scripts.text: The Captain's Cabin is right over there. Since the Captain values courtesy and manners. make sure not to make any mistakes.
scripts.translation: 船长室就在那边。船长很重视礼节和举止，千万别失礼。

scripts.text: Go to meet the Recorder who is the closest to this place. He is such a funny guy. You would have fun talking to him.
scripts.translation: 去见离这里最近的记录员吧。他很有趣，和他聊聊会很开心。

scripts.text: Have you met the Recorder? How about meeting the Head Chef?
scripts.translation: 见过记录员了吗？要不要再去见见主厨？

scripts.text: Well. Have you met all of them?
Not all of them. I couldn't find them all.
scripts.translation: 还没有，我没能找到所有人。

scripts.text: I suppose so. They must be drinking Kahlugna Milk and snoring somewhere. They will come back when it is the time to set off. You can meet them then...
scripts.translation: 我想也是。他们大概在哪儿喝着卡鲁纳牛奶、呼呼大睡呢。等到起航时自然会回来，到时再去见他们吧...

scripts.text: Isn't that ^0000cdKahlugnag^000000 you are holding in your hand? Not anyone can have it, you know.
scripts.translation: 你手里拿的是卡鲁纳牛奶吧？这可不是谁都能拿到的。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: The one checking the ticket at the entrance asked me to deliver it to the Head Chef.
scripts.translation: 入口处负责验票的人让我把它交给主厨。

scripts.text: Why didn't you give it to the Head Chef then? Go ahead and deliver it to him!
scripts.translation: 那你怎么没交给主厨？快把东西送过去！

scripts.text: Have you delivered the thing to the Head Chef? The ingredient should be delivered when it is still fresh! The kitchen is at the end of the hallway.
scripts.translation: 东西交给主厨了吗？食材要趁新鲜送到！厨房就在走廊尽头。

scripts.text: I have handed it over. And the Boatswain wanted to know when the ^0000cdSailing Signal^000000 would be issued.
scripts.translation: 我已经交给主厨了。水手长想知道起航信号什么时候发出。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I was thinking about it just now. Well, have you been trained properly for the adventure? don't you want ^0000cdtest your strength^000000 before that?
scripts.translation: 我刚才也在想这件事。你为冒险做好准备了吗？要不要先测试一下实力？ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Look at Lasagna. What do you think?
scripts.translation: 看看罗札纳，你觉得怎么样？

scripts.text: I think it is one lively and happy village!
scripts.translation: 我觉得这是个热闹又快乐的村庄！

scripts.text: That's not what I want to hear. Take a look at the sea we are about to explore.
scripts.translation: 我想听的不是这个。看看我们即将驶入的海域。

scripts.text: Yes. The ^0000cdfog^000000 over the sea. The sea fog.
I won't be surprised if a monster storms out of the fog. I smell something smoky too. Has a volcano erupted recently around here?
scripts.translation: 就算魔物突然从雾里冲出来，我也不会奇怪。我还闻到一股烟味。这附近最近有火山爆发吗？

scripts.text: We are unable to issue the sailing signal because of the fog. Ask the ^0000cdChief Officer^000000 if there would be any change in the sailing schedule. If there is any, go fix it.
scripts.translation: 因为海雾，我们无法发出起航信号。去问问大副航行日程是否有变。如果有变化，就去处理一下。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: What? I finished the training yesterday.
scripts.translation: 什么？我昨天已经完成训练了。

scripts.text: We are not doing a charity work here. We train promising Dorams and send them to the new continent to bring honor to the name of Doram. That's why train you guys.
scripts.translation: 我们可不是在做慈善。我们训练有前途的多兰，再把他们送往新大陆，为多兰族争光。这就是训练你们的原因。

scripts.text: Consider it as a warming up for all the difficulties you would encounter in the new continent.
scripts.translation: 就把这当成热身，为你在新大陆将遭遇的种种困难做好准备。

scripts.text: The Chief Officer is in the Captain's Cabin. Go ask him if there would be a change in the sailing schedule because of the fog!
scripts.translation: 大副在船长室里。快去问问他，海雾会不会影响航行日程！

scripts.text: I guess we wouldn't be able to set off because of the mist.
scripts.translation: 看来雾还没散，我们暂时无法起航。

scripts.text: How did it go? Please report to Chief Officer Stello.
scripts.translation: 情况如何？向大副斯特洛汇报吧。

scripts.text: Go ahead and report to the Chief Officer.
I am glad that you are working like a full-fledged Doram.
scripts.translation: 很高兴看到你能像个合格的多兰一样办事。

scripts.text: I should check the cargo before sailing off.
scripts.translation: 起航前我得检查一下货物。

scripts.text: It looks a lot and large. How about cutting down some?
scripts.translation: 看起来又多又大。要不要削减一些？

scripts.text: Who are you? You are not allowed to enter hear with no permission. Please leave.
scripts.translation: 你是谁？未经许可不得进入这里，请离开。
