scripts.text: What brought you here? Are you hear to meet the captain? If not, please leave. You are not supposed to be here.
scripts.translation: 有什么事？你是来见船长的吗？不是的话就请离开。这里不是你该来的地方。

scripts.text: Keep that in mind. You need to watch your manners when you deal with the crews of this ship.
scripts.translation: 记住，和船员打交道时要注意礼貌。

scripts.text: The Purser asked me to check if there wouldn't be any problem sailing off with the thick ^0000cdfog^000000.
scripts.translation: 事务长让我来确认一下，在这么浓的雾中起航会不会有问题。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Yes. Again. Umm, what should we do? We have no one to send there. Everyone's so busy preparing for the sailing.
scripts.translation: 是啊，又来了。嗯，该怎么办？没人能派过去，大家都忙着准备起航。

scripts.text: Stello, I guess you should go down there yourself.
scripts.translation: 斯特洛，我看你得亲自下去一趟。

scripts.text: Eggling is not ready to handle it yet. Think about why Eggling is still called Eggling.
scripts.translation: 蛋仔还没准备好处理这种事。想想看，为什么他至今还叫蛋仔。

scripts.text: ... I guess I should go. Damn it.
Stello. a gentleman should use a good language at all time.
scripts.translation: 斯特洛，绅士无论何时都要注意言辞。

scripts.text: Well... The Purser has sent me to take care of the problem.
scripts.translation: 嗯...事务长派我来处理这个问题。

scripts.text: Good. Consider it as the last training before sailing off.
scripts.translation: 很好。就把这当作起航前的最后训练吧。

scripts.text: Stello. It doesn't make sense to call it as the last training when we are dealing with a Doram who has finished the training for the adventure. This should be called the first practice.
scripts.translation: 斯特洛。对方可是已经完成冒险训练的多兰，把这称作最后训练不太合适吧。应该叫第一次实战。

scripts.text: Whatever it is. Well, good. I'll assign your first mission as your first practice.
scripts.translation: 叫什么都无所谓。好，那就把这次任务当作你的第一次实战。

scripts.text: The seaway we are about to take is ^0000cdno typical seaway^000000. You need to read the movements of the stars and wind. You need to take the way which is not marked on the map which makes you wonder if you will ever find the land.
scripts.translation: 我们要走的航线并非寻常航道。你得观察星象和风向，选择地图上没有标出的路线，甚至会怀疑自己还能不能找到陆地。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: That is why we need to get rid of all the fog which blocks us from reading the sun and wind.
scripts.translation: 所以我们必须驱散所有妨碍观察日照和风向的雾。

scripts.text: Can we get rid of the fog?
If it is a normal fog. You need to wait until it is lifted. However, there is ^0000cdsomething causing this fog^000000. It can be removed.
scripts.translation: 如果是普通的雾，只能等它散去。不过，这场雾是由某种东西引起的，想办法就能消除。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: There is something causing the fog? A villain involved, maybe? This is exciting!
scripts.translation: 有东西在制造雾？难道是坏人在捣鬼？听起来好刺激！

scripts.text: Not quite. There is a dragon living in a nearby cave. The dragon breathes fire which burns up everything around it. The fog is made of the smoke.
scripts.translation: 不完全是。附近的洞穴里住着一条龙，它喷出的火焰会烧毁周围的一切，而这些雾就是烟形成的。

scripts.text: No wonder the fog smells like smoke.
The condition of the dragon is always monitored by the vigilante corps. Please go to see ^0000cdthe vigilante guarding the south bridge of the village^000000, and check the state of the dragon.
scripts.translation: 义警一直在监视那条龙的情况。请去找守在村庄南桥的义警，确认龙的状况。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: And if you need help, please help them stop the dragon from breathing fire.
scripts.translation: 如果需要帮忙，就协助他们阻止那条龙喷火。

scripts.text: The sailing depends on your hand, dear adventurer. Well, go on and take care of your first mision!
scripts.translation: 这趟航行就靠你了，亲爱的冒险者。快去完成你的第一个任务吧！

scripts.text: Wait, take this with you. It will come in handy in case of an emergency. Please be careful!
scripts.translation: 等等，把这个带上。遇到紧急情况时会派上用场。小心行事！

scripts.text: Ask the vigilante how the dragon is doing and resolve the situation with the vigilante corps if any problem has occurred.
scripts.translation: 去问问义警那条龙的情况。如果出了问题，就和义警一起处理。

scripts.text: You are here. We were just talking about you.
scripts.translation: 你来了。我们刚才还在说你呢。

scripts.text: We were wondering if we had to go down there to recover your dead body...
scripts.translation: 我们在商量要不要下去把你的尸体捞回来...

scripts.text: What? Was it such a dangerous mission?
scripts.translation: 什么？这任务有那么危险吗？

scripts.text: No, not at all. Captain, what are you talking about?
scripts.translation: 一点也不危险。船长，您在说什么？

scripts.text: Stello, it is called a joke.
A joke should be pleasant for the both parties. This is just a curse.
scripts.translation: 玩笑应该让双方都觉得有趣。这听起来更像诅咒。

scripts.text: Stello, you must learn about this thing called social codes.
scripts.translation: 斯特洛，你得学学什么叫社交礼节。

scripts.text: Well, we can talk about that later. I was wondering when you would be back. When the fog was lifted, we figured out that you had succeeded, dear adventurer. Thank you for your effort.
scripts.translation: 这个以后再说吧。我一直在等你回来。雾一散，我们就知道你成功了。亲爱的冒险者，辛苦你了。

scripts.text: It was a great experience for me.
scripts.translation: 这次经历让我受益匪浅。

scripts.text: Stello, you should be liberal with your praise. Just as I did it to you.
scripts.translation: 斯特洛，赞美别人要大方些，就像我夸你那样。

scripts.text: Oh, yes. Let's give a big hand to the adventurer who has returned from the mission!
scripts.translation: 哦，对了！让我们为完成任务归来的冒险者热烈鼓掌！

scripts.text: Well then. It is the time to issue the sailing signal.
scripts.translation: 那么，是时候发出起航信号了。

scripts.text: Everyone, in your position! We are sailing off now!
scripts.translation: 所有人各就各位！准备起航！
斯特洛，把那个交给冒险者。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: That? What do you mean by that?
The thing that you cannot buy with money when you leave Lasagna.
scripts.translation: 就是离开罗札纳后，花钱也买不到的东西。

scripts.text: I have received a handful. I don't need more.
scripts.translation: 我已经拿到一些了，不需要更多。

scripts.text: Really? Then you may not need this either. Too bad. I have prepared it for you. I guess it belongs to someone else now.
scripts.translation: 真的吗？那这个你可能也不需要了。真可惜，我特地为你准备的...看来只好送给别人了。

scripts.text: It is the little present prepared for the novice adventurer by the leader of Farfalle vigilante corps and the captain of Con-Chliina in celebration of the first mission.
scripts.translation: 这是法尔法雷义警团首领和康奇利娜号船长准备的小礼物，送给完成首次任务的新手冒险者。

scripts.text: The hat is prepared by Pepperoncino after hearing your story. A Doram adventurer deserves to have a hat. The hat will bring you luck.
scripts.translation: 听完你的经历后，佩佩龙奇诺特地准备了这顶帽子。多兰冒险者就该有顶帽子，它会给你带来好运。

scripts.text: And the ring is prepared by the captain. Dear captain?
scripts.translation: 戒指是船长准备的。船长？

scripts.text: That ring will help you gather special experiences as a novice adventurer.
scripts.translation: 这枚戒指能帮你在冒险初期获得特别的历练。

scripts.text: It will grow with you until you don't need its help anymore. When you become an experienced adventurer, it will lose all its power and become an ordinary ring made of grass.
scripts.translation: 它会陪伴你成长，直到你不再需要它的帮助。等你成为经验丰富的冒险者，它就会失去力量，变成一枚普通的草制戒指。

scripts.text: Oh, I should get you a Magnifier. When you get an unidentified weapon or equipment, check with it.
scripts.translation: 对了，我再给你一个放大镜。拿到未鉴定的武器或装备时，可以用它来鉴定。

scripts.text: I'll give you some ^0000cdKahlugna Milk^000000 which all Dorams who have ever visited Lasagna crave. Thank you so much for your effort.
scripts.translation: 我再送你一些卡鲁纳牛奶。每个来过罗札纳的多兰都很喜欢它。非常感谢你的努力。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Well then. It is the time to issue the sailing signal.
scripts.translation: 那么，是时候发出起航信号了。

scripts.text: Everyone, in your position! We are sailing off now!
scripts.translation: 所有人各就各位！准备起航！

scripts.text: I'd like to explore the new continent when I get to leave the ship someday.
scripts.translation: 真希望哪天能离开这艘船，去探索新大陆。

scripts.text: How is the new continent? Should I ask for a leave and go on an adventure?
scripts.translation: 新大陆怎么样？我是不是也该请假去冒险？

scripts.text: Nonsense! Who else would take care of the seaway to the new continent?
scripts.translation: 别胡说！谁来负责通往新大陆的航线？

scripts.text: Just saying... It doesn't hurt to say that.
scripts.translation: 我只是说说...说说又没关系。

scripts.text: Make sure to knock. Keep your manners.
Stello, I have told you how the way you dress shows what kind of Doram you are. Ad just your attire, please.
scripts.translation: 斯特洛，我说过，你的穿着能体现多兰的风度。请整理一下仪容。

scripts.text: This is too heavy, tight and annoying. This is just too uncomfortable.
scripts.translation: 这身衣服又重又紧，还很碍事，穿着太不舒服了。

scripts.text: You need to overcome the inconvenience to have a correct posture. The correct posture is your first step to become a gentleman. Do you get it, Stello?
scripts.translation: 要保持端正的仪态，就得克服这些不便。仪态端正是成为绅士的第一步。明白了吗，斯特洛？

scripts.text: Who are you? You are not allowed to enter hear with no permission. Please leave.
scripts.translation: 你是谁？未经许可不得进入这里，请离开。

scripts.text: Hello. I am a passenger on this ship. I'd like to know when this ship sets off.
scripts.translation: 您好，我是这艘船上的乘客。想问问这艘船什么时候起航。

scripts.text: The ship will set off when the time comes.
scripts.translation: 到了起航的时候，自然就会出发。

scripts.text: Stello, I don't think that is the matter of the question. Look outside.
scripts.translation: 斯特洛，我看他问的不是这个。看看外面。

scripts.text: Oh, the red ^0000cdfog^000000! It seemed all right just a while ago!
scripts.translation: 啊，是红色的雾！刚才明明还好好的！ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I guess something may have cause the disturbance.
scripts.translation: 看来是有什么东西引起了这场异变。

scripts.text: We cannot sail off like this.
However, I really am in a hurry. Should I wait until the fog is lifted?
scripts.translation: 可是我真的赶时间。要等雾散了才能走吗？

scripts.text: That fog will not be lifted if you just sit and wait.

scripts.translation: 这不是自然形成的雾吗？

scripts.text: It Isn't. This fog is made of the smoke which is fumed by ^0000cdthe dragon living in the cave^000000 when it is upset. Please wait until ^0000cdthe vigilantes^000000 take care of it.
scripts.translation: 不是。这雾是洞穴里的龙发怒时喷出的烟形成的。等义警处理好再说吧。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Then when would we be able to set off?
scripts.translation: 那我们什么时候才能起航？

scripts.text: Isn't the fog covering the area near the shore? wouldn't it be a problem to just sail off?
scripts.translation: 雾不是只在近岸一带吗？直接起航应该也没问题吧？

scripts.text: The seaway we are about to take is ^0000cdno typical seaway^000000. You need to read the movements of the stars and wind. You need to take the way which is not marked on the map which makes you wonder if you will ever find the land.
scripts.translation: 我们要走的航线并非寻常航道。你得观察星象和风向，选择地图上没有标出的路线，甚至会怀疑自己还能不能找到陆地。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: That is why we need to get rid of all the ^0000cdfog^000000 which blocks us from reading the sun and wind.
scripts.translation: 所以我们必须清除所有妨碍观察日照和风向的雾气。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I guess there is no choice left for me. I should go there.
scripts.translation: 看来只能这样了，我去看看。

scripts.text: You don't need to do this.
Stello. This adventurer seems very experienced. This could be a new adventure as well. It could help us.
scripts.translation: 斯特洛，这位冒险者看起来经验丰富。这也算一次新的冒险，说不定能帮上忙。

scripts.text: Hum... OK. Please go to see ^0000cdthe vigilante guarding the south bridge of the village^000000, and check the state of the dragon.
scripts.translation: 嗯...好吧。请去找守在村庄南桥的义警，确认一下龙的情况。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Since the condition of the dragon is very important in Lasagna, the vigilantes check it at all time.
scripts.translation: 龙的情况对罗札纳很重要，所以义警一直在监视它。

scripts.text: Ask the vigilante how the dragon is doing and resolve the situation with the vigilante corps if any problem has occurred.
scripts.translation: 去问问义警那条龙的情况。如果出了问题，就和义警一起处理。

scripts.text: I see. Let me take a quick tour.
Stello, I have told you how the way you dress shows what kind of Doram you are. Ad just your attire, please.
scripts.translation: 斯特洛，我说过，你的穿着能体现多兰的风度。请整理一下仪容。

scripts.text: This is too heavy, tight and annoying. This is just so uncomfortable.
scripts.translation: 这身衣服又重又紧，还很碍事，穿着太不舒服了。

scripts.text: You need to overcome the inconvenience to have a correct posture. The correct posture is your first step to become a gentleman. Do you get it, Stello?
scripts.translation: 要保持端正的仪态，就得克服这些不便。仪态端正是成为绅士的第一步。明白了吗，斯特洛？

scripts.text: Who are you? You are not allowed to enter hear with no permission. Please leave.
scripts.translation: 你是谁？未经许可不得进入这里，请离开。

scripts.text: Hello, I am {0} who is on a new adventure.
scripts.translation: 你好，我是，正在踏上新的冒险旅程。 {0}

scripts.text: A new adventurer. A polite Doram always knocks before entering. Since you must be nervous before the adventure, I'll let it slide this time.
scripts.translation: 新来的冒险者啊。有教养的多兰进门前都会先敲门。看你出发前有些紧张，这次就算了。

scripts.text: I am Captain ^0000cdGamberi^000000 in charge of this ship. Welcome aboard.
scripts.translation: 我是这艘船的船长甘贝里。欢迎登船。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: The Purser must have sent up another irrelevant visitor. He must have told you how the people from the same home town should stick together and all.
scripts.translation: 事务长肯定又放了个无关紧要的访客上来。他一定又跟你说什么同乡之间要互相照应之类的话了。

scripts.text: Oh, I am not blaming you. I'll do my best to give you the best sailing adventure. I am ^0000cdStello^000000.
scripts.translation: 哦，我不是在怪你。我会尽力让你有一段愉快的航程。我叫斯特洛。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: It may help you ease your nerve to walk around the ship. As long as you watch your manners, everyone will welcome you.
scripts.translation: 在船上四处走走，也许能让你放松些。只要注意礼仪，大家都会欢迎你。

scripts.text: Especially, you need to adjust your attire. The right outfit leads to a correct posture, and the correct posture is the first step to become a gentleman.
scripts.translation: 尤其要注意仪容。得体的穿着能让仪态更端正，而仪态端正是成为绅士的第一步。

scripts.text: All the crews are such gentlemen, but they have no mercy for bad manners. You should be careful about this.
scripts.translation: 船员们都是绅士，但绝不容忍无礼的行为。你可得注意。

scripts.text: I am glad that an experienced adventurer like you is helping us. Ask the vigilante about the state of the dragon.
scripts.translation: 有你这样经验丰富的冒险者帮忙，真是太好了。去问问义警那条龙的情况吧。

scripts.text: It would be a great idea to meet other members of the crew.
scripts.translation: 去认识一下其他船员也不错。

scripts.text: You need to calm down the dragon to sail off. Please do your bedt.
scripts.translation: 要想起航，你得先让那条龙平静下来。尽力而为吧。

scripts.text: I am here to fulfil ^0000cdmy duty as an adventurer^000000.
scripts.translation: 我来履行身为冒险者的职责。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Other than setting off on an adventure, I collect adventure stories from other people. I have heard that Captain Gamberi, you have been in Lasagna for a long time.
scripts.translation: 除了亲自冒险，我也会向别人收集冒险故事。听说甘贝里船长您在罗札纳待了很久。

scripts.text: Everyone says that I can hear the adventure stories regarding Lasagna and Con-Chliina from you.
scripts.translation: 大家都说，想听罗札纳和康奇利娜号的冒险故事，找您准没错。

scripts.text: Hum! Then you have found the right man. It is another adventure for me to tell an adventure story to an adventurer. Which story do you want hear now?
scripts.translation: 哼！那你找对人了。给冒险者讲冒险故事，对我来说也是另一场冒险。你现在想听哪个故事？

scripts.text: I am interested in the story about you the most.
I am from Lasagna. I was born to an honorable family and gentle parents. I grew up to become a curious and adventurous child.
scripts.translation: 我来自罗札纳，出生在一个体面的家庭，父母也很温和。我从小就充满好奇，喜欢冒险。

scripts.text: I wanted to break free from the name of the family. I ran off and wandered around Lasagna.
scripts.translation: 我想摆脱家族的名声，于是离家出走，在罗札纳四处闯荡。

scripts.text: Oh, strange. This is not the story I have heard from your mother, Captain. She said you didn't want to help the butcher's shop business, and you went out from the early morning.
scripts.translation: 奇怪，这和我从您母亲那里听到的故事不一样，船长。她说您不想帮忙打理肉铺，一大早就跑出去了。

scripts.text: Stello, it is not polite to interrupt. I had a strong sense of justice and couldn't just let those bad Dorams disturbing peace in Lasagna. I had to ^0000cdlead them into the right path^000000.
scripts.translation: 斯特洛，插话可不礼貌。我当时正义感十足，没法对那些扰乱罗札纳安宁的坏多兰坐视不理。我必须引导他们走上正途。 ^0000cd^000000
后来我遇到了佩佩龙奇诺。

scripts.text: I heard that story. That's why you were called the mad...
scripts.translation: 我听过这个故事。所以您才被叫作疯...

scripts.text: I was interested in the fishing industry, and I went into the ^0000cdanchovy processing^000000 business with Pepperoncino. We made a fortune. We wondered what to do with all the money we had...
scripts.translation: 我对渔业很感兴趣，就和佩佩龙奇诺一起做起了鳀鱼加工生意。我们赚了很多钱，后来就开始琢磨该怎么花... ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: You may not see it now, but Lasagna used to be a dark place. Bad Dorams everywhere on the street, and there were a lot of fights.
scripts.translation: 你现在可能看不出来，罗札纳以前可是个黑暗的地方。街上到处都是坏多兰，打架斗殴更是家常便饭。

scripts.text: It was my duty to ^0000cdlead those bad Dorams into the right path^000000.
scripts.translation: 引导那些坏多兰走上正途是我的职责。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: It was 10 years ago when peace was brought to this town as Pepperoncino and Thomas worked together in accord...
scripts.translation: 那是十年前，佩佩龙奇诺和托马斯齐心协力，为这座城镇带来了和平...

scripts.text: I met Stello then. I ^0000cdcorrected Stello who was a pickpocket^000000 back then. He has become the Chief Office.
scripts.translation: 那时我遇到了斯特洛。我改正了当时还是扒手的斯特洛，他后来成了大副。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Hum, Let's stop talking about it. It was ages ago.
scripts.translation: 嗯...别说了，都是很久以前的事了。

scripts.text: I, Pepperoncino and Thomas wanted to pull off a major gig. A really big one. Nothing like what we had done by then. A business. I mean.
scripts.translation: 我、佩佩龙奇诺和托马斯想做一番大事业，真正的大事业，和以前做的那些都不一样。我是说，一门生意。

scripts.text: The business we started was to ^0000cdsell the specialty products of Lasagna in other cities^000000. It went well, and we hired more people to expand the size of the business.
scripts.translation: 我们开始把罗札纳的特产卖到其他城镇。生意很顺利，于是我们雇了更多人，不断扩大规模。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: At the same time, we ran a ^0000cdvigilante corps^000000 to clean up the streets of Lasagna. Many people joined us for our cause.
scripts.translation: 与此同时，我们还组建了义警团来整顿罗札纳的街道。许多人为了这个目标加入了我们。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Are you going to join me or get punched in the face? Are you going to keep living in the gutter? Who wouldn't join the vigilante corps hearing those threats...
scripts.translation: 你是要加入我们，还是等着挨揍？还想继续在街头混日子吗？听了这种威胁，谁还会不加入义警团呢...

scripts.text: No! I really wanted to join!

I corrected those bad Dorams and formed the merchant group and the vigilante corps to engage in^0000cd trades^000000. The business thrived, and all the cities nearby were filled with the goods from Lasagna.
scripts.translation: 我让那些坏多兰改邪归正，又组建商队和义警团来经营贸易。生意越做越大，附近城镇到处都能看到罗札纳的商品。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Anyway, we decided to extend our stage to the ^0000cdsea^000000. Such decision was made out of the adventurous spirit of mine.
scripts.translation: 后来，我们决定把事业扩展到海上。这个决定完全是出于我那颗热爱冒险的心。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: And we were caught in a storm and parted with ^0000cdThomas' ship, Navi^000000. We kept on looking for Navi.
scripts.translation: 我们遭遇风暴，和托马斯的船“纳维号”失散了。之后我们一直在寻找纳维号。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Then I pioneered the seaway to Malangdo with ^0000cdStello^000000 whom I had straightened, and reunited with Thomas. Eventually, we decided to advance into the new continent.
scripts.translation: 后来，我和被我纠正过来的斯特洛开辟了前往绵绵岛的航线，并与托马斯重逢。最终，我们决定进军新大陆。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Ever since, we have been not only leading the trade with the new continent but also connecting the continents. The adventurers from both continents use ^0000cdCon-Chliina^000000, and we are proud of it.
scripts.translation: 从那以后，我们不仅主导着与新大陆的贸易，也成了连接两块大陆的桥梁。两边的冒险者都搭乘康奇利娜号，想到这一点我们就很自豪。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Oh, it was quite a story. I really appreciate your story. I believe that al the numerous adventures have made you the man who you are now, dear captain.
scripts.translation: 真是精彩的故事，谢谢您愿意讲给我听。我相信，正是无数次冒险造就了今天的您，船长。

scripts.text: Well, I guess it is the time for me to go out looking for a new adventure, leaving this valuable experience behind.
scripts.translation: 我也该去寻找新的冒险了，把这段宝贵的经历留在心里。

scripts.text: Please come back later and tell me your story.
scripts.translation: 过些时候再来，跟我讲讲你的故事吧。

scripts.text: Come find me if you have any questions.
scripts.translation: 有问题的话，随时来找我。

scripts.text: I'd like to hear about the adventure story someday.
scripts.translation: 希望哪天能听听你的冒险故事。

scripts.text: I'd like to hear your adventure stories from the new continent someday. Come visit me from time to time during the adventure.
scripts.translation: 希望哪天能听听你在新大陆的冒险故事。冒险途中也常来看看我吧。

scripts.text: It looks a lot and large. How about cutting down some?
scripts.translation: 看起来又多又大。要不要删减一些？

scripts.text: Since it takes concentration, please don't interrupt me.
scripts.translation: 这需要集中精神，请别打扰我。

scripts.text: I told not to disturb... Oh, who are you?
scripts.translation: 我不是说了别打扰...咦，你是谁？

scripts.text: Hello, I am {0}, looking for adventure from the new continent. I am here to say hi as the Purser has advised.
scripts.translation: 你好，我是，正准备前往新大陆冒险。事务长建议我来跟你打声招呼。 {0}

scripts.text: Nice to meet you. I am the Recorder of this ship who is in charge of all records of this ship. You may come by whenever you have a question. You are free to access any records except the classified ones.
scripts.translation: 幸会。我是这艘船的记录员，负责管理船上的所有档案。有问题随时可以来找我。除了机密档案，你可以查阅其他所有记录。

scripts.text: Let me record your profile now. Oh, you don't need to do anything. You may just stand there.
scripts.translation: 我现在来记录一下你的资料。哦，你什么都不用做，站在那里就好。

scripts.text: Your name is... {0}... The height must be... and the color is... like this... The accent of yours... You must have lived in Pane and moved to Bongola.
scripts.translation: 你的名字是......身高应该是...发色是...这样...口音听起来...你一定在帕内住过，后来搬去了邦戈拉。 {0}

scripts.text: The dirt and grass on your feet... You are not a neat person... Oh, never mind. I am not writing down your faults... This is enough.
scripts.translation: 你脚上沾着泥土和草屑...看来不太爱干净...算了，我不会把缺点记下来的...这样就够了。

scripts.text: How do you know such things in detail?
scripts.translation: 你怎么能观察得这么仔细？

scripts.text: You just need to pay a little attention. It is just a technique I have picked up from observing people for a long time.
scripts.translation: 稍微留心就能发现。这只是我长期观察别人后学会的小技巧。

scripts.text: Let's see, you must have met the Captain and the Chief Officer. This place must be your second stop.
scripts.translation: 我想想，你应该已经见过船长和大副了。这里应该是你的第二站。

scripts.text: Now is the time to see the ^0000cdHead Chef, the Helmsman and the Boatswain^000000. They must be in the ^0000cddining room^000000 at the end of the hallway. Have a safe voyage.
scripts.translation: 接下来该去见主厨、舵手和水手长了。他们应该在走廊尽头的餐厅里。祝你一路顺风。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: You should go meet the Head Chef, the Helmsman and the Boatswain. They are in the dining room at the end of the hallway.
scripts.translation: 去见见主厨、舵手和水手长吧。他们都在走廊尽头的餐厅里。

scripts.text: Isn't it the time to meet the Purser?
You are on your way to meet the Sous Chef. He is in the dining room at the end of the hallway.
scripts.translation: 你正要去见副厨师长吧？他在走廊尽头的餐厅里。

scripts.text: You must be on your way back to the Purser. I was wondering since there hadn't been a sailing signal even after the scheduled time.
scripts.translation: 你应该是要回去找事务长吧？预定时间都过了还没发出起航信号，我正纳闷呢。

scripts.text: The Chief Officer and the Captain are the ones who issue the sailing signal. Asking them would be the fastest way to find out.
scripts.translation: 起航信号由船长和大副发出。直接问他们最快。

scripts.text: Are you heading there to meet the vigilante? I was about to go there to check out new members. As soon as the business her is taken care of, I'll go down there. Of course. with a notebook.
scripts.translation: 你要去见义警吗？我也正打算过去看看新成员。这边忙完我就下去，当然会带上笔记本。

scripts.text: You should go see the Captain and the Chief Officer. Everyone is waiting to set off.
scripts.translation: 去见船长和大副吧。大家都在等着起航。

scripts.text: I told not to disturb... Oh, who are you?
scripts.translation: 我不是说了别打扰...咦，你是谁？

scripts.text: Hello, I am {0}, looking for adventure from the new continent. I am here to say hi as the Purser has advised.
scripts.translation: 你好，我是，正准备前往新大陆冒险。事务长建议我来跟你打声招呼。 {0}

scripts.text: Oh, I see. Nice to meet you. I am the Recorder of this ship who is in charge of all records of this ship. You may come by whenever you have a question. You are free to access any records except the classified ones.
scripts.translation: 哦，明白了。幸会。我是这艘船的记录员，负责管理船上的所有档案。有问题随时可以来找我。除了机密档案，你可以查阅其他所有记录。

scripts.text: Let me record your profile now. Oh, you don't need to do anything. You may just stand there. Your name is... {0}...The height must be... and the color is... like this...
scripts.translation: 我现在来记录一下你的资料。哦，你什么都不用做，站在那里就好。你的名字是......身高应该是...发色是...这样... {0}

scripts.text: Oh, never mind. I am not writing down your faults... This is enough.
scripts.translation: 算了，我不会把你的缺点记下来的...这样就够了。

scripts.text: How do you know such things in detail?
scripts.translation: 你怎么能观察得这么仔细？

scripts.text: You just need to pay a little attention. It is just a technique I have picked up from observing people for a long time.
scripts.translation: 稍微留心就能发现。这是我长期观察别人后掌握的小技巧。

scripts.text: Anyways, just in time. A mysterious thing has just happened, and I need ^0000cda fresh eye who is not involved in it^000000.
scripts.translation: 说来正巧，刚发生了一件怪事，我需要一个不知情的旁观者来帮忙。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I have a hunch that I have to leave this place now.
scripts.translation: 我有种预感，现在该离开这里了。

scripts.text: You may want to hear me out at least. As an adventurer, it helps to hear a lot of stories.
scripts.translation: 至少听我说完嘛。作为冒险者，多听些故事总有好处。

scripts.text: I won't listen to it. I don't want to get involved in another annoying business.
scripts.translation: 我不听。我可不想再卷进什么麻烦事。

scripts.text: Is that so? Well, it is not polite to get hold of a busy person.
scripts.translation: 这样啊。那就不打扰您了，毕竟您很忙。

scripts.text: However, if you change your mind, come back anytime. I'll be waiting for you.
scripts.translation: 不过，如果改变主意，随时可以回来。我会等着您。

scripts.text: Good. Please take a look at this shelf here.
scripts.translation: 很好，请看看这边的书架。

scripts.text: There are a lot of books.
They may look like books, but they are not. They are the records of all the things which have happened on the ship.
scripts.translation: 看起来像书，其实不是。这些是船上发生过的各种事情的记录。

scripts.text: It is consisted not only of the events which have happened on the ship but also of the history of almost every person who has anything to do with Con-Chliina.
scripts.translation: 里面不只有船上发生的事件，还记载着几乎所有与康奇利娜号有关的人和事。

scripts.text: The future can be seen through the past.
I don't just make new records. I also do my best to store the records at their best condition.
scripts.translation: 我不只负责撰写新记录，也会尽力妥善保存已有的记录。

scripts.text: However, someone has ^0000cddamaged one of the records in this place^000000.
scripts.translation: 可是有人损坏了这里的一份记录。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Whoever did that did not even tried to hide the deed. This person has just torn the entire book mercilessly. It was ruined.
scripts.translation: 那人甚至没想过掩盖行径，竟把整本书都撕得粉碎，彻底毁掉了。

scripts.text: Huh! Is it a case in which I need to find the missing paged? The role of this fresh eye you are looking for is to provide a new insight to the investigation to solve the case?
scripts.translation: 咦！是要我找回丢失的书页吗？您需要的“新视角”，是指让我为调查提供新的线索，帮忙破案？

scripts.text: No. The missing pages have been found. In the oven of the kitchen.
scripts.translation: 不，丢失的书页已经找到了，就在厨房的烤箱里。

scripts.text: Unfortunately, most of the pages were gone in the fire. I could barely recognize the remaining of the document.
scripts.translation: 可惜大部分书页都被火烧毁了，剩下的部分也几乎无法辨认。

scripts.text: What were the missing pages about?
scripts.translation: 那些丢失的书页记载了什么？

scripts.text: Unfortunately, those pages contained ^0000cdthe record about Captain Gamberi^000000. Since Gamberi is our captain, I have done my best to make the record.
scripts.translation: 可惜那些书页记载着船长甘贝里的故事。甘贝里是我们的船长，所以我一直很用心地整理他的故事。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: The story about Captain Gamberi is included in all the books as well. And all of it was reduced to ashes.
scripts.translation: 所有记录中都收录了船长甘贝里的故事，可如今全都化为灰烬了。

scripts.text: The lost record was about the story of Captain Gamberi before he became the captain of Con-Chliina, which was very rare.
scripts.translation: 这份珍贵的记录讲述的是甘贝里船长成为康奇利娜号船长之前的经历。

scripts.text: It is because of the characteristic of Lasagna population. It is mostly consisted of the people from other regions. Captain Gamberi and Captain Thomas of Navi are pretty much the only people from Lasagna.
scripts.translation: 这是罗札纳居民的特点造成的。这里大多数人都来自其他地区，甘贝里船长和纳维号的托马斯船长几乎是唯二的本地人。

scripts.text: Most of the people who knew the past of Captain Gamberi have left Lasagna. There is almost no one who knows the past here now.
scripts.translation: 了解甘贝里船长过去的人大多已经离开罗札纳了。如今这里几乎没人知道他的往事。

scripts.text: That's why it has taken a long time to research and make the record.
scripts.translation: 所以调查和整理这份记录花了很长时间。

scripts.text: Should I help you find the thief then?
No. I have found the thief already. I plan to punish him in the most painful way possible. However, there are things I have to take care of before that. That's why I am keeping it quiet.
scripts.translation: 不用，我已经找到小偷了。我打算用最痛苦的方式惩罚他。不过在那之前还有些事要处理，所以暂时保密。

scripts.text: Then what do you need a fresh eye for?
scripts.translation: 那您需要一个局外人做什么？

scripts.text: If I cannot recover it, I should rebuild it. I tried to interview Captain Gamberi to fill in the missing pages, but Gaptain Gamberi didn't respond.
scripts.translation: 既然无法复原，就只能重新整理。我试着采访甘贝里船长，补上缺失的内容，可他不肯回应。

scripts.text: I have sent many other people. It was no use. He wouldn't open up to anyone on Con-Chliina about his past. That is why I need a ^0000cdfresh eye^000000.
scripts.translation: 我还派了很多人去，全都没用。他不愿向康奇利娜号上的任何人透露过去。所以我才需要一个局外人。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: He sometimes tells a stranger or a newbie ^0000cdhis story and how Lasagna has developed so far^000000 as he is telling some adventure stories. I'd like to send you to hear from him this time.
scripts.translation: 他有时会像讲冒险故事那样，向陌生人或新手讲述自己的经历，以及罗札纳一路发展至今的故事。这次我想请你去听听。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: You mean that I should ask him about what happened in the past without giving him the impression that I have been asked by you.
scripts.translation: 您是说，我去问问他过去发生的事，但不能让他知道是您派我去的。

scripts.text: Yes, indeed. It should remain a secret. If Captain Gamberi finds out, you and I'd never get away.
scripts.translation: 正是如此。这必须保密。要是被甘贝里船长发现了，你我都别想脱身。

scripts.text: Well, then. Have a safe trip.
You can interview Captain Gamberi and tell me the story.
scripts.translation: 你可以去采访甘贝里船长，再把听到的故事告诉我。

scripts.text: I have heard from the story from Captain Gamberi, but I am very confused.
scripts.translation: 我听了甘贝里船长讲的故事，不过有些困惑。

scripts.text: [When you told the story you heard from Captain Gamberi and about how Stello interrupted, the Recorder started writing it down.]
scripts.translation: [你讲述从甘贝里船长那里听来的故事，以及斯特洛如何插话时，记录员开始做笔记。]

scripts.text: That is strange. I cannot remember all the records, but the story told by Captain Gamberi ^0000cdis different^000000 from the part of the record I do remember.
scripts.translation: 真奇怪。我记不住所有档案，但甘贝里船长讲的故事和我记得的档案内容不一样。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Was the story of the Chief Officer true then?
scripts.translation: 那么，大副说的故事是真的吗？

scripts.text: Well, I am not sure. We need to check out the story with other versions. Since there are discrepancies, I cannot make the record counting on the words of Captain Gamberi.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我也不确定。得找其他版本来核对。既然内容有出入，我不能只凭甘贝里船长的话来定稿。

scripts.text: It is a relief that we have more people to hear the story from, other than Captain Gamberi.
scripts.translation: 幸好除了甘贝里船长，我们还可以向其他人打听。

scripts.text: Although this person is not from Lasagna, he has spent meaningful amount of time with Captain Gamberi. You may go talk to him. We can compare the story from him with the interview with Captain Gamberi.
scripts.translation: 虽然那人不是罗札纳人，但他和甘贝里船长相处过很长时间。你可以去找他谈谈，再把他的说法和甘贝里船长的采访内容对照一下。

scripts.text: I am sorry to ask you again.
scripts.translation: 又要麻烦你，真不好意思。

scripts.text: I mean ^0000cdPepperoncino the leader of the vigilante corps^000000. He must be having an early meal at the new Adventurer Club now.
scripts.translation: 我是说义警团首领佩佩龙奇诺。他现在应该正在新建的冒险者俱乐部吃早饭。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: You can enter the restaurant when you head to the south gate of the <NAVI>^4D4DFF[Adventurer Club]^000000<INFO>lasagna,56,186,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation: 从<NAVI>[冒险者俱乐部]<INFO>lasagna,56,186,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>南门进去，就能到餐厅。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: You can interview Pepperoncino and tell me the story.
scripts.translation: 你可以去采访佩佩龙奇诺，再把听到的故事告诉我。

scripts.text: He must be having an early meal at the newly built <NAVI>^4D4DFF[Adventurer Club]^000000<INFO>lasagna,56,186,000,1,</INFO></NAVI> now. You can enter the restaurant when you head to the south gate.
scripts.translation: 他现在应该正在新建的<NAVI>[冒险者俱乐部]<INFO>lasagna,56,186,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>吃早饭。从南门进去就能到餐厅。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: I guess you must have heard the actual story this time.
scripts.translation: 看来你这次听到了事情的真相。

scripts.text: The story on Pepperoncino's side makes me more confused. Listen for yourself.
scripts.translation: 佩佩龙奇诺的说法让我更困惑了。您自己听听看吧。

scripts.text: [When you told the story you heard from Pepperoncino and about how Olio interrupted, the Recorder started writing it down.]
scripts.translation: [你讲述从佩佩龙奇诺那里听来的故事，以及奥利奥如何插话时，记录员开始做笔记。]

scripts.text: The story from Pepperoncino doesn't quite make sense either. I can check out his story with the records.
scripts.translation: 佩佩龙奇诺的说法也有些不对劲。我可以对照档案来核实。

scripts.text: Let's see. Well, the story you heard is different from the record of Pepperoncino.
scripts.translation: 我看看...嗯，你听到的故事和档案里佩佩龙奇诺的记载不一样。

scripts.text: Not we cannot quite trust the story told by Pepperoncino. I cannot record the story I cannot trust.
scripts.translation: 看来佩佩龙奇诺的话也不完全可信。我不能把自己都不相信的故事写进档案。

scripts.text: However, I cannot let the records be lost like this. What should I do...
scripts.translation: 可是我不能就这样放任档案丢失...该怎么办呢？

scripts.text: How about asking Captain Thomas of Navi?
scripts.translation: 问问纳维号的托马斯船长怎么样？

scripts.text: As you can see, Captain Gamberi and Pepperoncino only tell the stories they like to tell. We cannot trust the story of Captain Thomas either.
scripts.translation: 你也看到了，甘贝里船长和佩佩龙奇诺只讲他们愿意讲的故事。托马斯船长的说法恐怕也不能全信。

scripts.text: How about the story told by the oldest person in Lasagna?
scripts.translation: 问问罗札纳最年长的那位怎么样？

scripts.text: Lasagna is somewhere you just drop by to make some dough when you are young. Most of them just leave this place...
scripts.translation: 罗札纳对很多人来说，只是年轻时来赚点钱的地方。大多数人之后都离开了...

scripts.text: Oh, you are right. There is ^0000cdthis one person^000000.
scripts.translation: 啊，你说得对。还有那么一个人。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Where the Adventurer Club is now, there used to be ^0000cdPub-Oven^000000. The place used to sell Kahlugna Milk. You can go to see ^0000cdthe first owner^000000 of the place. However...
scripts.translation: 冒险者俱乐部所在的地方以前是Pub-Oven，那里曾经卖卡鲁纳牛奶。你可以去找那里的第一任店主。只是... ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: However, she doesn't think clearly now... I guess she may remember the past more vividly because of it. It is like she is living in the past.
scripts.translation: 不过，她现在神志不太清楚...也许正因为如此，她反而更清楚地记得过去，就像一直活在过去一样。

scripts.text: Go to meet ^0000cdthe old lady who used to be the owner of Pub-Oven^000000. She is living in a ^0000cd small house near the Adventurer Club^000000.
scripts.translation: 去找曾经经营Pub-Oven的老妇人吧。她住在冒险者俱乐部附近的一间小屋里。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Go to see the old lady who used to be the first owner of Pub-Oven. She must be the house near it.
scripts.translation: 去看看那位曾经经营Pub-Oven的老妇人。她应该住在附近那间房子里。

scripts.text: Welcome. Thank you for your effort. Please report it now.
scripts.translation: 欢迎回来，辛苦了。请把情况告诉我。

scripts.text: [When you told the story about Captain Gamberi you heard from the old lady, the Recorder started writing it down.]
scripts.translation: [你讲述从老妇人那里听来的甘贝里船长故事时，记录员开始做笔记。]

scripts.text: Nice work. The story matches some of the details I remember. He sure is a living history. I guess I should fill in the records based on the story.
scripts.translation: 做得好。这个故事和我记得的一些细节吻合。他真是活历史啊。我会根据这个故事补全档案。

scripts.text: It will be filled with more abundant detailed than the previous record.
scripts.translation: 这次的档案会比之前的更加详尽。

scripts.text: Dear captain, what are you doing here?
You were in place. I am just checking if everyone is in the right place prior to the voyage.
scripts.translation: 你在这里啊。我只是趁起航前确认一下大家是否都各就各位了。

scripts.text: Since when it has been your duty to check it? So quietly? Without a knock on the door?
scripts.translation: 什么时候检查文件成了您的职责？而且还偷偷摸摸的，连门都不敲？

scripts.text: As an experienced crew of Con-Chliina, one must be able to cope with any situation whenever they need to.
scripts.translation: 身为康奇利娜号的老船员，无论遇到什么情况都得随时应对。

scripts.text: I see. ^0000cdIt must be the duty of the captain to tear and burn the document as well^000000, I guess.
scripts.translation: 我明白了。撕毁并烧掉档案，大概也是船长的职责之一吧。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Oh, hum. I should go check if the Boatswain in the right place.
scripts.translation: 哦，嗯...我得去看看水手长是否在岗位上。

scripts.text: don't even think about it from now on!
scripts.translation: 以后可别再碰这些档案了！

scripts.text: As more people started using the ship and accessing the record, he must have felt embarrassed by the record filled with his not so pretty past.
scripts.translation: 看的人越来越多，他大概是觉得档案里记载的那些不光彩往事让自己丢脸了。

scripts.text: I knew he would come again. He must have heard that I am recollecting the record. I though he would come back to get rid of it again. I guess I should be more careful not to lose it.
scripts.translation: 我就知道他还会再来。他肯定听说我在重整档案了。我还以为他会回来再毁一次...看来我得小心保管。

scripts.text: Dear adventurer. since you have completed your mission, here is the reward for you. You may access all documents in the recording room freely from now on. Well then.
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，既然你完成了任务，这就是给你的奖励。从今以后，你可以自由查阅记录室里的所有文件。那就这样吧。

scripts.text: You may access all documents in the recording room freely.
scripts.translation: 你可以自由查阅记录室里的所有文件。

scripts.text: Please do not touch the books.
Which one should I read first?
The long-awaited first voyage. After unloading everything, I hope we return as full ship again...
scripts.translation: 期待已久的首次航行。卸下所有货物后，希望我们还能满载而归...

scripts.text: Business is good everywhere we go. I'm amazed by the insight of Captain Peperoncino and his crewmen.
scripts.translation: 无论到哪里，生意都很好。佩佩龙奇诺船长和他的船员真有眼光。

scripts.text: Three days since we left Port Richoli. Met a storm. It's not the first time we experienced the fickleness of mother nature, but we can't help but feel dejected when counting the losses.
scripts.translation: 离开里乔利港已经三天了。我们遭遇了风暴。虽然不是第一次领教大自然的无常，但清点损失时还是忍不住沮丧。重伤1人

scripts.text: Seriously wounded 1, mildly wounded 13, top quality anchovies 23 boxes, kaluna 7 jars, beard comb 1 box, fine fabric 200 rolls.
scripts.translation: ，轻伤13人，特级鳀鱼23箱，卡鲁纳牛奶7罐，胡须梳1箱，优质布料200卷。

scripts.text: A couple days ago we met a storm, but another one?! Who set the course this way at this time of the year? I guess I should let it go since It's the first time.
scripts.translation: 前几天刚遇到风暴，怎么又来一个？！到底是谁选了这个季节走这条航线？看在是第一次的份上，就算了吧。

scripts.text: Nothing is up. Quiet. A shoal of flying fish over the ocean cast with full moon is just spectacular to watch.
scripts.translation: 日风平浪静。满月映照下，成群飞鱼跃出海面的景象真是壮观。

scripts.text: It's great to empty out all the cargo and return with new items loaded. I feel proud, It's like the feeling you get from gleaning and dispersing the crops widely.
scripts.translation: 卸下所有货物，再装上新货满载而归，感觉真好。就像收获庄稼，再把它们播撒到各地一样，令人自豪。

scripts.text: A glass kaluna milk at a pub after receiving my paycheck is the sweetest thing in the world.
scripts.translation: 领到薪水后，在酒馆喝一杯卡鲁纳牛奶，真是世上最甜美的享受。

scripts.text: Captain Gamberry and Captain Thomas are weird. They try to keep the lead in a straight line and sail on same speed. It's like having kids walk in steps.
scripts.translation: 甘贝里船长和托马斯船长真奇怪。他们总想让船队排成直线，以相同的速度航行。简直像让一群小孩排队走路。

scripts.text: We run into storms so often that I'm wondering if we should change our course. Thank god we avoided the storm in Port Richoli.
scripts.translation: 我们遇到风暴的次数太多了，真该考虑换条航线。幸好避开了里乔利港附近的风暴。

scripts.text: The sous chef we recruited from Port Richoli is just fantastic.
scripts.translation: 我们从里乔利港招来的副厨师长真了不起。

scripts.text: We lost Butterfly to the storm we met on the second day we left Port Richoli. We were so devastated that no one was able to say anything when we returned to Lasagna.
scripts.translation: 离开里乔利港第二天遇到风暴时，“蝴蝶号”失踪了。大家悲痛欲绝，回到罗札纳时谁都说不出话来。

scripts.text: It feels like everyone will be back and smiling if I go to the port.
scripts.translation: 总觉得只要去港口看看，大家就会回来，重新露出笑容。

scripts.text: A search for Butterfly, second time. Nothing. We couldn't find any remnants of Butterfly. So they must be safe.
scripts.translation: 第二次搜寻“蝴蝶号”，还是一无所获。没找到任何残骸，也就是说，他们一定平安无事。

scripts.text: Helmsman caught tuna by fishing. Chef tried to steam the whole fish but the sous chef barely stopped him and cut into pieces for everyone. I wish I can have some more.
scripts.translation: 舵手钓到了一条金枪鱼。厨师想整条蒸，被副厨师长好不容易拦住，切成小块分给大家。真想再吃一些。

scripts.text: Tuna is served again. First day was tuna, second day was tuna pasta, third day was fried tuna, fourth day was braised tuna... I'm sick of it. Just had it. Did we do something to anger the sous chef?
scripts.translation: 又吃金枪鱼。第一天是金枪鱼，第二天是金枪鱼意面，第三天是炸金枪鱼，第四天是炖金枪鱼...我吃腻了，刚才才吃过。我们是不是惹副厨师长生气了？

scripts.text: Boatswain tried to throw out the remaining tuna and got caught by the sous chef. We all learned how scary he can be.
scripts.translation: 水手长想把剩下的金枪鱼扔掉，结果被副厨师长逮个正着。我们这才知道他有多可怕。

scripts.text: We met a storm. Everyone was well-prepared, so the damage was not huge. I guess this is what a know-how is.
scripts.translation: 遭遇风暴。幸好大家准备充分，损失不大。这大概就是经验的价值吧。

scripts.text: Boatswain is acting strangely. We barely stopped him from trying to jump into water in the middle of a night. He seems to have lost it when I see him shivering all over, but then he's fine the next morning. He's bewitched or something.
scripts.translation: 水手长最近举止怪异。半夜里他差点跳进海里，我们好不容易才拦住。那晚他浑身发抖，像是失了神，第二天早上却又恢复正常。莫非是中邪了？

scripts.text: Still searching. No news on Butterfly.
scripts.translation: 在搜寻。“蝴蝶号”仍然没有消息。

scripts.text: We never had any rats but all of a sudden the ship is infested. Upon investigation, the boatswain... you're such a...
scripts.translation: 船上从来没有老鼠，最近却突然闹起鼠患。调查后发现是水手长...你这家伙...

scripts.text: A year may pass but we cannot give up the search. We're combing through the area where we lost them.
scripts.translation: 一年过去了，我们仍不能放弃搜寻。正在仔细搜索他们失踪的那片海域。

scripts.text: I don't know why, but I don't like the feel of this.
scripts.translation: 不知为何，总觉得哪里不对劲。

scripts.text: Storm. So sick of storms. We're so used to it that we can practically ride over it.
scripts.translation: 又是风暴。真受够了。我们都习惯了，甚至几乎能在风暴中航行。

scripts.text: You turned our ship because Stello claimed to have seen something strange last night. It's a route that we've never seen before. Everyone had different opinions, but since we had looked everywhere we can, we decided to give it a try.
scripts.translation: 日斯特洛说昨晚看见了奇怪的东西，于是我们改变航向，驶上一条从未见过的路线。大家意见不一，但能找的地方都找遍了，只好试试看。

scripts.text: When we went through the dense fog that appeared suddenly, there was an island we had never seen before. There were the Butterfly crewmen, their presence natural like the natives.
scripts.translation: 穿过突然出现的浓雾后，我们发现了一座从未见过的岛。蝴蝶号的船员们也在那里，仿佛他们本来就是当地居民。

scripts.text: Where we had landed softly after being hit by huge waves is called the Soft Island. This is a mysterious place inhabited by people with different appearances. It's a discovery of a new world.
scripts.translation: 巨浪把我们推上岸后，我们平安着陆的地方被称作软岛。那里住着外貌各异的人，是个神秘的地方。我们发现了一个新世界。

scripts.text: Using Soft Island as the base, Butterfly already had a footing in the new world and was making profits. They are just born to be merchants.
scripts.translation: 蝴蝶号以软岛为基地，已经在新世界站稳脚跟，开始赚钱了。他们真是天生的商人。

scripts.text: We are on our way to Lasagna. Captain Gamberry and Captain Thomas had a long conversation.
scripts.translation: 我们正在返回罗札纳。甘贝里船长和托马斯船长谈了很久。

scripts.text: Arrived in Lasagna. Drank five glasses of kaluna milk.
scripts.translation: 抵达罗札纳。喝了五杯卡鲁纳牛奶。

scripts.text: 3 years ago: decided to set sail
We are heading to the new world loaded with supplies. I wanted to take a close look and this is a great opportunity.
scripts.translation: 我们满载补给，正驶向新世界。我一直想亲眼看看那里，这次终于有机会了。

scripts.text: Arrived in Soft Island. I don't know how we found the way in the vast open sea, but It's still amazing.
scripts.translation: 抵达软岛。不知道我们是怎么在茫茫大海中找到这里的，但这仍然令人惊叹。

scripts.text: Captain Gamberry and Captain Thomas officially announced their expansion plan to the new world. Con-Chliina will be in charge of recruiting and sending adventurers to the new world
scripts.translation: 日甘贝里船长和托马斯船长正式宣布了进军新世界的计划。康奇利娜号负责招募冒险者并将他们送往新世界

scripts.text: And Farfalle Vigilantes will be in charge of training them. With Soft Island as its base, Butterfly agreed to support adventurers. Preparation time is three years.
scripts.translation: ，法尔法雷义警团负责训练他们。蝴蝶号将以软岛为基地，为冒险者提供支援。准备时间是三年。

scripts.text: I came up with items that can be sold between the new world and Far-Star. I'm surprised at how different their tastes are. Really surprised to hear the price of Igdrasil fruit.
scripts.translation: 我想到了可以在新世界和远星之间交易的商品。两边的喜好差异真大。伊格德拉希尔果实的价格更是让我大吃一惊。

scripts.text: Sailed out from Soft Island. We'll probably come a few more times.
scripts.translation: 我们从软岛启航。以后大概还会再来几次。

scripts.text: His parents ran a butcher's shop in Lasagna.
scripts.translation: 里 -他的父母在罗札纳经营肉铺。

scripts.text: When he was young, he couldn't resist using violence to rehab hoodlum dorams. Thus, he is called the mad dog of Lasagna.
scripts.translation: 里 -年轻时，他总忍不住用暴力教训那些流氓多兰，因此得了“罗札纳疯狗”的绰号。

scripts.text: He met Peperoncino (current chief of Farfalle Vigilantes) at Pub-Oven by having disagreements over how to drink kaluna.
scripts.translation: -他在Pub-Oven与佩佩龙奇诺因卡鲁纳牛奶的喝法起了争执，两人因此相识。佩佩龙奇诺后来成了法尔法雷义警团的首领。

scripts.text: He ended up working at the anchovy workshop with Peperoncino due to the debt he incurred at this time. Gamberry was recognized for his skills and became the workshop manager.
scripts.translation: 贝里 -那次欠下债务后，他和佩佩龙奇诺一起到鳀鱼工坊工作。甘贝里的手艺得到赏识，后来当上了工坊经理。

scripts.text: They organized a merchant business with Thomas (current captain of Butterfly) who joined later.
scripts.translation: 里 -后来托马斯（现任蝴蝶号船长）也加入了他们，三人一起组建商队。

scripts.text: Having decided to expand their domain to the sea, Gamberry and Thomas gathered a fleet and sailed out, but Captain Thomas went missing in a storm.
scripts.translation: 里 -决定把事业扩展到海上后，甘贝里和托马斯集结舰队出航，但托马斯船长在风暴中失踪了。

scripts.text: Stello, Con-Chliina's first officer, discovered the sea route and finally found Butterfly that had safely reached Soft Island in the new world.
scripts.translation: 里 -康奇利娜号的大副斯特洛发现了这条航线，最终找到了已平安抵达新世界软岛的蝴蝶号。

scripts.text: Currently sails on the liner that connects Lasagna to the new world.
scripts.translation: 里 -目前担任往返罗札纳与新世界的定期航线船长。

scripts.text: Besides the fact that he grew up poor in Fusilli, nothing else is known about his early days.
scripts.translation: 奇诺 -除了知道他早年在富西利过着贫困生活，其他事情都不清楚。

scripts.text: He came to Lasagna with a grand plan to make a fortune by working on an anchovy fishing line, but gave up because of seasickness.
scripts.translation: 龙奇诺 -他怀着靠捕捞鳀鱼发大财的宏愿来到罗札纳，却因晕船而放弃了。

scripts.text: Later, he began working at an anchovy workshop.
scripts.translation: 诺 -后来，他开始在鳀鱼工坊工作。

scripts.text: He met Gamberry (current captain of Con-Chliina) at Pub-Oven by having disagreements over how to drink kaluna.
scripts.translation: -他在Pub-Oven与甘贝里（现任康奇利娜号船长）因卡鲁纳牛奶的喝法起了争执，两人因此相识。

scripts.text: He ended up working at the anchovy workshop with Gamberry due to the debt he incurred at this time.
scripts.translation: 奇诺 -因为当时欠下了债，他最后和甘贝里一起到鳀鱼工坊工作。

scripts.text: They organized a merchant business with Thomas (current captain of Butterfly) who joined later.
scripts.translation: 奇诺 -后来托马斯（现任蝴蝶号船长）加入了他们，三人一起经营起商队。

scripts.text: When Gamberry and Thomas gathered a fleet and set out, Peperoncino organized and manages to this day Farfalle Vigilantes to maintain pubic order of Lasagna.
scripts.translation: 奇诺 -甘贝里和托马斯集结舰队出海后，佩佩龙奇诺组建了法尔法雷义警团，并一直管理至今，负责维护罗札纳的治安。

scripts.text: Born as Tomei Thomas but shortened to Thomas.
scripts.translation: 斯 -本名托梅·托马斯，后来简称托马斯。

scripts.text: Native of Lasagna, brought up affluently thanks to his wealthy parents.
scripts.translation: 马斯 -他是罗札纳人，父母富有，从小过着优渥的生活。

scripts.text: Grew up with Gamberry (current captain of Con-Chliina) as childhood friends.
scripts.translation: 马斯 -他和甘贝里（现任康奇利娜号船长）从小就是朋友。

scripts.text: Worked with Gamberry and Peperoncino (current chief of Farfalle Vigilantes) at the anchovy workshop as a hobby.
scripts.translation: 马斯 -他曾把在鳀鱼工坊和甘贝里、佩佩龙奇诺（现任法尔法雷义警团首领）一起工作当作兴趣。

scripts.text: While the two spent all the money to pay off their debts, Thomas was able to save his wages. This became the initial fund for the merchant business.
scripts.translation: 托马斯 -甘贝里和佩佩龙奇诺花光所有钱偿还债务时，托马斯却攒下了工资。这笔钱成了商队的启动资金。

scripts.text: Having decided to expand their domain to the sea, Gamberry and Thomas gathered a fleet and sailed out, but Captain Thomas went missing in a storm.
scripts.translation: 托马斯 -甘贝里和托马斯决定把事业扩展到海上，于是集结舰队出航，但托马斯船长在风暴中失踪了。

scripts.text: Later, he safely arrived and settled in Soft Island of the new world. He's steadily expanding his domain.
scripts.translation: 马斯 -后来，他平安抵达新世界的软岛并在那里定居，如今仍在稳步拓展事业。

scripts.text: The place where Thomas, Peperoncino, and Gamberry met up to make agreements.
scripts.translation: Oven]托马斯、佩佩龙奇诺和甘贝里曾在这里聚会并商定合作。

scripts.text: Today, it is an adventurers' club and a memorial, a must-see place for dorams going on an adventure.
scripts.translation: -Oven]如今这里是冒险者俱乐部兼纪念馆，是准备启程冒险的多兰必访之地。

scripts.text: A beverage made by mixing kaluna and milk that three dorams drank when they met up. In their memory, it is now a festival beverage.
scripts.translation: 奶]这是一种用卡鲁纳和牛奶调制的饮料，三位多兰当年聚会时常喝。为了纪念他们，如今它成了节庆饮品。

scripts.text: Mixing is usually done by stirring or shaking, but there is never-ending argument about these two methods.
scripts.translation: 纳牛奶]通常可以搅拌或摇晃来混合，但这两种做法引发的争论从未停歇。

scripts.text: Depending on preference, one to three gooseberries can be added.
scripts.translation: 牛奶]可按个人喜好加入一到三颗鹅莓。

scripts.text: Refers to the brotherhood formed in agreement by Thomas, Peperoncino, and Gamberry.
scripts.translation: 指托马斯、佩佩龙奇诺和甘贝里达成共识后结下的兄弟情谊。

scripts.text: Known to have gone missing in a storm but later found to have safely arrived and established in the new world. After the news spread, Butterfly became widely known as the icon of adventure and heroes.
scripts.translation: 蝴蝶号]据说它曾在风暴中失踪，后来才发现它已平安抵达并在新世界建立据点。消息传开后，蝴蝶号成了冒险与英雄精神的象征。

scripts.text: Abbreviation of Lasagna Day. It is the day when Butterfly, safely arrived in the new world, was found through the discovery of a new sea route after 32 search attempts.
scripts.translation: L日]“罗札纳日”的简称。经过32次搜寻，人们发现蝴蝶号已平安抵达新世界，并在这一天开辟了新的海上航线。

scripts.text: Lasagna celebrates this day annually with magnificent fireworks and festivals.
scripts.translation: 日]罗札纳每年都会在这一天举办盛大的烟火表演和庆典。

scripts.text: It looks a lot and large. How about cutting down some?
scripts.translation: 东西又多又大。要不要精简一些？

scripts.text: 5 creases on the sail, check. Good!
What! Who broke this Pussy Willow branch!
scripts.translation: 什么！是谁折断了这根柳枝！

scripts.text: Hello, I am {0} who is on a new adventure this time. Nice to meet you.
scripts.translation: 你好，我是，这次要踏上新的冒险旅程。幸会。 {0}

scripts.text: Oh, you are the newly trained adventurer setting off on an adventure to the new continent. I am fond of an adventurous spirit. I used to travel from a place to another when I was young.
scripts.translation: 哦，你就是受训完毕、准备前往新大陆冒险的新手啊。我很欣赏冒险精神。年轻时我也到处旅行。

scripts.text: Exactly when was it? How long ago?
scripts.translation: 那是什么时候？多久以前的事了？

scripts.text: Not long ago. It feels like it happened just yesterday.
scripts.translation: 没多久以前，感觉就像昨天才发生的一样。

scripts.text: Yesterday, you were running on the deck in the middle of the night.
scripts.translation: 昨天你还半夜在甲板上跑来跑去呢。

scripts.text: Hey, I get it. It is too noisy there. You may go now.
scripts.translation: 好了，我知道了。那边太吵了，你可以走了。

scripts.text: The Sous Chef is always on the edge before sailing off. don't take it personally.
scripts.translation: 副厨师长起航前总是很紧张，别往心里去。

scripts.text: A mature Doram doesn't hold on to such things. You may go. We are about to set off.
scripts.translation: 成熟的多兰不会计较这种事。你可以走了，我们马上就要起航。

scripts.text: It is almost the time for us to sail off. You should go back.
scripts.translation: 我们快要起航了，你该回去了。

scripts.text: 5 creases on the sail, check. Good!
What! Who broke this Pussy Willow branch!
scripts.translation: 什么！是谁折断了这根柳枝！

scripts.text: You seem to be in trouble. What is the matter?
scripts.translation: 你好像遇到麻烦了，怎么回事？

scripts.text: You don't seem to be experienced enough to resolve my problem. Come back after gaining more experience.
scripts.translation: 你看起来还没什么经验，帮不了我。等你历练多些再来吧。

scripts.text: We need to take off anytime soon, and the preparation for sailing is not made properly.
scripts.translation: 我们很快就要起航了，可准备工作还没做好。

scripts.text: I don't know much about sailing, but none of those sounds relevant to the ship.
scripts.translation: 我不太懂航海，但你说的这些听起来都和船没什么关系啊。

scripts.text: It is not your business... Well, ^0000cda stranger from a new place is supposed to solve this problem^000000.
scripts.translation: 这不关你的事...不过，来自异乡的陌生人就该来解决这种问题。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I am the sailor of sailors. The real seaman. I am the boatswain of this ship who is in charge of taking care of tough sailors and all the business on the deck. The story I am about to tell you... You shouldn't tell it to anyone else.
scripts.translation: 我是水手中的水手，真正的海员。这艘船的水手长就是我，负责管好那些难缠的水手和甲板上的大小事务。我接下来要讲的故事...你可不能告诉别人。

scripts.text: Then you would learn how fearful a sailor can be.
scripts.translation: 听完你就会知道，水手有时也会怕得要命。

scripts.text: Then go back to your spot. You shouldn't expect any favors from me from now on.
scripts.translation: 那就回到你的位置上去。从今往后，别指望我会帮你。

scripts.text: Good. I like the attitude that you don't give in for threats. So do I. Well, so did I.
scripts.translation: 很好，我就喜欢你不吃威胁这一套。我以前也这样...嗯，以前是。

scripts.text: Why do you use a past tense?
Do you believe in invisible things? Like those which don't really exist? Especially the special ones that appear in the night...
scripts.translation: 你相信看不见的东西吗？那些仿佛不存在的东西？尤其是夜里出现的怪东西...

scripts.text: You are right. I had no fear. I enjoyed running into adventures and stuff. That's how I ended up in Lasagna and became the boatswain of Con-Chliina after meeting Captain Gamberi.
scripts.translation: 没错。我以前天不怕地不怕，喜欢到处冒险。后来就来到了罗札纳，遇见甘贝里船长，成了康奇利娜号的水手长。

scripts.text: I have been to everywhere. And one day, I found it.
scripts.translation: 我到过很多地方。有一天，我发现了它。

scripts.text: There are numerous islands on the sea where no one lives. Sometimes, you find a pot buried in the middle of an island.
scripts.translation: 海上有许多无人居住的岛屿，有时你会在岛中央发现一个埋起来的罐子。

scripts.text: When the ship was anchored in an unknown island to replenish water, I explored the island as I always did. And I found a ^0000cdsealed pot^000000 there.
scripts.translation: 有次船停在一座陌生岛屿上补充淡水，我像往常一样上岛探查，结果发现了一个封印的罐子。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I shook it, but there was no sound. I was wondering what was in there making no sound when it had been sealed so carefully.
scripts.translation: 我摇了摇罐子，里面一点声音也没有。封得那么严实，里面到底装了什么，竟然一点声音都没有？

scripts.text: Gamberi who came there tried to stop me, but I opened the seal. There was nothing in the ^0000cdpot^000000, and nothing happened.
scripts.translation: 甘贝里赶来阻止我，但我还是揭开了封印。罐子里什么也没有，也没有发生任何事。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I threw away the pot and got on Con-Chliina. And it happened that night.
scripts.translation: 我把罐子扔了，然后回到康奇利娜号。那天晚上，怪事就发生了。

scripts.text: Oh, I guess we are getting into the good part. I really like it.
scripts.translation: 哦，精彩的部分要来了吧？我最喜欢听这个了。

scripts.text: Oh the night, I listened to this song. I could hear it anywhere. I could hear is from the creases in my palm, near my ear and the silver waves.
scripts.translation: 那天夜里，我听见了一首歌。无论走到哪里都能听见，掌心的纹路里、耳边，甚至银色的海浪中都传来歌声。

scripts.text: It felt like I could grab the tune with my hand. When I was walking, following the sound, someone shook me hard. The next thing I noticed was that I was being held by the crews just before jumping off the ship.
scripts.translation: 那旋律仿佛伸手就能抓住。我跟着声音走时，有人用力摇醒了我。回过神来才发现，自己正被船员们拉住，差点就跳下船了。

scripts.text: I thought so. I went to sleep with my ears closed. The strange thing is that it happened again the next day and the day after.
scripts.translation: 我当时也这么想，就捂着耳朵睡了。可第二天、第三天晚上，同样的事又发生了。

scripts.text: Every night, I saw a dim silhouette or couldn't fall asleep because of the chattering noise in my ear. When I did fall asleep, I felt this weight on my body and woke up, covered in cold sweats.
scripts.translation: 每到夜里，我都能看见模糊的身影，或被耳边的窃窃私语吵得睡不着。好不容易睡着后，又觉得身上压着什么，惊醒时浑身冷汗。

scripts.text: The pot turned out to be a pot in which an evil ghost has been sealed. Gamberi knew it and tried to stop me. However, it was too late. I had already broken the seal. I grew up in the land, and did not know about that at all.
scripts.translation: 那个罐子里原来封着一个恶灵。甘贝里知道这件事，才想阻止我。可一切都太迟了，我已经破坏了封印。我从小在内陆长大，根本不知道这些。

scripts.text: I have been suffering from ^0000cdthe supernatural phenomenon^000000 ever since.
scripts.translation: 从那以后，我就一直被超自然现象折磨。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: You mean whatever in there has cursed you, right?
scripts.translation: 你的意思是，罐子里的东西诅咒了你？

scripts.text: Gamberi took me to the Shaman meow to get a counselling, but it didn't work. This evil ghost is too old, strong and possessive to be removed.
scripts.translation: 甘贝里带我去找萨满喵求助，却没用。这个恶灵太古老、太强大，执念也太深，根本无法驱除。

scripts.text: The only thing I could do was to weaken it as much as possible each day.
scripts.translation: 我唯一能做的，就是每天尽量削弱它。

scripts.text: Is depending on all kinds of superstitions the way to weaken it?
scripts.translation: 靠各种迷信来削弱它吗？

scripts.text: No other crews of Con-Chliina, except Captain Gamberi and I, know about this.
scripts.translation: 康奇利娜号上除了甘贝里船长和我，没有其他人知道这件事。

scripts.text: The ^0000cdShaman meow^000000 has told me a riddle that a stranger from a new place will solve this problem. It is not a coincidence that we have met.
scripts.translation: 萨满喵告诉我，有个谜题说，来自异乡的陌生人会解决这个问题。我们相遇绝非偶然。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Please go and tell this story to the Shaman meow and bring me the remedy. I'll do anything for you if you get rid of it.
scripts.translation: 请把这个故事告诉萨满喵，再带回能治好我的东西。只要你能帮我摆脱它，我什么都愿意做。

scripts.text: The Boatswain of Con-Chliina doesn't lie. If you don't trust me, you should trust Gamberi who has hired me as the Boatswain of Con-Chliina.
scripts.translation: 康奇利娜号的水手长从不撒谎。你要是不信我，就去相信雇我当水手长的甘贝里吧。

scripts.text: The Shaman meow lives in a secluded place near the entrance of the village.
scripts.translation: 萨满喵住在村庄入口附近一处僻静的地方。

scripts.text: Shaman meow is living in a secluded place at the entrance of Lasagna. I hope that a stranger from a new place like you take care of my problem.
scripts.translation: 萨满喵住在罗札纳入口附近一处僻静的地方。希望你这个来自异乡的陌生人能帮我解决麻烦。

scripts.text: Dear adventurer, did you meet Shaman meow?
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，见到萨满喵了吗？

scripts.text: [You told the Boatswain the story you had heard from Shaman meow.]
scripts.translation: [你把从萨满喵那里听来的故事告诉了水手长。]

scripts.text: What? I should become a Shaman meow? What a nonsense! I am a sailor! I shall die on the sea as a sailor!
scripts.translation: 什么？我要变成萨满喵？简直胡说八道！我是水手！我这辈子都要当水手，最后也要葬身大海！

scripts.text: I'd rather spend the rest of life fighting than living with the ghosts!
scripts.translation: 我宁可余生都在战斗，也不愿和幽灵为伍！

scripts.text: Shaman meow is not as bad as you think. Why don't you go get a counseling when you have time.
scripts.translation: 萨满喵没你想的那么糟。有空的话，去找他聊聊吧。

scripts.text: I'll just pretend you didn't say that! I don't give a damn about a Shaman meow saying those malicious things!
scripts.translation: 我就当没听见！我才不在乎萨满喵说的那些恶毒话！

scripts.text: The evil ghost will absorb the life out of you. You won't last many days like this, dear Boatswain.
scripts.translation: 恶灵会吸走你的生命。亲爱的水手长，你这样下去可撑不了几天。

scripts.text: You can survive through a day with a ^0000cddaily amulet^000000. I guess you should be closer to the Shaman meow now.
scripts.translation: 带着每日护符就能撑过一天。我想你现在该更信任萨满喵了。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: And today's amulet is ^0000cd20 Basils and 5 Basilrocks^000000. You can get them from the basilisks.
scripts.translation: 今天的护符需要20片罗勒叶和5块罗勒石。可以去找巴西利斯克收集。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Ba... Basilisks... Out of the frying pan into the fire. I don't like to deal with those dirty things.
scripts.translation: 巴...巴西利斯克...这简直是才出狼窝又入虎口。我可不想和那些脏东西打交道。

scripts.text: Well, That's it from me. I should get going...
scripts.translation: 好了，我就说到这儿。我得走了...

scripts.text: Yeah, the stranger taking care of this problem. It must have been our destiny.
scripts.translation: 没错。你就是那个能解决我麻烦的异乡人。我们相遇一定是命运安排的。

scripts.text: Actually, it meant that you would die and the evil ghost would find a new host.
scripts.translation: 其实那意思是，你会死掉，然后恶灵再找一个宿主。

scripts.text: No, no, never. You cannot get out of this like that. ^0000cdIt must have been our destiny.^000000 It is a fate! You should help me.
scripts.translation: 不，不，绝对不行！你不能就这么推脱。这一定是命运安排的。是命运！你得帮我。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: ...Well, just as I heard from Shaman meow. I was told that the Boatswain would make me do it.
scripts.translation: ...好吧，正如萨满喵所说，我早就知道水手长会让我帮忙。

scripts.text: That Shaman meow sure seems to have the vision. I am a believer now. I believe the amulet is really effective. Please go get me one now. Please.
scripts.translation: 萨满喵好像真的有预知能力。我现在信他了，也相信护符确实有效。拜托，现在就帮我弄一个！

scripts.text: OK, I can't help it. Just for today.
scripts.translation: 好吧，我也没办法。就帮你这一次。

scripts.text: Today's amulet is 20 Basils and 5 Basilrocks! The sun will go down anytime soon!
scripts.translation: 今天的护符需要20片罗勒叶和5块罗勒石！太阳马上就要下山了！

scripts.text: Here are the Basil and Basilrock.
scripts.translation: 罗勒叶和罗勒石都在这里。

scripts.text: Argh... Give it to me. No, no. Not like that. Just wrap it a little so that no one can see. Right. Like that. Give me all you have.
scripts.translation: 啊...给我。等等，不是这样。稍微包起来，别让人看见。对，就这样。把你带来的都给我。

scripts.text: It feels like the black fog neat me is lifting! I don't hear the whispering sound anymore! My head feels so clear in a long time.
scripts.translation: 我身边的黑雾好像散了！耳边也没有低语声了！我的头脑好久没有这么清醒过了。

scripts.text: It is unfair that I haven't known about this method so far!
scripts.translation: 我竟然到现在才知道这个办法，真是太不公平了！

scripts.text: It only lasts a day. When it expires, it will be burnt up. I guess you should be close to Shaman meow from now on.
scripts.translation: 护符只能维持一天，到期后就会烧掉。我看你以后还是多去找萨满喵吧。

scripts.text: No, never. I don't intend to be friends with Shaman meow or hunt the basilisks myself.
scripts.translation: 不，绝不！我才不要和萨满喵做朋友，更不会自己去猎杀巴西利斯克。

scripts.text: What are you going to do then?
Well, don't I have the ^0000cdnew helper^000000 in front of me?
scripts.translation: 这不就有个新帮手在我面前吗？ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I will reward you handsomely. However, you haven't been able to solve the problem permanently so I don't have to keep the promise I have made.
scripts.translation: 我会好好报答你。不过，你还没彻底解决问题，所以之前答应你的事就不算数了。

scripts.text: I will reward you handsomely. Please do me another favor tomorrow.
scripts.translation: 我会好好报答你。明天再帮我一次吧。

scripts.text: We will see. I'll come back if I want to.
scripts.translation: 再说吧。我想来的时候自然会来。

scripts.text: Oh, you would come. I have a hunch.
I am pretty sure that it is the evil ghost talking to you.
scripts.translation: 我很确定，那是恶灵在跟你说话。

scripts.text: I'll let it slide since you have done me a favor. I'll see you again tomorrow.
scripts.translation: 看在你帮过我的份上，这次就算了。明天见。

scripts.text: Did you bring the amulet for today? You seem to be empty-handed. Is there anything wrong?
scripts.translation: 今天的护符带来了吗？看你两手空空的，出什么事了？

scripts.text: Please give it to me now. I feel the power of the amulet fading away now.
scripts.translation: 快给我吧，我感觉护符的力量正在消退。

scripts.text: This is the amulet for today! Give me all the Basilrocks you have.
scripts.translation: 今天的护符就是这个！把你带来的罗勒石都给我。

scripts.text: It feels like watching the blue horizon on a clear and windless day. It is refreshing.
scripts.translation: 感觉就像在晴朗无风的日子眺望蓝色海平线，真清爽。

scripts.text: It feels like watching the clouds go by lying on my back on a green hill.
scripts.translation: 感觉就像躺在绿草坡上，仰望云朵飘过。

scripts.text: It feels like seeing the sunshine through the black fog.
scripts.translation: 感觉就像透过黑雾看见了阳光。

scripts.text: Thank you for getting them for me. Please come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你帮我找来这些东西。明天再来吧。

scripts.text: You said you would come if you wanted to.
scripts.translation: 你说过，想来的时候就会来。

scripts.text: The amulet is still effective. Go to see Shamanyang after ^0000cd4:00 am^000000 and bring me tomorrow's amulet.
scripts.translation: 护符的效果还在。凌晨4:00以后去找萨玛尼扬，再把明天的护符带给我。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: You said you would come if you wanted to.
scripts.translation: 你说过，想来的时候就会来。

scripts.text: However, you shouldn't have come to me. You should have gone to ^0000cdShamanyang^000000 and asked about today's amulet.
scripts.translation: 不过你不该来找我。去找萨玛尼扬，问问今天的护符吧。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I am counting on you then.
It looks a lot and large. How about cutting down some?
scripts.translation: 东西又多又大。要不要精简一些？

scripts.text: We can go anywhere if we have the wind and the sail.
scripts.translation: 只要有风和帆，我们就能驶向任何地方。

scripts.text: Hello, I am {0} who is on a new adventure this time. Nice to meet you.
scripts.translation: 你好，我是，这次要踏上新的冒险旅程。幸会。 {0}

scripts.text: Oh, you are the newly trained adventurer setting off on an adventure to the new continent. I am fond of an adventurous spirit. I used to travel from a place to another when I was young.
scripts.translation: 哦，你就是受训完毕、准备前往新大陆冒险的新手啊。我很欣赏冒险精神。年轻时我也到处旅行。

scripts.text: Exactly when was it? How long ago?
scripts.translation: 那是什么时候的事？多久以前了？

scripts.text: Not long ago. It feels like it happened just yesterday.
scripts.translation: 没多久以前，感觉就像昨天才发生的一样。

scripts.text: Yesterday, you were running on the deck in the middle of the night.
scripts.translation: 昨天你还半夜在甲板上跑来跑去呢。

scripts.text: Hey, I get it. It is too noisy there. You may go now.
scripts.translation: 好了，我知道了。那边太吵了，你可以走了。

scripts.text: The Sous Chef is always on the edge before sailing off. don't take it personally.
scripts.translation: 副厨师长起航前总是很紧张，别往心里去。

scripts.text: A mature Doram doesn't hold on to such things. You may go. We are about to set off.
scripts.translation: 成熟的多兰不会计较这种小事。你可以走了，我们马上就要起航。

scripts.text: The Sous Chef believes that it brings bad luck to have a stranger while cooking. You should go now.
scripts.translation: 副厨师长觉得做饭时有陌生人在场会带来厄运。你先离开吧。

scripts.text: We can go anywhere if we have the wind and the sail.
scripts.translation: 只要有风和帆，我们就能驶向任何地方。

scripts.text: Take your filthy hand off from her! [Woncow] is sensitive, so no one besides me can touch her!
scripts.translation: 把你的脏手从她身上拿开！[赢牛]很敏感，除了我，谁都不许碰她！

scripts.text: So? What! I won her on a bet. Every time I call her name, it reminds me of that moment of victory. It's beautiful.
scripts.translation: 那又怎样！我打赌赢了她。每次叫她的名字，我都会想起当时获胜的情景，多美好啊。

scripts.text: Anyway, why is there a cow on this ship?
scripts.translation: 话说，这艘船上为什么会有奶牛？

scripts.text: Why? Because we want to drink fresh milk every day!
scripts.translation: 当然是为了每天都能喝到新鲜牛奶！

scripts.text: You brought a cow on board for fresh milk?
scripts.translation: 你为了喝新鲜牛奶，特地把奶牛带上船？

scripts.text: The boatswain can't leave her side for a second because she's his goddess of fortune. Lucky for us, we can have kaluna milk every day.
scripts.translation: 水手长一刻也离不开她，因为她是他的幸运女神。多亏了她，我们每天都能喝到卡鲁纳牛奶。

scripts.text: Hey! Keep talking and you'll jinx it!
scripts.translation: 喂！再说下去会招来厄运的！

scripts.text: It looks a lot and large. How about cutting down some?
scripts.translation: 东西又多又大。要不要切掉一些？

scripts.text: It is going to be the time to eat soon. I should hurry up.
scripts.translation: 快到开饭时间了，我得加快速度。

scripts.text: Hello, I am {0} who is on a new adventure this time. Nice to meet you.
scripts.translation: 你好，我是，这次要踏上新的冒险旅程。幸会。 {0}

scripts.text: Oh, you are the newly trained adventurer setting off on an adventure to the new continent. I am fond of an adventurous spirit. I used to travel from a place to another when I was young.
scripts.translation: 哦，你就是受训完毕、准备前往新大陆冒险的新手啊。我很欣赏冒险精神。年轻时我也到处旅行。

scripts.text: Exactly when was it? How long ago?
scripts.translation: 那是什么时候的事？多久以前了？

scripts.text: Not long ago. It feels like it happened just yesterday.
scripts.translation: 没多久以前，感觉就像昨天才发生的一样。

scripts.text: Yesterday, you were running on the deck in the middle of the night.
scripts.translation: 昨天你还半夜在甲板上跑来跑去呢。

scripts.text: Hey, I get it. It is too noisy there. You may go now.
scripts.translation: 好了，我知道了。那边太吵了，你可以走了。

scripts.text: The Sous Chef is always on the edge before sailing off. don't take it personally.
scripts.translation: 副厨师长起航前总是很紧张，别往心里去。

scripts.text: A mature Doram doesn't hold on to such things. You may go. We are about to set off.
scripts.translation: 成熟的多兰不会计较这种小事。你可以走了，我们马上就要起航。

scripts.text: Ask the Purser when the sailing sign will be issued. Depending on the time, we need to either change the ingredients or replenish them.
scripts.translation: 去问问事务长什么时候发出起航信号。看时间安排，我们可能得更换或补充食材。

scripts.text: Keep it short. I am busy.
What are you doing? Is it a new way to get yourself killed? I am not afraid of challenges. Draw your weapon.
scripts.translation: 你在干什么？想用新花样找死吗？我可不怕挑战。拔出武器！

scripts.text: I don't mean.... I don't mean... That...
scripts.translation: 我不是那个意思...我不是...那个...

scripts.text: You tiny rat! Now tell me. I don't think a rookie like you would come up with this on your own. Who sent you here?
scripts.translation: 你这小老鼠！说吧。我不信你这种新人能自己想出这种事。是谁派你来的？

scripts.text: Sous Chef! I think this guy's telling the truth. It is ordered by you, right?
scripts.translation: 副厨师长！我觉得他没说谎。这是您吩咐的吧？

scripts.text: ^0000cdKahlugnag^000000? That Eggring! He made this newbie do this and pull off a prank! Hey, I am sorry. Please accept my apology.
scripts.translation: 卡鲁纳牛奶？那个蛋仔！他让这个新人来捉弄我！喂，真对不起，请接受我的道歉。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I'll make sure to tell him to say sorry to you. He is such a trouble. He will always be nothing but a sailor boy.
scripts.translation: 我会让他向你道歉的。他真会惹麻烦，永远都只是个小水手。

scripts.text: I mean making it, not eating it.
Eh, I have never tried it, but I believe I would like it.
scripts.translation: 呃，我还没试过，不过我想我会喜欢的。

scripts.text: When you come back later, ^0000cdI'll teach you how to cook^000000. It is my way of saying sorry. Well, you may go now.
scripts.translation: 你下次回来时，我教你做菜，算是向你赔罪。好了，你可以走了。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Hey newbie! Ask the Purser when we will be sailing off on your way. I think something has gone wrong since there is no sign so far.
scripts.translation: 嘿，新人！路上记得问问事务长我们什么时候起航。到现在还没信号，我看是出问题了。

scripts.text: It is going to be the time to eat soon. I should hurry up.
scripts.translation: 快到开饭时间了，我得加快速度。

scripts.text: Are you here to learn how to cook?
If you want to learn how to cook, come to see me anytime.
scripts.translation: 想学做菜的话，随时可以来找我。

scripts.text: You don't seem to be a novice anymore. I cannot teach you any further since I am too busy. If you want to explore the world of cooking more, you should find someone else.
scripts.translation: 你看起来已经不是新手了。我太忙，没法继续教你。想进一步学习烹饪的话，去找别人吧。

scripts.text: I have heard that there is someone who teaches how to cook in the palace of the new continent. It would be a good idea to check out.
scripts.translation: 听说新大陆的宫殿里有人教烹饪，有机会可以去看看。

scripts.text: Good food can ^0000cdraise a certain status^000000 and ^0000cdrecover HP^000000. There is no reason not to cook and eat.
scripts.translation: 美味的料理可以提升特定能力，还能恢复HP。没有理由不学着做来吃啊。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: There are two main functions of cooking.
There are six types of cooking. Each enhances ^0000cdStr, Agi, Vit, Int, Dex or Luk^000000. The amount of status enhancement depends on the level of cooking.
scripts.translation: 料理有六种，分别可以提升力量、敏捷、体质、智力、灵巧或幸运。能力提升幅度取决于料理等级。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Secondly, it ^0000cdrecovers HP and SP^000000. The amount of recovery also depends on the level of cooking, and some food only recovers HP.
scripts.translation: 第二种是恢复HP和SP。恢复量也取决于料理等级，而且有些料理只能恢复HP。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: In order to cook such dishes, you need to make some preparation.
scripts.translation: 要做这些料理，得先准备好食材和工具。

scripts.text: There are two steps for the preparation.

scripts.translation: 第一，你需要一本烹饪书。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: You need a Cookbook to learn how to prepare the ingredients and cook. You can get this Cookbook from a ^0000cdquest^000000 or a ^0000cdmonster^000000.
scripts.translation: 你得用烹饪书学习如何处理食材和烹饪。烹饪书可以通过任务或从魔物身上获得。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Once you get a Cookbook, you need to collect the ^0000cdingredients^000000. It doesn't help to lick the pages if the Cookbook without preparing the ingredients. Even the eggrings know better than that.
scripts.translation: 拿到烹饪书后，还得收集食材。光舔书页可做不出料理，得先备好食材。连蛋黄波利都懂这个道理。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: You can get the ingredients from the ^0000cdmonsters^000000 or the ^0000cdIngredient Merchants^000000. Although it takes quite a preparation to cook, the effectiveness is worth it.
scripts.translation: 食材可以从魔物身上取得，也可以向食材商人购买。准备料理虽然费些工夫，但效果值得。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Oh, by the way, you need to know that ^0000cdcooking may fail^000000. The chance of failure depends on the cooking utensils you have and the level of your cooking.
scripts.translation: 对了，烹饪也有失败的可能。失败率取决于你使用的炊具和烹饪等级。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Well then, Let's start cooking. Talk to me again when you are ready!
scripts.translation: 好了，开始做菜吧！准备好后再来找我。

scripts.text: Let's see. Did you bring all the ingredients?
scripts.translation: 我看看...食材都带齐了吗？

scripts.text: Go hunting after eating this. You won't believe the newfound power in you.
scripts.translation: 吃完这个再去打猎吧。你会惊讶于自己获得的新力量。

scripts.text: If you eat this, you can move much faster than others. Even faster than a hummingbird flapping its wings.
scripts.translation: 吃了这个，你的移动速度会比别人快得多，甚至超过振翅飞行的蜂鸟。

scripts.text: don't you feel the mysterious power pumping through your vessels already? You cannot resist it!
scripts.translation: 难道你还没感觉到神秘力量在血管中奔涌吗？你会无法抵挡它的！

scripts.text: You will become more skillful when you have a bite of this.
scripts.translation: 吃一口这个，你的技巧就会更加娴熟。

scripts.text: Are you ready? Action speaks louder than words! Let's start cooking!
scripts.translation: 准备好了吗？光说不练可不行！开始做菜吧！

scripts.text: Actually, you need the recipe and the cooking utensils, but it could be too complicated for a novice. I'll make one for you this time. We shouldn't waste the ingredients, you know.
scripts.translation: 其实你得准备烹饪书和炊具，不过对新手来说可能太复杂了。这次我替你做好吧，可别浪费食材。

scripts.text: Since it is a trial version for novice, it has the same effect as level 1 food, but ^0000cdit doesn't last as long.^000000
scripts.translation: 这是给新手的试用料理，效果和1级料理一样，不过持续时间较短。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: What kind of food do you like to eat? Since Int or Luk dishes won't do much good for you, you can make four kinds of dishes for now.
scripts.translation: 你喜欢吃什么？智力或幸运类料理对你帮助不大，所以目前可以做下面四种。

scripts.text: ^0000cdFragrant Seasoned Herbs^000000. It enhances ^0000cdStr^000000. The people who use a lot of physical strength eat this.
scripts.translation: 香气调味草能提升力量。经常需要出力的人都会吃它。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: The ingredients are ^0000cd1 Clover, 1 Green Herb and 1 Red Herb^000000.
scripts.translation: 需要的食材是1个三叶草、1个绿色药草和1个红色药草。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: You can get Clovers and Red Herbs from Leaf Lunatic or Grass Fabre in the field outside.
scripts.translation: 外面的野地里，群叶疯兔和草地绿棉虫都会掉落三叶草和红色药草。

scripts.text: You can get Green Herbs from Grass Fabre.
scripts.translation: 草地绿棉虫会掉落绿色药草。

scripts.text: If you bring all the ingredients, we can cook. Hurry up.
scripts.translation: 食材带齐了就能开做，快去收集吧。

scripts.text: The^0000cd Crunchy Salad^000000! I really like this dish. You have a good taste.
scripts.translation: 爽脆沙拉！这可是我最喜欢的料理，你很有眼光。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: The Crunchy Salad enhances ^0000cdAgi^000000. The people who wants to attack faster or who doesn't want to get hit tend to eat it.
scripts.translation: 爽脆沙拉能提升敏捷。想加快攻击速度或避免被击中的人都爱吃。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: The ingredients are ^0000cd1 Apple and 2 Carrots^000000.
scripts.translation: 需要的食材是1个苹果和2根胡萝卜。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: You can get Apples from the Eggring jumping in the outer field of Izlude.
scripts.translation: 依斯鲁得岛外围的野地里，蛋黄波利会掉落苹果。

scripts.text: You can get the Carrots from Leaf Lunatic.
scripts.translation: 群叶疯兔会掉落胡萝卜。

scripts.text: If you bring all the ingredients, we can cook!
The ^0000cd Mixed Stew.^000000 It enhances ^0000cdVit^000000. It really fills you up so you don't feel mush pain even when you are hit by the monster.
scripts.translation: 什锦炖菜能提升体质。吃下去很有饱足感，被魔物打中时也不会觉得那么疼。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: The ingredients are ^0000cd1 Jellopy , 1 Fluff, and 1 Feather^000000.
scripts.translation: 需要的食材是1个杰勒比结晶、1个绒毛和1根羽毛。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: You can get Jellopies from the Eggring jumping in the outer field.
scripts.translation: 外围野地里的蛋黄波利会掉落杰勒比结晶。

scripts.text: You can get Fluffs from Grass Fabre or Leaf Lunatic.
scripts.translation: 草地绿棉虫或群叶疯兔都会掉落绒毛。

scripts.text: You can get Feathers from Grass Fabre or Leaf Lunatic.
scripts.translation: 草地绿棉虫或群叶疯兔都会掉落羽毛。

scripts.text: If you bring all the ingredients, we can cook. Hurry up.
scripts.translation: 食材带齐了就能开做，快去收集吧。

scripts.text: The ^0000cdBaked Gold Apple^000000. It is hard to resist the golden hue on its surface.
scripts.translation: 烤金苹果。表面烤出的金色光泽，让人难以抗拒。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: It enhances ^0000cdDex^000000. The ones who'd like to raise the Hit tend to eat this.
scripts.translation: 它能提升灵巧。想提高命中率的人都喜欢吃。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: The ingredients are ^0000cd1 Apple and 1 Clover^000000.
scripts.translation: 需要的食材是1个苹果和1个三叶草。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: You can get Apples from the Eggring in the outer field.
scripts.translation: 外围的野地里，蛋黄波利会掉落苹果。

scripts.text: You can get Clovers from Grass Fabre or Leaf Lunatic.
scripts.translation: 草地绿棉虫和群叶疯兔都会掉落三叶草。

scripts.text: If you bring all the ingredients, we can cook. Hurry up.
scripts.translation: 食材带齐了就能开做，快去收集吧。

scripts.text: I need someone to ask a favor. You don't seem experienced enough.
scripts.translation: 我正想找人帮忙，不过你看起来经验还不够。

scripts.text: I told you not to enter the kitchen like that... Oh... Are you from the new continent?
scripts.translation: 我不是说过别那样闯进厨房吗...咦...你是从新大陆来的吗？

scripts.text: I see you around often these days. You look so strange. The face without any whiskers and the butt with no tail.
scripts.translation: 最近常看到你。你长得真奇怪，脸上没胡须，屁股后面也没尾巴。

scripts.text: Please excuse me. I am the Sous Chef in charge of this kitchen.
scripts.translation: 幸会，我是负责这间厨房的副厨师长。

scripts.text: I told you not to enter the kitchen like that... Oh... You seem familiar...
scripts.translation: 我不是说过别那样闯进厨房吗...咦...你看起来有点面熟...

scripts.text: Hello. I am an adventurer {0} who has set off on an adventure on Con-Killina.
scripts.translation: 你好，我是，正搭乘康奇利娜号踏上新的冒险旅程。 {0}

scripts.text: Is that so? Let me introduce myself. I am the Sous Chef in charge of this kitchen.
scripts.translation: 是吗？那我自我介绍一下。我是负责这间厨房的副厨师长。

scripts.text: How about the Head Chef? Why is the Sous Chef in charge of the kitchen?
scripts.translation: 那主厨呢？为什么是您负责厨房？

scripts.text: Look over there. The man sleeping on the floor who seems so far from being a gentleman. ^0000cdHe is our Head Chef^000000. The captain has always said how we have to do our best at what we do. But no use.
scripts.translation: 看那边。地板上那个睡得正香、一点也不像绅士的男人，就是我们的主厨。船长总说大家要尽力做好分内的事，可他根本不听。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Do you know what is the most important thing in cooking? It is the endless passion and pursuit of the best taste. Nevertheless, our Head Chef has no interest in such things.
scripts.translation: 你知道烹饪最重要的是什么吗？是对美味永无止境的热情与追求。可我们的主厨对此毫无兴趣。
