scripts.text: However, he is very good at making enough servings to feed a number of people in a short time. That is why he has become the Head Chef. But when people started complaining about the taste, I was called in.
scripts.translation: 不过，他很擅长在短时间内做出足够多的饭菜，因此当上了主厨。后来大家开始抱怨味道，我才被叫来帮忙。

scripts.text: Ever since, the Head Chef entrusted me with everything.
scripts.translation: 从那以后，主厨就把一切都交给我了。

scripts.text: I believe the people of the new continent eat different food from us. What do the people find delicious in the new continent?
scripts.translation: 新大陆的人吃的东西应该和我们不一样吧？他们觉得什么样的料理最好吃呢？

scripts.text: I'd like to go out there and taste each dish. However, if I do, the crews of this ship will starve to death.
scripts.translation: 我也想亲自去尝尝各种料理。可我要是走了，这艘船上的人就得饿肚子。

scripts.text: Hum, there are many kinds of food. We also hunt the ingredients and cook. There are many things for sure...
scripts.translation: 嗯，那里有很多种食物。大家会自己打猎收集食材再烹饪，种类可多了...

scripts.text: I happen to have a ^0000cdCookbook of the new continent^000000. Do you have any of the ingredients for the food now?
scripts.translation: 我正好有一本新大陆烹饪书。你现在有书里提到的食材吗？ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Well, then let me ask you a favor. Please bring me some of the ingredients in this ^0000cdCookbook^000000. This thing called ^0000cdMastela Fruit Wine^000000... I am curious about this, but it requires some ingredients which are not found here.
scripts.translation: 那就帮我个忙吧。请按照这本烹饪书，带些食材回来。比如这种叫玛丝黛拉果酒的料理，我很想尝尝，可它需要一些本地没有的食材。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: And please get me some ^0000cdCat Hardtacks made by the Head Chef of Navi^000000 as well. I have heard that it doesn't taste good, but it is nutritious and easy to store.
scripts.translation: 另外，也请帮我弄一些纳维号主厨制作的猫干粮。我听说它虽然不好吃，但营养丰富又方便保存。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Please bring me ^0000cd4 Mastela Fruit and 1 Cat Hardtack^000000.
scripts.translation: 请带来4个玛丝黛拉果实和1份猫干粮。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: If you bring them to me, I'll reward you handsomely.
scripts.translation: 带来的话，我会给你丰厚的报酬。

scripts.text: Well then. I am counting on you.
What happened to the favor I asked you. 4 Mastela Fruit and 1 Cat Hardtacks.
scripts.translation: 我拜托你的事办得怎么样了？4个玛丝黛拉果实和1份猫干粮。

scripts.text: You have brought them so fast. I can challenge making new cuisines with these. My heart is pounding so hard.
scripts.translation: 你带得真快！有了这些，我就能试做新料理了。真让人兴奋。

scripts.text: May I ask more favors next time? You know, the ingredients.
scripts.translation: 下次还能再拜托你带些食材吗？

scripts.text: Let me drop by when I get time.
It hasn't been long since you left. Have you got them already? Or have you forgotten what I have asked you for?
scripts.translation: 你刚离开没多久，已经拿到了吗？还是忘了我让你带什么？

scripts.text: ^0000cd20 Buns^000000. In order to keep them fresh, you should hurry up.
scripts.translation: 20个包子。为了保证新鲜，快点带来。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Oh, this is the Bun... It sure is hot and huge. This is totally different from that of our side.
scripts.translation: 哦，这就是包子...又热又大，和我们这边的包子完全不同。

scripts.text: Thank you for bringing them to me. Thanks to you, the food of Lasagna can take another step forward.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你把包子带来。多亏了你，罗札纳的料理又向前迈进了一步。

scripts.text: It hasn't been long since you left. Have you got them already? Or have you forgotten what I have asked you for?
scripts.translation: 你刚离开没多久，已经拿到了吗？还是忘了我让你带什么？

scripts.text: Bring ^0000cd5 Cat Hardtacks and 5 Malangdo Canned Food^000000. Please hurry up.
scripts.translation: 带5份猫干粮和5罐绵绵岛罐头来，快一点。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Cat Hardtack and Malangdo Canned Food... Well, they will last long enough.
scripts.translation: 猫干粮和绵绵岛罐头...嗯，都能保存很久。

scripts.text: Thank you form getting them for me. Now Con-Chliina can come up with our own ways to store food for a long time.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你帮我找来这些。这样康奇利娜号也能研究自己的食物长期保存方法了。

scripts.text: It hasn't been long since you left. Have you got them already? Or have you forgotten what I have asked you for?
scripts.translation: 你刚离开没多久，已经拿到了吗？还是忘了我让你带什么？

scripts.text: You should bring ^0000cd20 ice cubes^000000. It is to keep the stored food fresh. Please hurry up.
scripts.translation: 请带来20块冰块，给储存的食物保鲜。快一点。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: The ice cubes. I am just so excited to see them. The ice cubes that don't melt! It sure is the new continent.
scripts.translation: 冰块！真想快点看看。永不融化的冰块！这就是新大陆啊。

scripts.text: Thank you for bringing them to me. Thanks to you, the crews of Con-Chliina can have some fresh food.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你把冰块带来。多亏了你，康奇利娜号的船员也能吃到新鲜食物了。

scripts.text: What brought you here? Is it about the favor yesterday?
scripts.translation: 有什么事？是昨天拜托你的那件事吗？

scripts.text: Since I am on duty, I cannot proceed with any personal study of cooking. Come back after the break of day.
scripts.translation: 我现在值班，没法做自己的烹饪研究。等我休息时再来吧。

scripts.text: Just in time. I just have a moment to spare and I'd like to keep working on my study of the cuisine in the new continent. Would you get some ingredients for me?
scripts.translation: 来得正好，我刚好有点空，想继续研究新大陆的料理。能帮我找些食材吗？

scripts.text: What I need to day is the ^0000cdBun^000000. We have something similar in Lasagna, but the recipe is totally different.
scripts.translation: 我今天想要的是包子。罗札纳也有类似的食物，不过做法完全不同。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I'd like to know how it is made. Please bring me some. ^0000cd20 Buns^000000 would do.
scripts.translation: 我想知道包子是怎么做的，带一些给我吧。20个包子就够了。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: What I need to day are the ^0000cdCat Hardtack and Malangdo Canned Food^000000. I am curious how the crews of Navi survived through such a long voyage.
scripts.translation: 我今天想要猫干粮和绵绵岛罐头。真好奇纳维号的船员是怎么熬过漫长航程的。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I'd like to know how they are made. Please bring me some. ^0000cd5 Cat Hardtacks and 5 Malangdo Canned Food^000000 would do.
scripts.translation: 我想知道猫干粮和罐头是怎么做的，请各带一些来。5份猫干粮和5罐绵绵岛罐头就够了。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I need ^0000cdIce Cubes^000000 today. I have heard that the Ice Cubes from this one cave doesn't melt even in the middle of summer.
scripts.translation: 今天我需要冰块。听说某个洞穴里的冰块盛夏也不会融化。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: If we had those, we could keep food fresh and drink cold Kahlugna Milk anytime. ^0000cd20 Ice Cubes^000000 would do, Thank you.
scripts.translation: 有了冰块，食物就能保鲜，卡鲁纳牛奶也能随时冰镇。20块冰就够了，谢谢。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: What do you expect me to do without the ingredients?
scripts.translation: 没有食材，你还想让我做什么？

scripts.text: Oh, you have brought them all! Let me cook them for you right away.
scripts.translation: 哦，东西都带齐了！我马上做给你吃。

scripts.text: The adventurer from the new continent. What brought you here? Do you need help?
scripts.translation: 来自新大陆的冒险者啊。来这里有什么事？需要帮忙吗？

scripts.text: I heard that we couldn't set off because of the fog. I am here to check the condition of the dragon inside the cave.
scripts.translation: 我听说大雾导致船无法起航，所以来看看洞穴里那条龙的情况。

scripts.text: Are you going to do that yourself?
The fog is covering the sky. The ^0000cdpatrol^000000 hasn't returned yet, so it may take some time.
scripts.translation: 浓雾遮住了天空。巡逻队还没回来，可能还要等一会儿。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Please let me know where the dragon lives.
scripts.translation: 请告诉我那条龙住在哪里。

scripts.text: Come with me then. The <NAVI>^4D4DFF[Dragon's Nest]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,340,244,000,1,</INFO></NAVI> is in the cave at the right end of the field outside the village.
scripts.translation: 那跟我来。<NAVI>[龙巢]<INFO>lasa_fild02,340,244,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>就在村外田野尽头的洞穴里。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: What are you doing here? Did you miss the ship?
scripts.translation: 你在这里做什么？错过船了吗？

scripts.text: I heard that we couldn't set off because of the fog. I am here to check the condition of the dragon inside the cave.
scripts.translation: 我听说大雾导致船无法起航，所以来看看洞穴里那条龙的情况。

scripts.text: The fog? Huh! The fog! When did this happen? And the patrol hasn't returned yet.
scripts.translation: 大雾？咦，大雾？什么时候起雾的？巡逻队也还没回来。

scripts.text: The patrol who went to check it ^0000cdhasn't returned yet^000000. Something must have happened. You said you would go there to check the condition of the dragon, right? Come with me.Stone
scripts.translation: 去查看情况的巡逻队还没有回来，肯定出了什么事。你刚才说要去看看那条龙，对吧？跟我来。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: You know, the <NAVI>^4D4DFF[Dragon's Nest]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,340,244,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>. It is in the cave at the right end of the field outside the village. You should go first. I'll follow you after making some preparations.
scripts.translation: 就是<NAVI>[龙巢]<INFO>lasa_fild02,340,244,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>，在村外田野尽头的洞穴里。你先过去，我准备好就跟上。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: The <NAVI>^4D4DFF[Dragon's Nest]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,340,244,000,1,</INFO></NAVI> is in the cave on the right side. Come with me then.
scripts.translation: <NAVI>[龙巢]<INFO>lasa_fild02,340,244,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>就在右边的洞穴里。跟我来吧。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: I'll follow you. <NAVI>^4D4DFF[Dragon's Nest]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,340,244,000,1,</INFO></NAVI> is in the cave at the right end of the field outside the village.
scripts.translation: 我会跟着你。<NAVI>[龙巢]<INFO>lasa_fild02,340,244,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>就在村外田野尽头的洞穴里。 ^4D4DFF^000000

scripts.text: The wind is very uneasy today.
I don't see it near here. We should go deeper!
scripts.translation: 附近没看到它，我们得再往里面走！

scripts.text: I may have feigned death, but I am not a coward. It really was huge and frightening. Well, this is not important now. Just go to Tartufi. Tell him that I am sorry that I cannot make it today.
scripts.translation: 我虽然装死了，但绝不是胆小鬼。那家伙真的又大又可怕。算了，现在不是说这个的时候。去找塔尔图菲，告诉他我今天去不了了。

scripts.text: Have you taken care of it already? You are fast. I am going to take a rest now. You may go now!
scripts.translation: 已经处理好了？你动作真快。我得休息一下，你先走吧！

scripts.text: The Basilisks are acting strange today.
scripts.translation: 今天的巴西利斯克很不对劲。

scripts.text: Hey! Machie! Wake up! What's going on? Oh, my...
scripts.translation: 嘿！玛琪！醒醒！怎么回事？天啊...

scripts.text: Didn't you say that you would like to bring your mother from your hometown? You cannot die like this! Hey, buddy! Machie! don't die on me!
scripts.translation: 你不是说要把母亲从家乡接来吗？不能就这么死了！嘿，伙计！玛琪，别死啊！

scripts.text: Hey! Machie! Wake up! What's going on? didn't you say that you would like to bring your mother from your hometown? You cannot die like this!
scripts.translation: 嘿！玛琪！醒醒！怎么回事？你不是说要把母亲从家乡接来吗？你不能死在这里！

scripts.text: Hey, buddy! Machie! don't die on me!
don't kill a person with your words.
scripts.translation: 别说得我好像要死了一样。

scripts.text: Phew... I tried so hard to fake death. Is it gone now?
scripts.translation: 呼...我可是费了好大劲才装死的。它走了吗？

scripts.text: The most ferocious, heinous and brutal basilisk. This thing was dangerous. It was the scariest basilisk that I had ever seen. I had sprained my ankle out of fear.
scripts.translation: 那是只最凶残、最暴戾的巴西利斯克，太危险了！我从没见过那么可怕的家伙，吓得脚踝都扭伤了。

scripts.text: So you played dead? Good job. A vigilante should know how to save one's life. Good for you.
scripts.translation: 所以你是装死了？干得好。义警也得懂得保命，你做得不错。

scripts.text: Who is it? Someone from the new continent? A newbie to the Vigilante Corps?
scripts.translation: 你是谁？来自新大陆？还是义警团的新人？

scripts.text: No, the adventurer waiting for the sailing. I guess the ship is not setting off because of the fog. This guy came here to check things out.
scripts.translation: 不是，是那个等着上船的冒险者。大概是雾太大，船才没能起航。他是来查看情况的。

scripts.text: I see. Tartufi is causing the trouble again. The basilisks are running wild today.
scripts.translation: 原来如此，又是塔尔图菲惹的麻烦。今天的巴西利斯克到处乱窜。

scripts.text: The good weather may have bothered them. Or they could have heard a tune of a flute or something.
scripts.translation: 也许是天气太好，刺激到它们了。也可能是听见了什么笛声。

scripts.text: Argh... Please hold me a little. I cannot walk properly.
Dear adventurer, I should take him to the base. Would you be able to go there alone?
scripts.translation: 亲爱的冒险者，我得先带他回基地。你能自己过去吗？

scripts.text: ^0000cdTartufi^000000 is right upstairs. Go and ask him what the problem is. He doesn't bite. You don't need to be scared.
scripts.translation: 塔尔图菲就在楼上。去问问他出了什么事。他不咬人，不用怕。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: You don't need to rush since the ship won't sail until Tartufi is at peace. Take your time. The ship cannot leave without you.
scripts.translation: 不用着急，塔尔图菲平静下来之前，船不会起航的。慢慢来吧，船还得等你呢。
这话听起来压力好大啊。

scripts.text: Is that so? I just wanted you to take your time. Well, get in there. Remember, the peace of Tartufi is the peace of the ocean. It means hope.
scripts.translation: 是吗？我只是想让你别着急。进去吧。记住，塔尔图菲平静，海洋才能平静，也就有了希望。

scripts.text: I am sorry to send you alone!
Well, how can I find the dragon's nest?
It is hard to miss. You can tell that it is the dragon's nest when you see it. It is located in a high place and very flashy... Well, you can just tell.
scripts.translation: 那地方很显眼，一看就知道是龙巢。它在高处，特别醒目...总之，你看到就明白了。

scripts.text: I heard that ^0000cdan outsider had been messing with the basilisks^000000.
scripts.translation: 我听说有个外人一直在招惹巴西利斯克。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I guess I may have caused it.
What for? You don't get anything good from hunting down the basilisks.
scripts.translation: 为什么？猎杀巴西利斯克又没什么好处。

scripts.text: Out of curiosity perhaps. I would poke at everything if I go to the new continent too. Argh... Please hold me a little. I cannot walk properly.
scripts.translation: 也许是好奇吧。我要是去了新大陆，恐怕也会到处乱碰。啊...扶我一下，我走不稳。

scripts.text: Dear adventurer, I should take him to the base. Would you be able to go there alone? ^0000cdTartufi^000000 is upstairs. Go and ask him what the problem is.
scripts.translation: 我得带他回基地。你能自己过去吗？塔尔图菲就在楼上，去问问他出了什么事。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I think the adventurer knows what the problem is already.
scripts.translation: 我想这位冒险者已经知道问题出在哪儿了。

scripts.text: You don't have to say it like that.
Nothing like this would have happened if that guy just left the basilisks alone. Well, go ahead.
scripts.translation: 要不是那家伙去招惹巴西利斯克，也不会闹成这样。好了，去吧。

scripts.text: Remember, the peace of Tartufi is the peace of the ocean. It means hope. Please ingratiate yourself with Tartufi.
scripts.translation: 记住，塔尔图菲安宁，海洋才能安宁。这就是希望。想办法让塔尔图菲平静下来。

scripts.text: Yes. I'll make sure to resolve the problem.
You go ahead and see Tartufi. I'll take Machie with me after taking a rest. Remember, the peace of Tartufi is the peace of the ocean. It means hope.
scripts.translation: 你先去找塔尔图菲。我休息一下，再带玛琪过去。记住，塔尔图菲安宁，海洋才能安宁。这就是希望。

scripts.text: Tartufi must have calmed down. Please go first. I'll go with Machie when he can walk a little. It is too heavy to carry him on my back.
scripts.translation: 塔尔图菲应该已经冷静下来了，你先过去吧。等玛琪能走几步，我就带他过去。背着他实在太沉了。

scripts.text: No. I hope someone carries me on his back...
scripts.translation: 不行。真希望有人能背我...

scripts.text: You are saying that for me to hear. don't you even dream of it. I am tired tool.
scripts.translation: 你这是故意说给我听的吧？别想了，我也累得很。

scripts.text: Annoying flies. Annoying mosquitoes. Just annoying. For what fame and riches am I doing here all alone...
scripts.translation: 烦人的苍蝇，讨厌的蚊子...真是烦死了。我孤零零待在这里，究竟图什么名声和财富...

scripts.text: You've been troublesome enough. What's up with you all today? You all tiger moths or something?
scripts.translation: 你们已经够烦人了。今天到底怎么回事？你们是飞蛾吗？
听着，我可不是巴西利斯克。

scripts.text: Who are you? Then again, I've never seen you before... Where's Magchi?
scripts.translation: 你是谁？我以前没见过你...玛琪呢？

scripts.text: Magchi was injured during a patrol and went back.
scripts.translation: 玛琪巡逻时受伤了，已经回去了。

scripts.text: A huge basilisk appeared and he was so startled that he injured his leg. Another vigilante took him, so I'm sure he returned safely.
scripts.translation: 出现了一只巨大的巴西利斯克，他吓得扭伤了腿。另一位义警带他回去了，应该没事。

scripts.text: Yeah? Then I guess he's not dead. I was always curious about the rest of the story that Magchi used to tell me every day. Oh, do you that story too?
scripts.translation: 是吗？那他应该没死。我一直想知道玛琪每天讲的那个故事后续是什么。哦，你也听过那个故事吗？

scripts.text: It's [I Witnessed a Murder on the Evening of Full Moon]. Tell me, if you know the story.
scripts.translation: 故事叫《满月之夜目击谋杀》。你要是知道，就讲给我听吧。

scripts.text: No clue. I've never heard of it.
scripts.translation: 完全不知道，我从没听说过。

scripts.text: Really? Then did Magchi make up that story? And are you going to take care of them?
scripts.translation: 真的吗？那是玛琪编出来的故事吗？你会去处理那些家伙吗？

scripts.text: Magchi used to fight off the basilisks that came this way every day. Without Magchi, they're being troublesome today. So annoying.
scripts.translation: 玛琪以前每天都会赶走从这边过来的巴西利斯克。他不在，它们今天就闹得特别凶，真烦人。

scripts.text: So That's why you're breathing out fire.
scripts.translation: 所以你才会朝它们喷火啊。

scripts.text: Because it keeps them away for now.
scripts.translation: 这样至少能暂时把它们赶走。

scripts.text: The port is smothered in fog because of that smoke. So I came to investigate since the boats can't set sail.
scripts.translation: 那些烟让港口笼罩在浓雾中，船也无法起航，所以我来调查一下。

scripts.text: Set sail? Then are you an adventurer? I heard from Magchi that a new world has been discovered. An unknown land where no one has gone before. I wish I can go, too.
scripts.translation: 起航？你是冒险者吗？我听玛琪说发现了一个新世界，是从来没人去过的未知之地。我也好想去看看。

scripts.text: No. My mom and dad left just recently. I must stay here and grow up a bit more. Sleep a lot and eat a lot. Once I become strong and tough, I'll go for a sightseeing.
scripts.translation: 不行，爸爸妈妈刚离开不久。我得留在这里再长大一些，多睡觉、多吃东西。等我变得强壮了，再去观光。

scripts.text: You're this big and still call yourself a child?
scripts.translation: 你都这么大了，还说自己是小孩？

scripts.text: don't call me a little child though. I'm only 457 years old. But then again, I'm a child compared to grandpa hiding somewhere over there.
scripts.translation: 别叫我小孩子，我才457岁。不过跟躲在那边的爷爷比起来，我确实还小。

scripts.text: He's ^0000cdImoogi^000000, somewhat of a basilisk chief. But I don't know. He's complaining about how if it weren't for ^0000cdmy mom and dad, he would've ascended to heaven already^000000. So he always has basilisks on loose to harass me.
scripts.translation: 他是伊穆吉，算是巴西利斯克的首领吧。不过我也不清楚。他总抱怨说，要不是我爸妈，自己早就飞升了。所以他才老是放巴西利斯克出来欺负我。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Oh! There are basilisks coming this way again. Please, take care of them.
scripts.translation: 啊！巴西利斯克又朝这边来了。拜托，帮我对付它们！

scripts.text: Well, Magchi used to wield some type of long pole. Maybe that would do. ^0000cdAt least 20^000000 must be taken care of before they run away.
scripts.translation: 嗯，玛琪以前会挥舞一种长杆武器。也许那个有用。它们逃跑之前，至少要解决20只。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I picked up a few things so let me give them a try. Wait.
scripts.translation: 我捡了些东西，先试试看。等等。

scripts.text: They just never give up, do they? But you must try a little harder. They're nowhere near done because they know that you're weak. So you must show your strong side!
scripts.translation: 它们就是不肯罢休啊？你还得再努力一点。它们觉得你很弱，所以不会轻易退走。快让它们看看你有多强！

scripts.text: They'll be quiet for a while if you show them that you're strong. So try a little harder. I'll help you.
scripts.translation: 只要让它们知道你很强，它们就会安静一阵子。再努力一点，我会帮你的。

scripts.text: Is he gone? I guess he is. That ought to keep them quiet for a while. Got me all worried at first because he said he was a rookie adventurer, but he should be able to pull off one doram's bit.
scripts.translation: 他走了吗？应该走了。这下它们会安静一阵子了。一开始他说自己是新手冒险者，我还挺担心的，不过对付一只巴西利斯克，他应该还是没问题。

scripts.text: Everyone treats me like a new eggring, but I've also completed a formal training course!
scripts.translation: 大家都把我当成刚出生的蛋黄波利，可我明明完成了正规的训练课程！

scripts.text: Magchi tells me that It's a short, intensive program. But would that be enough? You went through a hell of a training while taking down those basilisks, so you're no longer a rookie.
scripts.translation: 玛琪说那只是个短期强化课程，可真的够吗？不过你对付那些巴西利斯克时可吃了不少苦，现在已经不算新手了。

scripts.text: By the time he's ready to run around again, Magchi will come. Thanks a lot. You said you're heading for an adventure in the new world? Tell me about the new world when you're in Lasagna time to time.
scripts.translation: 等玛琪能重新到处走动时，他就会来找我。真是帮大忙了。你说要去新世界冒险？以后回罗札纳时，记得跟我讲讲那边的事。

scripts.text: It was short, but I really enjoyed your being here. Goodbye.
scripts.translation: 虽然相处的时间不长，但我很高兴你来过。再见。

scripts.text: It must be somewhere near here that can communicate with Imoogi.
scripts.translation: 附近一定有能和伊穆克沟通的地方。

scripts.text: How dare you treat me like a ghost! I have lived for ^0000cd2,500 years^000000!
scripts.translation: 你竟敢把我当幽灵！我已经活了2,500年！ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Oww...that hurts. I'm sorry if I've offended you, but are you Imoogi, the chief of the Basilisk?
scripts.translation: 哎哟...好痛。要是冒犯了你，我向你道歉。请问你是巴西利斯克首领伊穆克吗？

scripts.text: Your language is as vulgar as your appearance.
scripts.translation: 你的言行和外表一样粗俗。
塔尔图菲也是这么说的。

scripts.text: He's young and foolish from lack of learning. I am Imook. I am called ^0000cdLord Imuk^000000.
scripts.translation: 他年轻又无知，才会这么说。我是伊穆克，人称伊穆克大人。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Lord Imuk... Did you say you lived for 2,500 years?
scripts.translation: 伊穆克大人...您刚才说自己活了2,500年？

scripts.text: Yes. And I was supposed to ^0000cdbecome a dragon and ascend to heaven^000000.
Ascend? You mean going up to the heaven?

I can ^0000cdascend to heaven by training for 1,000 years and becoming a dragon^000000. But the ^0000cdmother and father of that young one^000000 snatched ^0000cdYeouiju^000000 twice in the past and ascended instead.
scripts.translation: 我只要修炼1,000年，化身为龙便能升天。可那个年轻人的父母过去两次夺走了如意珠，抢先升天。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: And now, that young one is hiding Yeouiju somewhere and seeking for a chance to ascend after 500 years. I will regain what's mine. My rights are justified.
scripts.translation: 如今那个年轻人把如意珠藏了起来，想等500年后再找机会升天。我要夺回属于我的东西，我的诉求理所当然。

scripts.text: Seems like Yeouiju is a must-have in order to become a dragon. Is that why the basilisks are bothering Tartufi?
scripts.translation: 看来如意珠是化龙的必需之物。那些巴西利斯克一直骚扰塔尔图菲，就是为了这个吗？

scripts.text: The ^0000cdbasilisks are charged with the task of recovering Yeouiju^000000.
scripts.translation: 巴西利斯克受命夺回如意珠。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: You see, Tartufi breathes fire when he's attacked, and the smoke smothers the town. This keeps people from traveling freely.
scripts.translation: 你看，塔尔图菲受到攻击时会喷火，烟雾就会笼罩城镇，害得大家无法自由出行。

scripts.text: I'm sorry to hear that. But that young one is at fault. Basilisks will continue with their task until the Yeouiju is recovered.
scripts.translation: 我很遗憾听到这些。不过错在那个年轻人。夺回如意珠之前，巴西利斯克会继续执行任务。

scripts.text: Mm... I understand. So you have no intention of giving up until you get that Yeouiju. I'll ask Tartufi about Yeouiju.
scripts.translation: 嗯...我明白了。看来拿到如意珠之前，您是不会罢休的。我去问问塔尔图菲如意珠的事。

scripts.text: Thanks. Now I must continue with my training so do not disturb me and go away.
scripts.translation: 多谢。我得继续修炼了，别再打扰我，离开吧。

scripts.text: Tell the young one about Yeouiju. I must continue with my training so do not disturb me and go away.
scripts.translation: 把如意珠的事告诉那个年轻人。我得继续修炼了，别再打扰我，离开吧。

scripts.text: Annoying flies. Annoying mosquitoes. Just annoying. I miss mom and dad.
scripts.translation: 讨厌的苍蝇，讨厌的蚊子...真烦人。我想爸爸妈妈了。

scripts.text: You've been troublesome enough. What's up with you all today? Tiger strike wasn't enough? You all tiger moths or something?
scripts.translation: 你们已经够烦人了！今天怎么回事？老虎扑击还不够吗？你们都是飞蛾吗？
听着，我不是巴西利斯克。

scripts.text: Who are you? Your clothes are weird and you look weird. Where did Magchi go?
scripts.translation: 你是谁？衣服奇怪，人也奇怪。玛琪去哪儿了？

scripts.text: Magchi was injured during a patrol and went back. And I'm from the new world.
scripts.translation: 玛琪巡逻时受伤回去了。我来自新世界。

scripts.text: I see. You're from the new world. But what about Magchi?
scripts.translation: 这样啊，你来自新世界。那玛琪呢？

scripts.text: Basilisks went on a rampage and he injured his leg. Another vigilante took him, so I'm sure he returned safely.
scripts.translation: 巴西利斯克突然发狂，害他伤了腿。另一位义警带他回去了，应该没事。

scripts.text: Yeah? Then That's a relief. But I don't know what's gotten into these creatures. They were quiet just until now.
scripts.translation: 是吗？那就好。不过这些家伙到底怎么了？刚才还安安静静的。

scripts.text: Well, I was after the basilisks just before.
scripts.translation: 我刚才一直在追那些巴西利斯克。

scripts.text: What? You went after the basilisks? You?
scripts.translation: 什么？你去追巴西利斯克了？你？

scripts.text: Uh... yes. I'm sorry. I didn't mean to.
scripts.translation: 呃...是的，对不起，我不是故意的。

scripts.text: No, no. I'm not saying what you did was wrong. But can you tell me more about that?
scripts.translation: 不，不，我不是在怪你。能跟我说说具体发生了什么吗？

scripts.text: I was asked to find some basils. I heard that I can find them from the basilisks, so I came all the way here to catch them. I guess that must've excited them.
scripts.translation: 我受命去找些罗勒。听说巴西利斯克身上能找到，所以就一路追到这里。我想它们可能因此受到了惊吓。

scripts.text: I see. Then are you strong? You said you caught some basilisks.
scripts.translation: 原来如此。那你很强吗？你说自己抓了几只巴西利斯克。

scripts.text: Well, I guess you can say that...
Magchi just drove off the basilisks that came this way every day. That was enough, but without Magchi, they are bothering me again. So annoying.
scripts.translation: 玛琪每天只要赶走来这边的巴西利斯克就够了。可他不在，它们又来烦我了，真讨厌。

scripts.text: So That's why you're breathing out fire.
scripts.translation: 原来你是因此才喷火的。

scripts.text: Because it keeps them away for now.
scripts.translation: 这样至少能暂时把它们赶走。

scripts.text: The port is smothered in fog because of that smoke. So I came to investigate since the boats can't set sail.
scripts.translation: 烟雾笼罩了港口，害得船无法起航，所以我来调查一下。

scripts.text: Set sail? Ah, right. You said you were from the new world. Then can I ask for a favor? Please tell their ^0000cdchief^000000 to keep them quiet.
scripts.translation: 起航？啊，对，你说你来自新世界。能帮我一个忙吗？请告诉它们的首领，叫它们安静些。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: His name is Imoogi. I don't know where he lives, but there's something ^0000cdup there that can communicate with Imoogi^000000. Basilisks go there every morning and hear something...
scripts.translation: 他叫伊穆克。我不知道他住在哪里，不过上面有某种可以和伊穆克沟通的东西。巴西利斯克每天早上都会去那里听他说些什么... ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I see. Sorry about the basilisks. I'll take care of it.
scripts.translation: 我明白了。抱歉惹出了巴西利斯克的事，我会处理好的。

scripts.text: Did you get to talk with Imoogi? What did he say? Not yet? Hurry up. The basilisks are so annoying.
scripts.translation: 你和伊穆克谈过了吗？他说了什么？还没吗？快去吧，巴西利斯克烦死了。

scripts.text: You here. So how did it go?
[You tell Tartufi about the story of Lord Imuk and Yeouiju.]
scripts.translation: [你向塔尔图菲讲述了伊穆克大人与如意珠的故事。]

scripts.text: I'm not exactly sure, but It's a must-have to become a dragon and ascend to the heaven.
scripts.translation: 我也不清楚，只知道要化身为龙、飞升成仙，就少不了它。

scripts.text: Whatever it is, I'll look for it. It should take some time to look for it here somewhere. But in the meanwhile, can you take care of them?
scripts.translation: 不管那是什么，我会去找找看。不过在这里搜寻可能要花很久。这段时间你能帮我对付它们吗？

scripts.text: I will. How long would it take?
I don't know. Perhaps 200 years or so?
scripts.translation: 不知道，也许两百年左右？

scripts.text: Think about it. It takes about that much time to search through everything here. On top of that, I don't even know what Yeouiju is.
scripts.translation: 你想想，在这里找遍所有地方大概就得花那么久。而且我连如意珠是什么都不知道。

scripts.text: Anyway, I'll look for it, so you take care of them. Just today. Tomorrow, perhaps Magchi will come and get rid of them. But today, you do it. I heard It's because of you.
scripts.translation: 总之我会去找如意珠，你先帮我赶走那些巴西利斯克，就今天一天。也许玛琪明天会来处理它们。听说这事是你惹出来的。

scripts.text: Fine. If you by any chance find that Yeouiju, please tell Lord Imuk.
scripts.translation: 好吧。如果你找到如意珠，请告诉伊穆克大人。

scripts.text: I'll think about it. I don't even know what that is. I can't promise you without knowing what it is.
scripts.translation: 我会考虑的。我连那是什么都不知道，不能随便答应你。

scripts.text: I guess you're right. I can't wait forever so I should get rid of those basilisks. How many should I take care of?
scripts.translation: 你说得对，我不能一直等下去。我去解决那些巴西利斯克。要处理多少只？

scripts.text: Get rid of ^0000cd20 or so^000000 and they won't come near from fear.
scripts.translation: 解决大约20只，吓过它们之后就不敢再靠近了。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Fine. If you by any chance find that Yeouiju, please tell Lord Imuk.
scripts.translation: 好吧。如果你找到如意珠，请告诉伊穆克大人。

scripts.text: No, not yet. They keep coming. I said not yet.
scripts.translation: 还不行，它们还在不断出现。我说还没结束呢。

scripts.text: Did you forget? You must get rid of at least 20 basilisks before they get quiet.
scripts.translation: 忘了吗？至少要赶走20只巴西利斯克，它们才会安静下来。

scripts.text: Good job. That should keep them quiet now. I'm going to look through my treasure but I need to sleep first. I'm sleepy cuz I've been up for so long today.
scripts.translation: 干得好，现在它们应该会安静了。我要去找找宝物，不过得先睡一觉。我今天醒太久了，困死了。

scripts.text: Yes. I'm sure Lord Imuk will wait as well.
scripts.translation: 好。我想伊穆克大人也会等着的。

scripts.text: Fine. You're boarding on a ship, right? I hope you get to your destination safely.
scripts.translation: 好吧，你要上船了，对吧？祝你平安抵达目的地。

scripts.text: Thanks. I think I can sail off in a nice weather.
scripts.translation: 谢谢。天气这么好，我想可以起航了。

scripts.text: I heard you're boarding on a ship. Shouldn't you hurry?
scripts.translation: 听说你要上船了，不该快点出发吗？

scripts.text: Only the vigilantes can eat here.
You're from the new world? What does a person from the new world want with me?
scripts.translation: 你来自新世界？新世界的人找我有什么事？

scripts.text: You're from our adventurers' club {0} Aren't you?
scripts.translation: 你是我们冒险者俱乐部派来的，对吧？ {0}

scripts.text: I remember everyone that I've crossed paths with.
scripts.translation: 和我打过交道的人，我都记得。

scripts.text: Besides seeking for new adventures, listening to other people's stories is an adventurer's duty. From what I gather, you've been in Lasagna longer than most people.
scripts.translation: 寻找新的冒险之外，听取别人的故事也是冒险者的职责。据我所知，你在罗札纳待的时间比大多数人都长。

scripts.text: Everyone recommended that I should ask you for stories on Lasagna and Farfalle Vigilantes.
scripts.translation: 大家都建议我向你打听罗札纳和法尔法雷义警团的故事。

scripts.text: Listening to other people's adventure stories is one of the virtues of an adventurer. If you can listen carefully and learn something from other people, they'll be valuable lessons on life.
scripts.translation: 倾听别人的冒险故事，是冒险者的美德之一。认真听取并从中学习，就能收获宝贵的人生经验。

scripts.text: So what are you curious about?

My story... Why are you curious? But since you asked, I'll tell you. I was born outside of Lasagna called ^0000cdFusilli^000000. Back then, you mention the name Peperoncino and everyone in Fusilli knew.
scripts.translation: 我的故事...你为什么想知道？既然你问了，我就讲讲吧。我出生在罗札纳以外的富西利。那时候只要提起佩佩龙奇诺，富西利无人不知。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Sir, That's not what you said the last time we talked over a drink. You said you left because you hated being looked down upon due to poverty.
scripts.translation: 先生，这和你上次喝酒时说的不一样。你当时说，自己因为贫穷而受人轻视，所以才离开家乡。

scripts.text: What are you talking about? You must've been very drunk that day. What more can an adventurer ask for when you get to experience so many things in a vast ocean?
scripts.translation: 你在说什么？那天你肯定喝醉了。在广阔的海上经历这么多，一个冒险者还能奢求什么呢？

scripts.text: But unfortunately, ^0000cdI became unable to be on a ship^000000. I can't tell you why. It's classified information.
scripts.translation: 可惜，我再也不能上船了。原因不能告诉你，这是机密。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Then I saw the unlimited potential of fishing industry, or anchovy manufacturing to be more exact. So I jumped into the ^0000cdanchovy manufacturing business^000000. And I met Gamberry around that time.
scripts.translation: 后来我看到了渔业的无限潜力，确切地说，是鳀鱼加工的潜力。于是我投身鳀鱼加工生意。那段时间我遇见了甘贝里。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: ^0000cdGamberry was a hoodlum who reminded me of a ruffian^000000. He soon was moved by my words and joined me in the business.
scripts.translation: 甘贝里当时是个混混，让我想起一个恶棍。后来他被我的话打动，也加入了这门生意。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Of course there were small disputes, but Gamberry was moved by my leadership and became influenced. After we gained enough experience and know-hows from anchovy manufacturing, we decided to draw a bigger picture.
scripts.translation: 我们当然也有过小争执，不过甘贝里被我的领导能力打动，渐渐受我影响。我们从鳀鱼加工中积累了经验和诀窍后，决定大干一场。

scripts.text: It was ^0000cdselling specialty products^000000. Gamberry's friend ^0000cdThomas^000000 joined the venture and we decided to start the business in Lasagna. But the problem was ^0000cdlousy dorams^000000.
scripts.translation: 我们要做的是销售罗札纳特产。甘贝里的朋友托马斯也加入了，于是我们决定在罗札纳开展生意。问题是那些不成器的多兰。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: They would pick on every single thing so I decided to catch them and make them work.
scripts.translation: 他们什么事都要挑刺，所以我决定把他们抓起来，让他们干活。

scripts.text: At any rate, Captain Gamberry is a good man. He was influenced by me since his ragtag days and now he's become a doram.
scripts.translation: 不管怎么说，甘贝里船长是个好人。他落魄时就受我影响，如今也成了多兰。

scripts.text: How was Lasagna in the past?
scripts.translation: 以前的罗札纳是什么样的？

scripts.text: Lasagna was just awful when I first came here. You breathe and someone picks a fight. You walk and fights break out. Captain Gamberry went around putting the brakes on those crowds, but my first impression of him was no different from them.
scripts.translation: 我刚来罗札纳时，这里糟透了。喘口气都有人找茬，走几步就有人打架。甘贝里船长四处劝架，但我当时觉得他和那些人没什么两样。

scripts.text: If violence subdues violence, then what will subdue that violence? Anyway, Lasagna was like a rotten trash can. In comparison, Fusilli is a town with totally innocent people!
scripts.translation: 如果以暴制暴，那又该用什么来制止暴力？总之，罗札纳简直像个腐烂的垃圾桶。相比之下，富西利的人可纯朴多了！

scripts.text: I ask the newcomers about Fusilli and none of them knows. It must be in the backwoods or something.
scripts.translation: 师我问过新来的人，没人听说过富西利。那地方大概在偏远的乡下吧。

scripts.text: Anyhow, the biggest obstacle when we started the business was Lasagna's lousy dorams. They pounced on me for a fight. Is everyone who live by sea so belligerent like that?
scripts.translation: 总之，我们刚开始做生意时，最大的障碍就是罗札纳那些不成器的多兰。他们动不动就找我打架。难道所有靠海生活的人都这么好斗吗？

scripts.text: No, don't insult them. It's this place That's unusual.
scripts.translation: 别这么说他们。是这个地方比较特别。

scripts.text: At first, I tried to persuade those lousy dorams through conversation. I tried to be a gentleman but they wouldn't listen. That's when Gamberry took the matters into his own hands.
scripts.translation: 起初，我试着跟那些不成器的多兰讲道理，想做个绅士，可他们根本不听。最后甘贝里亲自出手了。

scripts.text: didn't I tell you just before? He took care of it completely. I gathered those lousy dorams and spoke to them. They were so touched by my speech that they volunteered to join the vigilance corps.
scripts.translation: 我刚才不是说了吗？他把事情彻底解决了。我召集那些多兰和他们谈话，他们被我的演讲打动，自愿加入了义警团。

scripts.text: Hmph! Anyway, with the efforts of vigilance corps and merchants, Lasagna was reborn to its current state.
scripts.translation: 哼！总之，多亏义警团和商人的努力，罗札纳才变成了今天的样子。

scripts.text: How are the vigilance corps and merchants?
scripts.translation: 义警团和商人现在怎么样了？

scripts.text: The ^0000cdvigilance corps and merchants^000000 are... um... Among several organizations that run Lasagna, you can say that the two created today's Lasagna. And Gamberry, Thomas, and I were at the heart of it.
scripts.translation: 义警团和商人嘛...嗯...管理罗札纳的几个组织中，可以说正是这两者造就了今天的罗札纳。我、甘贝里和托马斯就是其中的核心。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: When we jumped into the specialty product business, many dorams who were moved by us wanted to help.
scripts.translation: 我们开始经营特产时，许多被我们打动的多兰都主动来帮忙。

scripts.text: See what I mean? Different version from the last.
scripts.translation: 看吧，我说什么来着？这次的说法又不一样。

scripts.text: We gathered those lousy dorams and sent them to the vigilance corps and merchants. Lasagna's ^0000cdmaintenance of order was handled by the vigilantes^000000, and ^0000cdeverything related to the products was handled by the merchants^000000.
scripts.translation: 我们把那些多兰召集起来，分派到义警团和商队。罗札纳的治安由义警负责，所有与特产有关的事务则由商人负责。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: To expand our flourishing business, we ^0000cdbegan sea trade^000000. But during this time, ^0000cdThomas's ship Butterfly went missing in a typhoon^000000.
scripts.translation: 为了扩大生意，我们开始海上贸易。就在那段时间，托马斯的“蝴蝶号”在台风中失踪了。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I ^0000cdpersistently persuaded the captain and crewmen of Con-Chliina to find Butterfly^000000. My efforts finally paid off and we found them on a ^0000cdremote island in the new world^000000.
scripts.translation: 我一直劝康奇利娜号的船长和船员去寻找蝴蝶号。努力终于有了回报，我们在新世界一座偏远的岛上找到了他们。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Well, that was Stello of Con-Chliina...
scripts.translation: 那就是康奇利娜号的斯特洛...
你还有什么想知道的吗？

scripts.text: That was... what an amazing adventure. Thank you for sharing your story. I can clearly see where your dignified manner comes from.
scripts.translation: 那真是...一段精彩的冒险。谢谢你告诉我这些。我现在明白你这份沉稳是怎么来的了。

scripts.text: I hope I can listen to your story one day.
scripts.translation: 希望有一天也能听听你的故事。

scripts.text: I hope I can listen to your story one day.
scripts.translation: 希望有一天也能听听你的故事。

scripts.text: Wow, you have an amazing sensing ability.
When you live alone for a long time, you get sensitive to the slightest noise. So what brings you here? I'm out of kaluna milk right now. Do you want to order something else?
scripts.translation: 一个人住久了，连细微的声音都会特别敏感。那么，你来找我有什么事？我现在卡鲁纳牛奶卖完了，要点别的吗？

scripts.text: there's something I wanted to ask you. Do you remember anything about Captain Gamberry and Chief Peperoncino?
scripts.translation: 我有件事想请教您。您还记得甘贝里船长和首领佩佩龙奇诺吗？

scripts.text: Oh, those eggring boys. Speaking of which, I haven't seen them much lately. Did they give up and leave Lasagna?
scripts.translation: 哦，那群蛋黄波利小子啊。说起来，最近都没怎么见到他们。他们是放弃罗札纳，离开了吗？

scripts.text: No, they're both well and still in Lasagna. I'm here because there is something I wanted to know about Captain Gamberry.
scripts.translation: 没有，他们都好好的，还在罗札纳。我想打听一些甘贝里船长的事。

scripts.text: Captain? Captain who? Gamberry? That eggring boy? Oh, you're right. He did become a captain. I remember when he showed up in my pub with Pepe.
scripts.translation: 船长？哪个船长？甘贝里？那个蛋黄波利小子？啊，你说得对，他后来确实当上了船长。我记得他和佩佩一起来我酒馆的时候。

scripts.text: ^0000cdPepe. Peperoncino. Gamberry is Berry, and Tomei Thomas is Toto^000000. I guess young people don't know. Anyway, they were like wild basilisks.
scripts.translation: 佩佩就是佩佩龙奇诺。甘贝里绰号贝里，托梅·托马斯绰号托托。现在的年轻人恐怕不知道这些了。总之，他们那时就像一群野生的巴西利斯克。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Are the basilisks still in the cave? When we were young, we didn't even go near the cave.
scripts.translation: 巴西利斯克现在还待在洞穴里吗？我们年轻时连洞穴附近都不敢靠近。

scripts.text: So what happened then? They showed up at the pub and what did they do?
scripts.translation: 后来发生什么了？他们来到酒馆后做了什么？

scripts.text: Oh, right. Pepe looked like a homeless and ordered kaluna milk. That's when Berry picked a fight, saying that only the kids have it shaken.
scripts.translation: 哦，对了。佩佩当时看起来像个流浪汉，点了一杯卡鲁纳牛奶。贝里就挑起了争执，说只有小孩子才喝搅拌过的。

scripts.text: So they ^0000cdfought^000000. My ^0000cdstore was destroyed^000000. So I made a ^0000cdclaim for damages^000000 for broken furniture and profit loss until the pub was back in business.
scripts.translation: 于是他们打了起来。砸坏了我的酒馆。家具损坏了，酒馆也停业了好一阵，我只好向他们索赔。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: You mentioned Pepe. Seemed like he was poor there as well. He came to Lasagna after hearing from somewhere that he can make a lot of money on anchovy fishing boat, but quit because of seasickness.
scripts.translation: 你提到佩佩了。看来他当时也很穷。他听说在鳀鱼船上能赚大钱，就来到了罗札纳，却因为晕船放弃了。

scripts.text: After that, he couldn't get on a boat ever again. Haha. He became indebted because of the ^0000cdpenalty for breach of contract^000000 and couldn't leave. So he ended up in the anchovy workshop where he removes anchovy head and guts...
scripts.translation: 从那以后，他再也没法上船了，哈哈。他因为违约金欠了债，没法离开，最后只好在鳀鱼工坊给鳀鱼去头、清内脏... ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Anyway, he had a huge debt from the boat and pub. The two mulled over what to do and ended up at the ^0000cdanchovy workshop^000000. Few years later, ^0000cdGamberry became the workshop manager^000000. The job was perfect for him.
scripts.translation: 总之，他欠下了船费和酒馆的债。他们商量一番后，去了鳀鱼工坊。几年后，甘贝里成了工坊经理，那里正适合他。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: How was Lasagna in the old days?
scripts.translation: 以前的罗札纳是什么样的？

scripts.text: don't even mention it. It was a mess. The roads were awful. People were awful. there's a reason why the past is called the dark ages.
scripts.translation: 别提了，一团糟。道路糟糕，人也糟糕。过去会被称为“黑暗时代”，不是没有原因的。

scripts.text: Have you ever stepped on fish guts on a road? That's how Lasagna was back then.
scripts.translation: 你试过在路上踩到鱼内脏吗？以前的罗札纳到处都是那样。

scripts.text: Then one day, two roughnecks came up with the merchants and vigilance corps and started beating up Lasagna kids.
scripts.translation: 后来有一天，两个粗汉带着商人和义警团来到这里，开始教训罗札纳的混混。

scripts.text: I guess sticks do make dorams. The two sent those hoodlums to the merchants and vigilance corps. Mm... I remember those boys. Their beards were cut and tails were tattered.
scripts.translation: 看来棍棒底下真能出多兰。那两人把那些混混分派给商人和义警团。嗯...我记得那两个小伙子，他们剃掉了胡须，尾巴也弄得破破烂烂的。

scripts.text: Those doram mouse-looking ones all left Lasagna and only the ones who wanted to live a decent life stayed. They're the ones who made current Lasagna.
scripts.translation: 那些长得像老鼠的多兰都离开了罗札纳，只剩下一心想好好生活的人留了下来。正是他们造就了今天的罗札纳。

scripts.text: But who are you? Did you come to order kaluna milk? Stirred or shaken? Where did all my workers go?
scripts.translation: 不过，你是谁？来点卡鲁纳牛奶的吗？要搅拌还是摇匀？我的员工都去哪儿了？

scripts.text: With no customers, my pub will soon be out of business.
scripts.translation: 再没有客人上门，我的酒馆就要关门了。

scripts.text: If you're not going to order anything, get the heck out!
scripts.translation: 不点东西就赶紧滚出去！

scripts.text: It looks huge and heavy. Go and get rid of some.
scripts.translation: 这东西看起来又大又重，去处理掉一些吧。

scripts.text: If you wish to speak to me, then you'd better go and get some more experience.
scripts.translation: 想跟我说话的话，先去多积攒些经验再来。

scripts.text: A glass of kaluna milk please.
scripts.translation: 请给我一杯卡鲁纳牛奶。

scripts.text: If you want to drink kaluna milk, then go see the guy next door. But you'd better hurry. Stirred or shaken, that won't matter pretty soon.
scripts.translation: 想喝卡鲁纳牛奶就去找隔壁那位。不过最好快点，不管搅拌还是摇匀，很快就都喝不到了。

scripts.text: You know what the main ingredients of kaluna milk are? They're ^0000cdkaluna^000000, the essence made from fermenting a special shellfish called ^0000cdkalunyak^000000, and fresh milk.
scripts.translation: 你知道卡鲁纳牛奶的主要原料吗？有卡鲁纳、用一种叫卡鲁尼亚克的特殊贝类发酵制成的精华，还有新鲜牛奶。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Mix that in moderate temperate and garnish with a gooseberry. And then you get the kaluna milk that everyone loves.
scripts.translation: 按适当比例混合，再放上一颗鹅莓点缀，大家最爱的卡鲁纳牛奶就做好了。

scripts.text: But we're almost finished with the kaluna in store and the person who supplies us hasn't been here for days. Even the ones we had in stockpile are nearly gone.
scripts.translation: 可是店里的卡鲁纳快用完了，供应商已经好几天没来。连储备的也所剩无几。

scripts.text: Without kaluna, there's no kaluna milk. You get what that means?
scripts.translation: 没有卡鲁纳，就做不了卡鲁纳牛奶。明白这意味着什么吗？

scripts.text: It means customers who came for kaluna milk would have made their trip in vain.
scripts.translation: 那些专程来喝卡鲁纳牛奶的客人就要白跑一趟了。

scripts.text: Angry people who didn't get to drink kaluna milk will soon cause a ^0000cdriot^000000, and soon it will spread over the entire Lasagna.
scripts.translation: 喝不到卡鲁纳牛奶的客人会愤怒地闹事，恐怕很快就会波及整个罗札纳。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Then Lasagna will return to its former state of filth and danger. I can't let that happen. We're finally living like decent human beings but to go back to that dark age...
scripts.translation: 那样罗札纳就会变回从前那个肮脏又危险的地方。我绝不能让这种事发生。我们好不容易才过上安稳日子，难道又要回到黑暗时代...

scripts.text: I'm sure that won't happen just over a glass of kaluna milk.
scripts.translation: 我想不至于因为一杯卡鲁纳牛奶就闹成那样吧。

scripts.text: You don't understand what kaluna milk means for people of Lasagna. It's not merely a drink that relaxes the body for these people.
scripts.translation: 你不懂卡鲁纳牛奶对罗札纳人有多重要。它可不只是能让人放松的饮料。

scripts.text: Kaluna milk also symbolizes ^0000cdfaith and friendship, as well as festival^000000. I can't discuss the details here, but if you're curious, go see the bookkeeper of Con-Chliina.
scripts.translation: 卡鲁纳牛奶还象征着信任、友谊和节庆。详情我不方便在这里说。想知道的话，就去问问康奇利娜号的记录员。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: He's a recording maniac who loves to record everything.
scripts.translation: 他是个记录狂，什么事情都喜欢记下来。

scripts.text: I'm not exactly sure, but I can tell It's really important for people here.
scripts.translation: 我不太清楚，不过能感觉到它对这里的人很重要。

scripts.text: Right. That's what I'm talking about. You always start or finish the day with kaluna milk. But that kaluna is nearly all gone!
scripts.translation: 没错，我说的就是这个。人们总以卡鲁纳牛奶开启或结束一天，可现在卡鲁纳快要耗尽了！

scripts.text: Why don't you send someone over and find out what happened?
scripts.translation: 为什么不派个人去看看出了什么事？

scripts.text: I'm not dumb you know. But there's no one to send! Look, everyone is busy.
scripts.translation: 我又不傻，可是没人能派啊！你看，大家都忙着呢。
啊，不好意思，我帮不了你。

scripts.text: Yeah, I'm busy so you should get going. If you wish to drink kaluna milk, try the next door.
scripts.translation: 是啊，我忙得很，你该走了。想喝卡鲁纳牛奶就去隔壁看看。

scripts.text: What? What did you just say? If I heard you correctly, you said you'd help me.
scripts.translation: 什么？你刚才说什么？我没听错的话，你说要帮我？

scripts.text: Dear lord, thank you. So this is how you repay me for all the nice deeds I've done.
scripts.translation: 老天爷，谢谢你！这就是对我平日善行的回报啊。

scripts.text: I'm the one who said I'll help you, but how come the lord gets the appreciation?
scripts.translation: 明明是我说要帮你的，怎么反倒是你在感谢老天？

scripts.text: Oh, not at all. I'm grateful to you, too. Anyways, if you go to the ^0000cdfishing hole near the south bridge^000000, you'll meet ^0000cdLegalas^000000 who is standing on crutches. He's the one who supplies us with kaluna.
scripts.translation: 哦，我也很感谢你。总之，去南桥附近的渔场找找吧，那里有个拄拐杖的莱加拉斯，负责给我们供应卡鲁纳。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Most people in Lasagna work for the vigilante corps or merchants, so the town is always short on hands.
scripts.translation: 罗札纳的大多数人都在义警团或商队工作，所以镇上一直缺人手。

scripts.text: So we hire outsiders who want a job as a special treatment policy, and Legalas is in charge of fermenting kaluna.
scripts.translation: 因此我们会用特殊的雇用政策招揽外来务工者，莱加拉斯就负责发酵卡鲁纳。

scripts.text: He's quite skilled at catching, cleaning, and fermenting kalunyak that Lasagna's kaluna milk is regarded as the best around here. Ah, this is not the important part.
scripts.translation: 他很擅长捕捉、清洗和发酵卡鲁尼亚克，所以罗札纳的卡鲁纳牛奶才是这一带最好的。啊，这不是重点。

scripts.text: Go find Legalas and find out what's going on. And tell him to make delivery as soon as possible. At the rate we're going, we'll be out of stock after today.
scripts.translation: 去找莱加拉斯问问出了什么事，让他尽快送货。照现在的进度，今天过后就要断货了。

scripts.text: Okay, I'll go and find out.
Didn't you say you were going to find out why Legalas was not able to make the delivery?
scripts.translation: 你不是说要去调查莱加拉斯为什么没能送货吗？

scripts.text: I beg you. I'm really worried. Can't even sleep these days.
scripts.translation: 拜托你了，我真的很担心，这几天连觉都睡不好。

scripts.text: Adventurer, what did Legalas say? Did he say he can deliver kaluna?
scripts.translation: 冒险者，莱加拉斯怎么说？他说能送来卡鲁纳吗？

scripts.text: Yes. Fortunately, he said he's close to meeting the delivery quota.
scripts.translation: 能。好在他说货物很快就能备齐。

scripts.text: What a relief! But did tell you about what caused him the delay?
scripts.translation: 太好了！他有没有告诉你，是什么耽误了送货？

scripts.text: [You tell Kalu about the story of Daldal and Gopara.]
scripts.translation: [你向卡卢讲述了达尔达尔与戈帕拉的故事。]

scripts.text: So what you're telling is that I should keep the two far away from the workshop while Legalas is working.
scripts.translation: 所以你是说，莱加拉斯工作时，我得让那两个人离工坊远点。

scripts.text: I think That's something I can take care of. As a matter of fact, I have a ^0000cdlunchbox delivery to make inside the cave^000000. Every day, that is.
scripts.translation: 这事我应该能处理。正好我每天都要往洞穴送午餐盒。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Looks like the two can be sent to the delivery team while Legalas is working. For wage, a meal per day would do.
scripts.translation: 莱加拉斯工作时，正好可以让那两个人加入送货队。报酬嘛，每人每天给顿饭就行。

scripts.text: Cave? That's nice. I've always wanted to go there myself.
scripts.translation: 洞穴？听起来不错，我一直很想亲自去看看。

scripts.text: Whatever it is, I'm happy that I get to eat yummy food.
scripts.translation: 不管是什么，只要有好吃的，我就开心。

scripts.text: Okay, then Let's get started right away! Take this lunchbox to the ^0000cdvigilante inside the cave. His name is Panna.^000000
scripts.translation: 好，那就马上开始！把这个午餐盒送给洞穴里的义警潘娜。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: A team must move as one.
Since when was I part of the team? All right, fine... Let's go.
scripts.translation: 我什么时候成团队的一员了？好吧...走吧。

scripts.text: Just deliver this big lunchbox to Panna who's out on a cave patrol.
scripts.translation: 把这个大午餐盒送给正在洞穴巡逻的潘娜就行了。

scripts.text: Good job. While the three of you went to the cave, Legalas visited with kaluna. If we can keep this up every day, delivery will be no problem at all.
scripts.translation: 干得好。你们三个去洞穴的时候，莱加拉斯正好送来了卡鲁纳。每天都能这样的话，送货就没问题了。

scripts.text: Adventurer, I'm counting on you tomorrow as well.
scripts.translation: 冒险者，明天也拜托你了。

scripts.text: If time permits, I'll be out early and waiting.
scripts.translation: 要是有空，我会早点出门等着。
我们之前的口号是什么来着？

scripts.text: One team. If I don't show up, they'll probably harass Legalas again. Fine.
scripts.translation: 一队。如果我不去，他们可能又会去烦莱加拉斯。好吧。

scripts.text: I'm fine. Had too much kalunyak that I'm still digesting.
scripts.translation: 我不用了，卡鲁尼亚克吃太多，还没消化完。

scripts.text: You should take this. Nice work.
Good job today as well. Two of you, get some food. Adventurer, that this. I'm counting on you tomorrow as well!
scripts.translation: 今天也干得很好。你们两个去吃点东西吧。冒险者，这个给你。明天还得拜托你！

scripts.text: Just deliver this big lunchbox to Panna who's out on a cave patrol.
scripts.translation: 把这个大午餐盒送给正在洞穴巡逻的潘娜就行了。

scripts.text: Adventurer, you're here already? It's not the time for lunchbox delivery yet.
scripts.translation: 冒险者，你来得这么早？还没到送午餐盒的时候。

scripts.text: Right on time. Two people are here already and waiting.
scripts.translation: 来得正好，他们两个已经在这里等着了。

scripts.text: Waited for a long time. Almost died waiting.
Then I ask that you ^0000cddeliver the lunchbox to Panna in the cave^000000 for today as well. Hurry up on your way there, but take your time on your way back.
scripts.translation: 那么，今天也请你们把午餐盒送到洞穴里交给潘娜。去的时候走快点，回来时慢慢走。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Stop eating! Stop! Shame on you!
Enough already! You guys are getting worse and worse every day! don't you guys think this is too much? Have you no conscience?!
scripts.translation: 够了！你们一天比一天过分！不觉得这样太过分了吗？还有没有良心？！

scripts.text: Conscience? Mm... Sorry, but I don't know because I have no clue where my conscience is.
scripts.translation: 良心？嗯...抱歉，我不知道自己的良心在哪儿。

scripts.text: Probably in the chest, right? But what am I supposed to do with it?
scripts.translation: 大概在胸口吧？不过拿它来做什么？

scripts.text: The minute I catch kalunyak, you two devour it! You even ate the ones I had cleaned!
scripts.translation: 我一抓到卡鲁尼亚克，你们俩就把它吃掉！连我清洗好的也不放过！

scripts.text: didn't I tell you several times that those must be fermented and delivered? And the deadline has already passed!
scripts.translation: 我不是跟你们说过好几次，这些得先发酵再送货吗？而且交货期限都过了！

scripts.text: I did. But I couldn't help it.
Uh, are you Legalas who supplies kaluna?
scripts.translation: 呃，你就是给大家供应卡鲁纳的莱加拉斯吗？

scripts.text: Now look! Someone is here because I couldn't make the delivery! I'm ruined now! I'll starve to death!
scripts.translation: 看吧！因为我没能按时送货，客人都找上门了！我完蛋了，要饿死了！

scripts.text: Calm down. The situation is bad but no need to be so pessimistic. Why is everyone here so extreme?
scripts.translation: 冷静点。情况确实不好，但也不至于这么悲观。这里的人怎么都这么容易慌？

scripts.text: I don't know what you mean. Please explain.
scripts.translation: 我不懂你的意思，请解释一下。

scripts.text: Kalu from the adventurers' club wants to know why the delivery is being late. He has enough to sell for today, so everything will be fine as long as you can deliver by today.
scripts.translation: 冒险者俱乐部的卡卢想知道送货为什么延误。他今天还有足够的库存，只要你今天能送到就没问题。

scripts.text: Ha! Huh! Ha! I wish I can do that. But those two pigs are devouring the kalunyaks! At first, they ate one or two, but now they're at it the minute I catch one. I don't have the opportunity to clean and ferment it!
scripts.translation: 哈！唉！我也想啊。可那两头猪把卡鲁尼亚克都吃了！起初还只吃一两个，现在我一抓到它们就抢。我根本没机会清洗和发酵！

scripts.text: If you want kaluna, then do something about ^0000cdthose two over there^000000! I'm about to go crazy because not only do they leech onto me, now they're ruining my work. Perhaps It's better that I go back to the battlefield!
scripts.translation: 想要卡鲁纳，就去处理那边那两个人！他们不但赖着不走，还毁了我的工作，我快疯了！我还不如回战场去呢！ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Please calm down. I'll talk to them.
scripts.translation: 冷静点，我去跟他们谈谈。

scripts.text: They won't listen no matter what. Look at those bellies. They're from eating so much kalunyak and kaluna.
scripts.translation: 跟他们说什么都没用。看看他们的肚子，都是吃太多卡鲁尼亚克和卡鲁纳吃出来的。

scripts.text: Who knows where the pigs suddenly disappeared to, but I hope they're not back anytime soon. I'm on a roll here! A little more, just a little more...!
scripts.translation: 不知道那两头猪突然跑哪儿去了，希望它们别这么快回来。我正忙得起劲呢！再一点点，就快好了...

scripts.text: Legalas, I tried everything to make them work, but they have neither the skills nor will.
scripts.translation: 莱加拉斯，我试着让他们干活了，可他们既没本事，也没那个意愿。

scripts.text: But they promised that they won't eat kalunyak, so you won't have any problem with the delivery anymore.
scripts.translation: 不过他们保证不再吃卡鲁尼亚克，这下应该不会影响你送货了。

scripts.text: You seem to have some grudge against us. I'm going to tell Legalas everything as soon as he gets here.
scripts.translation: 你对我们好像有意见。莱加拉斯一来，我就把事情都告诉他。

scripts.text: What did we do wrong anyway?
I was wondering why you suddenly took these two out. So That's what happened. It must've been difficult, taking them around with you.
scripts.translation: 我还纳闷你为什么突然带这两个人过来，原来是这么回事。带着他们到处跑，辛苦你了。

scripts.text: Thanks to your sacrifice, I was able to make most of the ^0000cdkaluna^000000 I needed to deliver. Thank you so much.
scripts.translation: 多亏你帮忙，我总算做出了大部分要交付的卡鲁纳。太感谢了。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: You guys are openly being mean to us.
scripts.translation: 你们也太明目张胆地欺负我们了。
卡鲁尼亚克果然最好吃。

scripts.text: Doh! That pig is eating kalunyak again!
scripts.translation: 哎呀！那头猪又在吃卡鲁尼亚克了！

scripts.text: I was hungry. I can't eat anchovies anymore. I can only eat kalunyak now.
scripts.translation: 我饿了嘛，凤尾鱼我已经吃腻了，现在只想吃卡鲁尼亚克。

scripts.text: I have no work so I'll eat again.
scripts.translation: 反正没事做，那我再吃点。

scripts.text: Adventurer, I have a favor to ask. I haven't met my delivery quota yet, but those two are eating all my kalunyaks! What you see is all I got for today and at this rate, I won't be able to fulfill the order.
scripts.translation: 冒险者，能帮我个忙吗？我还没完成今天的交货量，那两个人却把卡鲁尼亚克都吃了！今天就剩这些了，照这样下去我根本交不了货。

scripts.text: Please take them with you again, even for a short while!
scripts.translation: 拜托你了，哪怕只带走他们一会儿也好！

scripts.text: I need to deliver some message to Kalu anyway, so I'll take the two with me.
scripts.translation: 反正我也要给卡卢送消息，就带他们一起去吧。

scripts.text: Guys, how about we go to the ^0000cdPub-Oven^000000?
Fine. Anywhere as long as It's not boring.
scripts.translation: 行啊，只要不无聊，去哪儿都行。

scripts.text: Does it have plenty of yummy food? If yes, I'll go.
scripts.translation: 那里有很多好吃的吗？有的话我就去。

scripts.text: Thanks for keeping these pigs. Thanks to you, my job got easier!
scripts.translation: 谢谢你帮我看着这两头猪！多亏了你，我的工作轻松多了！

scripts.text: Guys, there's something I wish to share with you.
scripts.translation: 大家，我有件事想跟你们说。

scripts.text: I'm getting tired of this now. But there's nothing else to eat.
scripts.translation: 我有点吃腻了，可也没别的东西吃。

scripts.text: When did we eat because we wanted to? It was more like eating because it was there.
scripts.translation: 我们什么时候是因为想吃才吃的？明明是因为有得吃才吃。

scripts.text: What is it? Did you bring something to eat?
scripts.translation: 怎么了？你带吃的来了吗？

scripts.text: Are you going to play with us?
From what I hear, you eat all the kalunyaks that Legalas cleans. Right now, we're almost out of kaluna made from those kalunyaks. Can you please control yourselves a bit?
scripts.translation: 听说你们把莱加拉斯清洗好的卡鲁尼亚克全吃了。现在用卡鲁尼亚克做的卡鲁纳快用完了，能不能稍微克制一下？

scripts.text: Because you can't make kaluna milk without kaluna. Someone who was supposed to receive kaluna from Legalas is in a tight spot right now.
scripts.translation: 没有卡鲁纳就做不了卡鲁纳牛奶。莱加拉斯有个客户正等着收货，已经很为难了。

scripts.text: What does that have to do with us?
You see, Kalu really needs kaluna. Without kaluna, he can't continue his business.
scripts.translation: 卡卢很需要卡鲁纳。没有卡鲁纳，他的生意就做不下去。

scripts.text: That has nothing to do with me.
It has a lot to do with Legalas. You are aware that Legalas supplies Kalu with kaluna fermented from kalunyak, right?
scripts.translation: 这和莱加拉斯关系可大了。你们知道他是把卡鲁尼亚克发酵成卡鲁纳，再供应给卡卢的吧？

scripts.text: If he can't meet the deadline or delivery quota, he'll lose his job to someone else.
scripts.translation: 要是他没按时交货或没完成配额，就会被别人取代。

scripts.text: So what does that have to do with us?
If Legalas loses his job, then he won't be able to earn money. And if he can't earn money, then wouldn't that put you guys in a tight spot?
scripts.translation: 莱加拉斯要是丢了工作，就没法赚钱。你们的生活不也会因此陷入困境吗？

scripts.text: From what I gather, Legalas feeds you, clothes you, and puts a roof over your heads.
scripts.translation: 据我所知，莱加拉斯给你们吃的、穿的，还给你们提供住处。

scripts.text: Then Legalas can find some other job.
scripts.translation: 那莱加拉斯可以去找别的工作啊。

scripts.text: If you're ruining his work right now, what makes you think that Legalas won't do anything later? He'll probably get rid of you two and go find some other opportunities.
scripts.translation: 你们现在一直在妨碍他工作，凭什么觉得他以后还会管你们？他大概会把你们赶走，另谋出路。

scripts.text: Then you two who can't support yourselves will wander around and starve to death in some filthy backstreet alley.
scripts.translation: 到时候你们两个养不活自己，只能在肮脏的小巷里流浪，最后饿死。

scripts.text: Then you guys shouldn't get in the way now, should you? Are you going to eat more kalunyaks?
scripts.translation: 那你们现在就别再妨碍他了，对吧？还要继续吃卡鲁尼亚克吗？

scripts.text: Not eating kalunyaks is not enough. I've never thought about the possibility that Legalas can leave us. We must do something.
scripts.translation: 光不吃卡鲁尼亚克还不够。我从没想过莱加拉斯会离开我们，我们得做点什么。
态度不错！这样莱加拉斯就...

scripts.text: You brought up the subject so you should be responsible for us. That's how Legalas has been taking care of us.
scripts.translation: 既然是你提起这件事的，就该对我们负责。莱加拉斯一直就是这么照顾我们的。
莱加拉斯去哪儿，我就去哪儿。

scripts.text: there's something called doram trash among the dorams. Too bad that you can't use it since you're not dorams and That's about it. Fine.
scripts.translation: 多兰里有种东西叫“多兰废物”。可惜你们不是多兰，所以也用不上。就这样吧。

scripts.text: I'm the one responsible for bringing up the subject and for poor Legalas's sake, I'll help you guys find a job.
scripts.translation: 既然是我提起这件事，为了可怜的莱加拉斯，我会帮你们找份工作。

scripts.text: there's nothing I can teach you. But as I said, I'll look for a place where you can learn.
scripts.translation: 我没什么能教你们的。不过我说过，会帮你们找个能学习的地方。

scripts.text: Then find something easy. I think something like ^0000cdbabysitting^000000 would be nice.
scripts.translation: 那就找点轻松的活吧。比如照看小孩就不错。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Yeah, I like babies. Small and cute.
scripts.translation: 对，我喜欢小宝宝，小小的，很可爱。

scripts.text: Fine. I'll see if there are any babies around here. There is some type of ^0000cdplayground^000000 above the pub. I'll take a look there.
scripts.translation: 好吧，我看看附近有没有需要照看的小孩。酒馆上面好像有个游乐场，先去那里看看。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Yeah, this place is the best. It doesn't taste good, but drinking kaluna seems to be my destiny.
scripts.translation: 对，这里最好。卡鲁纳虽然不好喝，但喝它大概就是我的命。

scripts.text: I said I'll go see Kalu. I was bored anyway, so It's all good. Go, you lead the way.
scripts.translation: 我说了要去找卡卢啊。反正我也无聊，这样正好。走吧，你带路。

scripts.text: I'm drinking kaluna right now, but It's not because It's tasty. It's because It's there.
scripts.translation: 我现在喝卡鲁纳，可不是因为它好喝，只是因为手边正好有。

scripts.text: Guys, there's something I wish to share with you.
scripts.translation: 大家，我有件事想告诉你们。

scripts.text: I'm getting tired of this now. But there's nothing else to eat.
scripts.translation: 我有点吃腻了，可也没别的东西吃。

scripts.text: When did we eat because we wanted to? It was more like eating because it was there.
scripts.translation: 我们什么时候是因为想吃才吃的？明明是因为有得吃才吃。

scripts.text: What is it? Did you bring something to eat?
scripts.translation: 怎么了？你带吃的来了吗？

scripts.text: Are you going to play with us?
From what I hear, you eat all the kalunyaks that Legalas cleans. Right now, we're almost out of kaluna made from those kalunyaks. Can you please control yourselves a bit?
scripts.translation: 听说你们把莱加拉斯清洗好的卡鲁尼亚克全吃了。现在用卡鲁尼亚克做的卡鲁纳快用完了，能不能稍微克制一下？

scripts.text: Because you can't make kaluna milk without kaluna. Someone who was supposed to receive kaluna from Legalas is in a tight spot right now.
scripts.translation: 没有卡鲁纳就做不了卡鲁纳牛奶。莱加拉斯有个客户正等着收货，已经很为难了。

scripts.text: What does that have to do with us?
You see, Kalu really needs kaluna. Without kaluna, he can't continue his business.
scripts.translation: 卡卢很需要卡鲁纳。没有卡鲁纳，他的生意就做不下去。

scripts.text: That has nothing to do with me.
It has a lot to do with Legalas. You are aware that Legalas supplies Kalu with kaluna fermented from kalunyak, right?
scripts.translation: 这和莱加拉斯关系可大了。你们知道他是把卡鲁尼亚克发酵成卡鲁纳，再供应给卡卢的吧？

scripts.text: If he can't meet the deadline or delivery quota, he'll lose his job to someone else.
scripts.translation: 要是他没按时交货或没完成配额，就会被别人取代。

scripts.text: So what does that have to do with us?
If Legalas loses his job, then he won't be able to earn money. And if he can't earn money, then wouldn't that put you guys in a tight spot?
scripts.translation: 莱加拉斯要是丢了工作，就没法赚钱。你们的生活不也会因此陷入困境吗？

scripts.text: From what I gather, Legalas feeds you, clothes you, and puts a roof over your heads.
scripts.translation: 据我所知，莱加拉斯给你们吃的、穿的，还给你们提供住处。

scripts.text: Then Legalas can find some other job.
scripts.translation: 那莱加拉斯可以去找别的工作啊。

scripts.text: If you're ruining his work right now, what makes you think that Legalas won't do anything later? He'll probably get rid of you two and go find some other opportunities.
scripts.translation: 你们现在一直在妨碍他工作，凭什么觉得莱加拉斯以后还会管你们？他大概会把你们赶走，另谋出路。

scripts.text: Then you two who can't support yourselves will wander around and starve to death in some filthy backstreet alley.
scripts.translation: 到时候你们两个养不活自己，只能在肮脏的小巷里流浪，最后饿死。

scripts.text: Then you guys shouldn't get in the way now, should you? Are you going to eat more kalunyaks?
scripts.translation: 那你们现在就别再妨碍他了，对吧？还要继续吃卡鲁尼亚克吗？

scripts.text: Not eating kalunyaks is not enough. I've never thought about the possibility that Legalas can leave us. We must do something.
scripts.translation: 光不吃卡鲁尼亚克还不够。我从没想过莱加拉斯会离开我们，我们得做点什么。
态度不错！这样莱加拉斯就...

scripts.text: You brought up the subject so you should be responsible for us. That's how Legalas has been taking care of us.
scripts.translation: 既然是你提起这件事的，就该对我们负责。莱加拉斯一直就是这样照顾我们的。
莱加拉斯去哪儿，我就去哪儿。

scripts.text: there's something called doram trash among the dorams. Too bad that you can't use it since you're not dorams and That's about it. Fine.
scripts.translation: 多兰里有种东西叫“多兰废物”。可惜你们不是多兰，所以也用不上。就这样吧。

scripts.text: I'm the one responsible for bringing up the subject and for poor Legalas's sake, I'll help you guys find a job.
scripts.translation: 既然是我提起这件事，为了可怜的莱加拉斯，我会帮你们找份工作。

scripts.text: there's nothing I can teach you. But as I said, I'll look for a place where you can learn.
scripts.translation: 我没什么能教你们的。不过我说过，会帮你们找个能学习的地方。

scripts.text: Then find something easy. I think something like ^0000cdbabysitting^000000 would be nice.
scripts.translation: 那就找点轻松的活吧。比如照看小孩就不错。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Yeah, I like babies. Small and cute.
scripts.translation: 对，我喜欢小宝宝，小小的，很可爱。

scripts.text: Fine. I'll see if there are any babies around here. There is some type of ^0000cdplayground^000000 above the pub. I'll take a look there.
scripts.translation: 好吧，我看看附近有没有需要照看的小孩。酒馆上面好像有个游乐场，我先去那里看看。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I can't believe I was going to leave this comfy place. I forgot for a second that eating kalunyak is the biggest joy in my life.
scripts.translation: 真不敢相信我刚才竟然想离开这么舒服的地方。我一时忘了，吃卡鲁尼亚克才是人生最大的乐趣。

scripts.text: Let's go see Kalu. I want to go and eat something yummy.
scripts.translation: 我们去找卡卢吧，我想去吃点好吃的。

scripts.text: Eating kalunyak is simple. Grab kalunyak with hard shell. Then hand it over to Legalas.
scripts.translation: 卡鲁尼亚克很简单：抓起带硬壳的卡鲁尼亚克，然后交给莱加拉斯。

scripts.text: Legalas gets rid of kalunyak's shell and puts it in a container. Then you eat from that container. Simple, right?
scripts.translation: 莱加拉斯会把卡鲁尼亚克剥壳后放进容器里，然后你们就可以吃了。很简单吧？

scripts.text: Wouldn't Babysitting be easy? What can a little kid do?
scripts.translation: 照看小孩应该很轻松吧？小孩子能做什么呢？
虽然个头很大，但确实...是个婴儿。

scripts.text: G-guys? didn't you want me to find you a babysitting job?
scripts.translation: 你...你们不是想让我帮忙找照看小孩的工作吗？

scripts.text: So That's what we're doing right now. We're sitting as hard as we can.
scripts.translation: 我们现在不就在做吗？正努力坐着呢。

scripts.text: Babysitting is not sitting around quietly. It's looking after a baby!
scripts.translation: 照看小孩不是坐着不动，而是要看护小孩！

scripts.text: Is that so? But That's so bothersome! I can't even look after my own body.
scripts.translation: 是这样吗？可太麻烦了！我连自己都照顾不好。

scripts.text: That was what babysitting was about? I didn't know. If I did, I wouldn't have done it.
scripts.translation: 原来照看小孩是这么回事？我不知道啊，早知道就不干了。

scripts.text: This is not going to work. Let's forget about babysitting. Was there anything you've always wanted to do?
scripts.translation: 这样不行，还是别照看小孩了。你们有没有一直想做的事？

scripts.text: Now that I think about it, I've always wanted to do something ^0000cdrelated to anchovies^000000. Anchovies are yummy.
scripts.translation: 仔细想想，我一直想做些和鳀鱼有关的事。鳀鱼很好吃。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Okay, fine. Let's go to the anchovy workshop ^0000cdnear the dock^000000.
scripts.translation: 好吧，那就去码头附近的鳀鱼工坊看看。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Opps! I was supposed to go to the anchovy workshop. Gotta hurry.
scripts.translation: 糟了！我本来要去鳀鱼工坊的，得赶紧走。

scripts.text: Twinkle twinkle little star - how I wonder what you are -
scripts.translation: 一闪一闪亮晶晶 - 满天都是小星星 -

scripts.text: Up above the world so high - like a diamond in the sky -
scripts.translation: 挂在天上放光明 - 好像许多小眼睛 -

scripts.text: Twinkle twinkle little star - how I wonder what you are -
scripts.translation: 一闪一闪亮晶晶 - 满天都是小星星 -

scripts.text: To be honest, before I came here, I thought the anchovies were dug from the ground. But I'm not embarrassed though.
scripts.translation: 说实话，我来之前还以为鳀鱼是从地里挖出来的。不过，我可不觉得丢脸。

scripts.text: I've had anchovies before because Legalas bought some time to time.
scripts.translation: 我以前吃过鳀鱼，莱加拉斯偶尔会买一些回来。

scripts.text: Rookie? Have experience working in this field? Well, it doesn't matter even if you don't. You can learn it easily.
scripts.translation: 新人？做过这行吗？没有也没关系，很快就能学会。

scripts.text: Now, follow after me. Grab an anchovy. Remove its head. Pull out the guts. Put it inside the container.
scripts.translation: 跟我来。拿一条鳀鱼，去掉鱼头，掏出内脏，再放进容器里。

scripts.text: Rookies go through these four steps, but skilled workers pick up and simultaneously remove head and guts and throw it inside the container. They are capable of one-step method.
scripts.translation: 新手要分四步做，熟练工人却能一边拿鱼，一边去头、掏内脏，再把它扔进容器，一步完成。

scripts.text: The captain of Con-Chliina was especially skilled at it. Now, you guys give it a try.
scripts.translation: 康奇利娜号的船长尤其擅长这个。现在你们也试试看。

scripts.text: What is this gross looking thing?
Anchovy. You said you wanted to do something that has to do with anchovies, so I brought you here.
scripts.translation: 鳀鱼啊。你们不是说想做和鳀鱼有关的工作吗？所以我就带你们来了。

scripts.text: Anchovy is a long and thin snack That's a bit salty, Isn't it? But this thing has a head... and eyes too!
scripts.translation: 鳀鱼不是细长、咸咸的零食吗？可这东西竟然有头...还有眼睛！

scripts.text: Of course it has eyes and head since It's a fish.
scripts.translation: 它是鱼，当然有眼睛和头。

scripts.text: Then what did you think it was?
I thought it was a tasty food made from some mysterious ingredients in the store.
scripts.translation: 我以为那是商店里用神秘材料做出来的美味。

scripts.text: Guys... how can you not know that an anchovy is a fish? What kind of lives did you guys live?
scripts.translation: 你们...怎么会不知道鳀鱼是鱼？以前到底过的是什么日子啊？

scripts.text: Where in the world did you find these idiots? Do you think they can handle this job?
scripts.translation: 你们从哪儿找来这两个笨蛋的？他们真能干这份活吗？

scripts.text: I don't think I can eat another anchovy ever again. Our eyes met just before. They're going to follow me every time I see an anchovy.
scripts.translation: 我再也不想吃鳀鱼了。刚才我还和它对上了眼。以后每次看到鳀鱼，我都会想起那双眼睛。

scripts.text: Ha... Is that so? Seems like this job is not for you either. Then Let's go find something else. Was there any other job you wanted to try?
scripts.translation: 哈...是吗？看来这份工作也不适合你们。我们再找别的吧。还有什么想做的工作吗？

scripts.text: Ship. I want to be on a ^0000cdship^000000!
Right. I've been living in Lasagna all this time and never been on a ship. This is a good chance to board on one.
scripts.translation: 对啊，我一直住在罗札纳，还从没上过船。这可是个好机会。

scripts.text: Yeah? Then Let's go to that ^0000cdanchovy fishing boat up there^000000.
scripts.translation: 是吗？那我们去上面那艘鳀鱼渔船看看。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Didn't you say you were going to the anchovy shipping boat? Beats me what you can do there even if you go there.
scripts.translation: 你们不是说想去鳀鱼运输船吗？就算去了，我也不知道你们能做什么。

scripts.text: Lasagna's anchovies are special. Top quality anchovies are steamed and dried nine times, followed by removal of head and guts. This is an art work that requires delicate processes.
scripts.translation: 罗札纳的鳀鱼很特别。上等鳀鱼要蒸干九次，再去掉头和内脏。这是一门讲究细致工序的手艺。

scripts.text: They're perfect to be served with alcohol and make great snacks for students studying for an exam. Try one.
scripts.translation: 它们很适合下酒，也是备考学生的好零食。尝一个吧。

scripts.text: I've always wanted to be on a boat... hah... nostalgia...
scripts.translation: 我一直想上船...哈哈...真让人怀念...

scripts.text: Every time I see a boat, it reminds me of a shell. You know, the one that is empty inside and hard outside.
scripts.translation: 每次看到船，我就会想起贝壳。你知道那种东西吧？里面空空的，外面却很硬。

scripts.text: I was wondering if you need any help on the ship.
scripts.translation: 我想问问船上需不需要帮手。

scripts.text: Anchovy business has definitely seen better days, but I'm always short on hands.
scripts.translation: 鱼生意确实不如从前了，不过我一直缺人手。

scripts.text: Then how about you give these two a try? They want to work on a ship, so even an apprenticeship would be nice.
scripts.translation: 那您愿不愿意试用这两个人？他们想在船上工作，就算从学徒做起也行。
感觉我们像是要被卖掉了。

scripts.text: Probably just an imagination. He wouldn't sell us.
scripts.translation: 大概是你想多了，他不会卖掉我们的。

scripts.text: Hey, you two over there. Have you ever been on a ship?
scripts.translation: 喂，你们两个以前上过船吗？

scripts.text: Nah. My mom held my hand and came here just by riding on the tides. She was swept away and I landed here alone. Legalas found me and since then, we've been living together like a family.
scripts.translation: 没有。我妈妈牵着我的手，跟着潮水漂到了这里。她被潮水冲走了，我一个人留在岸上。莱加拉斯发现了我，从那以后我们就像一家人一样生活。

scripts.text: No need to know about your past. I just need you to do a good job on the ship. Since this is the first time on a boat for both of you, looks like there's a long bumpy road ahead.
scripts.translation: 不需要知道你们的过去，只要在船上好好干活就行。既然你们都是第一次上船，往后可有不少苦头要吃。

scripts.text: So mean. I shared my painful past and you couldn't care any less.
scripts.translation: 真冷漠。我都把伤心往事告诉你了，你却一点也不在意。

scripts.text: I want to share mine. Can I tell you?
scripts.translation: 我也想讲讲自己的故事，可以吗？

scripts.text: Now now, calm down. How does it feel to be on a ship? It carries anchovies from the anchovy fishing boat to Lasagna, but you won't get to see them since the cargo is stored in the storage area.
scripts.translation: 好了，冷静点。在船上的感觉怎么样？这艘船负责把鳀鱼从渔船运到罗札纳，不过货物都放在仓库里，你们看不到。

scripts.text: That's not the problem I'm upset.
Why does the floor look so nauseous?
scripts.translation: 为什么地板看起来这么晃，真恶心？

scripts.text: Looks like you got a seasickness. It'll get better after a while. By then, you'll feel strange when you walk on land.
scripts.translation: 是晕船了。过一会儿就会好些，不过到时在陆地上走路反而会觉得怪怪的。

scripts.text: Weird. The ship is firm, but why is it so nauseous?
scripts.translation: 真奇怪，船明明这么稳，我为什么还会晕？

scripts.text: That's because the boat moves along with the waves.
scripts.translation: 因为船会随着波浪起伏。

scripts.text: What? Isn't the boat stuck firmly on the water?!
scripts.translation: 什么？船不是牢牢停在水面上的吗？！

scripts.text: It's floating on water, not stuck on water. How can a boat move if It's stuck on water?!
scripts.translation: 浮在水上，不是钉在水上。要是钉住了，还怎么航行？！

scripts.text: I can't believe it! How can you say that such heavy boat is floating on water?!
scripts.translation: 不敢相信！这么重的船怎么可能浮在水面上？！

scripts.text: Take them back with you. Working on a ship doesn't require high intelligence, but these idiots probably can't even pull off a cleaning job. No, forget cleaning. I'll be lucky if they don't drive me crazy first.
scripts.translation: 们带回去吧。船上的活不需要多聪明，可这两个笨蛋恐怕连清理工作都做不好。不，别说清理了，只要他们不把我逼疯，我就谢天谢地了。

scripts.text: What do you mean you understand? You don't say such a thing like that.
scripts.translation: 你说“明白了”是什么意思？怎么能这么说呢？

scripts.text: This won't do. I don't think I can help you. We should go back to ^0000cdLegalas^000000 discuss the matter with him. Let's go now.
scripts.translation: 这不行，我帮不了你们。我们还是回去和莱加拉斯商量一下吧，现在就走。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I don't know what just happened, but I'm happy to go back.
scripts.translation: 我不知道刚才发生了什么，不过能回去就好。

scripts.text: Yeah, Let's go back for now. This is not fun anymore.
scripts.translation: 是啊，先回去吧。这里一点也不好玩。

scripts.text: Didn't you say that you're going back to Legalas? And next time you bring some helpers, make sure they're decent.
scripts.translation: 不是说要回去找莱加拉斯吗？下次带帮手来，记得找靠谱的人。

scripts.text: If you have anybody decent, bring him. I'm so short on hands that I do all of that work by myself.
scripts.translation: 靠谱的人就带来吧。我实在缺人手，什么活都得自己干。

scripts.text: What is it? didn't you say that you had some business with not me, but Kalu?
scripts.translation: 怎么了？你不是说要找卡卢办事，不是来找我的吗？

scripts.text: Kalu! Tell Kalu that you delivered the lunchbox so we can eat!
scripts.translation: 卡卢！快告诉他午餐盒送到了，这样我们就有东西吃了！

scripts.text: I like relaxing here as well. No craving for kalunyak either.
scripts.translation: 我也喜欢在这里放松，而且也不怎么想吃卡鲁尼亚克。

scripts.text: Didn't you say you had something to say to Kalu? Go ahead.
scripts.translation: 你不是有话要跟卡卢说吗？快去吧。

scripts.text: Too late. Go and report to Kalu.
scripts.translation: 太迟了，快去把午餐盒交给卡卢吧。

scripts.text: You're here already. We hate waiting, so we're thinking about just settling here.
scripts.translation: 你终于来了。我们讨厌等人，刚才都打算直接在这儿住下了。

scripts.text: Hurry, go and deliver his lunchbox. He looks like he's about to starve to death.
scripts.translation: 快把午餐盒送过去，他看起来快饿死了。

scripts.text: Give that vigilante a lunchbox. I'm curious as to what's inside.
scripts.translation: 给那个义警送午餐盒吧，我很好奇里面装了什么。

scripts.text: Oh, I'm so hungry. When is the food coming? Food.
scripts.translation: 啊，我好饿。饭什么时候送来？我要吃饭。

scripts.text: Where's the lunchbox? Where's mine? there's none for me! Where did you drop it? My food! My food!!!
scripts.translation: 午餐盒呢？我的那份呢？怎么没有我的！你把它弄丢在哪儿了？我的饭！我的饭！！！

scripts.text: Calm down. I'll go find it right now.
I can understand, though. Let's go find the lunchbox.
scripts.translation: 我能理解。我们去找午餐盒吧。
真是个粗鲁又不知感恩的多兰。

scripts.text: How am I supposed to talk when I'm eating?
scripts.translation: 我吃东西的时候怎么说话？

scripts.text: Hah, I feel much better now. I was so hungry that I was about to eat a basilisk, and you couldn't come at a better time. I almost became a doram who failed to remain as one and turn into an animal.
scripts.translation: 哈，舒服多了。刚才我饿得差点把巴西利斯克都吃了，幸好你及时送来午餐。我差点饿到失去理智，变成只会吃东西的野兽。

scripts.text: It's okay, just leave them. I'll take them with me when I go back to town later.
scripts.translation: 不用，就放在那里吧。我晚些回城时会带走。

scripts.text: Thanks to you, I was able to eat a hearty meal. Please tell Kalu that I'm grateful for the delicious lunch. Hopefully, today will be another safe...
scripts.translation: 多亏了你，我才能饱餐一顿。请替我谢谢卡卢，这顿午餐真好吃。希望今天也能平安无事...

scripts.text: Oh, I'm so hungry. When is the food coming? Food.
scripts.translation: 啊，我好饿。饭什么时候送来？我要吃饭。
